# [OHM-018] THT trimmer potentiometer
## Identity
- Canonical name: THT trimmer potentiometer (multi-turn cermet, Bourns 3296W as representative). ID OHM-018, slug `pot_trimmer_tht`.
- Category electromechanical / potentiometer. Package PKG-TRIMMER. Mounting tht.
- Aliases: trimpot, preset, multi-turn trimmer, 3296W (top adjust), 3296X (side adjust), 3386 (single turn 3/8 in).
- Class A, priority P2, complexity 3.
## Physical Dimensions
Default 3296W: body length (along row, Y) 9.53 (M, "3/8 in" naming plus callout plus KiCad Bourns_3296W body 9.53 x 4.83, two independent documents), thickness (X) 4.83 +/-0.13 (M), height above board 10.03 (M), 3 pins in line at 2.54 pitch (H), pin dia 0.51 +/-0.03 (H), pin tail below body 3.81 default (L, candidates 3.81 +/-0.71 and 6.4 +/-1.32), 25 turns nominal (H). Adjust screw boss/recess dia 2.19 (L). Slot width ~0.56 and depth ~0.76 (L, labels uncertain).
## Geometry
Rectangular housing, flat top. Top adjust (W): a circular screw recess on the top face with a brass screw head and screwdriver slot; the screw center from the KiCad 3296W fab drawing (S5) is at Y = +3.495 (toward pin 1), X offset +1.15 from the body center, dia 2.19 (M-L; replaces the first-pass default Y = -2.54). Side adjust (X): screw head in the side/end face (position RESEARCH_REQUIRED). Pins exit the bottom face centered across the thickness.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
3 round pins dia 0.51 in a line at X=0, Y = +2.54 (pin 1), 0 (pin 2, wiper), -2.54 (pin 3). Tail to Z = -3.81 (default, differs from -2.6 architecture default; use -3.81 per source candidate; LOD0 may omit). Tinned/ gold-flash (unverified), MAT_TIN_BRIGHT visual. Terminal 2 is the wiper.
## PCB Interface
3 holes (dia 0.9 default) at pitch 2.54 along Y. Origin FCO = center pin (pin 2) = body center along Y; body center offset 0 (KiCad 3296W footprint: pin row centered along the body and centered across the 4.83 thickness within 0.01, so offset (0,0) confirmed, M). KiCad pad 1.44 dia / drill 0.8 for reference (the 0.9 hole default stays an OHMNI choice). standoff: UNCERTAIN, 0 default (real trimmers often sit on molded standoffs ~0.5; not read).
## Materials
Housing MAT_PLASTIC_BLUE (proposed; de facto, Bourns 3296 is commonly white or blue, color not source-supported), screw MAT_BRASS, pins MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
## Appearance
Blue (or white) block with a gold/brass screw head; printed code (e.g. "103" = 10 k) on the side face. Gloss low. Manufacturer variation large.
## Orientation Markings
No polarity. Terminals numbered 1, 2, 3; wiper = 2. Many bodies print an arrow or "1" near terminal 1 (unverified).
## Recognition Features
1. Narrow tall rectangular block, 2. brass slotted screw on top or end, 3. three in-line pins at 2.54, 4. printed resistance code.
## Parametric Variants
adjust_style (top|side), height (10.03 default), screw_y, pin_tail_length, color.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Box body, cylinder recess + screw cylinder + slot cut, 3 pin cylinders.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Box 4.83 (X) x 9.53 (Y) x 10.03 (Z), bottom Z=0. 2. Screw recess dia 2.19 depth 0.8 at (1.15, +3.495) on top (top adjust; KiCad fab marker position, M-L). 3. Brass screw head inside, slot 0.56 wide. 4. Three pins down. 5. Printed code decal.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + 3 pin boxes. LOD1: screw recess/screw with slot, pins. LOD2: housing edge radii, vent/seal detail, screw thread glimpse.
## Simplification Rules
May omit: seal marks, printed code, edge radii. Never omit: 3 pins at 2.54, screw head and slot, body proportions (tall block).

# [OHM-019] SMD trimmer potentiometer
## Identity

OHMNI default 3314G-1-103E: 4.5 x 4.5 x 2.55 (element14 distributor listing plus re-read Bourns 3314 datasheet: top-adjust G/J/H height 2.55; M). Conflict RESOLVED in gap-fill: the 1.30 +/-0.1 height and 5.00 to 6.20 length belong to the R/S/Z styles, not G/J. Adjust slot about 2.45 x 0.51 (datasheet read, L), mechanical angle 240 deg nominal (L). 3224 alternative: L 5.3 / W 4.8 / H 2.9 (3224W) etc. (family table).
## Geometry
Low square block with a circular rotor on top: a flat-top round rotor (dia about 3.2, UNCERTAIN) with a screwdriver slot 2.45 x 0.51 across its diameter; thin plastic housing; terminal pads on the underside edges.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
3 SMD terminals (pin 2 = wiper). Layout from the KiCad 3314G footprint (S5, Y flipped to OHMNI): pin 1 (+1.15, +2.75), pin 3 (-1.15, +2.75), pin 2 (0, -2.75); pad lands 1.3 x 1.3 (pins 1/3) and 2.0 x 1.3 (pin 2); model tabs wrap the body edge (see family), bottom Z=0.
## PCB Interface
3 SMD pads as above (KiCad 3314G pad sizes 1.3 x 1.3, 2.0 x 1.3 at the listed centers; 3314J uses 1.3 x 2.0 / 2.0 x 2.0 at |Y| = 2.0). FCO origin = center of pad bbox = body center (KiCad confirms offset (0,0), M). Standoff 0.
## Materials
Housing MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK or white (de facto; Bourns 3314 typically has a white or beige housing, unverified) default MAT_PLASTIC_WHITE; rotor MAT_PLASTIC_WHITE/ MAT_BRASS for metal rotor; pads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
## Appearance
White housing, tan rotor with a dark slot; printed code on rotor/housing. LOW confidence.
## Orientation Markings
None established. Terminal numbering 1, 2, 3 with 2 = wiper (Bourns).
## Recognition Features
1. Small square block, 2. round rotor with a slot, 3. three edge pads, 4. low height (about 2.5).
## Parametric Variants
size (3314|3224), style top/side adjust, height, rotor_diameter, housing_color.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Box housing + cylindrical rotor + slot cut + 3 pad boxes.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Box 4.5 x 4.5 x 2.0 (Z 0 to 2.0). 2. Rotor cylinder dia 3.2 on top to 2.55 height. 3. Slot cut 2.45 x 0.51 x 0.4. 4. Three pads. 
## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box. LOD1: box + rotor + slot + pads. LOD2: housing edge radii, rotor ring grooves.

# [OHM-020] Rotary potentiometer
## Identity
- Canonical name: Rotary potentiometer (panel/PCB, 16 mm Taiwan Alpha RV16 as representative; Bourns PTV09 9 mm alternate). ID OHM-020, slug `pot_rotary`.
- Category electromechanical / potentiometer. Package PKG-POT_ROTARY. Mounting tht (PCB pins, panel bushing).
- Aliases: pot, volume control, RV16, PTV09, 9 mm pot, 16 mm pot. Variants: bushing thread M6/M7/M8/M3/8 x 0.75; bushing length 5.0 to 8.0; shaft length 10 to 30; with/without switch (not modeled).
- Class A, priority P2, complexity 4. STATUS PARTIAL (many dimensions unresolved).
## Physical Dimensions
RV16 (Taiwan Alpha catalog): thread options M6x0.75, M7x0.75, M8x0.75, M3/8x0.75; bushing length options 5.0, 6.5, 7.0, 8.0; shaft lengths 10, 15, 20, 25; angle 300 +/-5 deg. OHMNI defaults (all L unless noted): body diameter 16 (from the "16 mm" name, DERIVED, M-L), body height above PCB 9.0 (UNCERTAIN placeholder), bushing M7 x 0.75 (dia 7.0; Alps RK163 bushing width 7), bushing length 7.0, shaft dia 6.0 (L-M: Alps RK163 shaft width 6 corroborates; the Alpha sheet read gave 5, 6.5, 8), shaft length (from bushing top) 15. PTV09 alternate: bushing M9 x 0.75, plastic bushing length 11.4 +0/-0.5, shaft length options 15/20/25/30, mechanical angle 280 +/-10 deg, pin dia 1.0 +0.2/-0, pin spacing numbers 1.8 and 2.2 (+0.2/-0) as read; body dims about 10.0 x 5.5 x 6.8 as read, assignment unclear. Gap-fill: RV16 pin spacing 5.0 / drill 1.3 corroborated (M-L) only by the Alps RK163 (another manufacturer) footprint in the KiCad library; Alpha RV16 itself not opened beyond the first pass. 9 mm class (PTV09A-1, Alpha RD901F): pin pitch 2.5, shaft 7.5 from the pin row, mounting holes 8.8 to 9.6 apart (KiCad, M-L), see PKG-POT_ROTARY.
## Geometry
Round or squarish metal can (steel) of dia 16 and ~9 mm tall; on top a threaded bushing (nickel/brass) coaxial with the shaft; a round shaft emerging from the bushing, tip features (flat, knurl, slot) per shaft code (K, F, R, R1 are Alpha's codes; meanings not established). Three bent pins from the can's bottom edge (vertical PCB mount). An optional anti-rotation lug on the bushing not read.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
3 pins (1, 2 wiper, 3), flat or round, placeholder dia 1.0, spacing 5.0 along Y (M-L: Alps RK163 pitch 5.0, drill 1.3), tails to Z = -2.6 default. 9 mm alternate (PTV09/Alpha RD901F): pitch 2.5, drill 1.0, shaft on the pin-2 line 7.5 from the pin row. Pin 1 at +Y: (0, +5.0). Pin tail material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
## PCB Interface
3 holes dia 1.3 (placeholder), plus mounting tabs if present (not read). FCO origin = pin pattern center; shaft axis at body center; body_offset (0, 0) UNCERTAIN. Standoff 0.
## Materials
Can MAT_STEEL_STAINLESS (zinc/ nickel plated steel, visual), bushing MAT_NICKEL, shaft MAT_STEEL_STAINLESS (or MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK for plastic shaft), pins MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, insulating base MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK.
## Appearance
Metal can silver, shaft knurled or flatted silver; markings printed on back/side; PTV09 plastic bushing variants have a black/colored plastic shaft. Appearance LOW.
## Orientation Markings
None; pin 1 at +Y. Wiper = pin 2.
## Recognition Features
1. Cylindrical can with a threaded bushing and shaft pointing up, 2. three bottom pins, 3. shaft length and tip (flat/knurl), 4. nut/washer if included.
## Parametric Variants
series (RV16|PTV09), bushing thread and length, shaft dia, shaft length, shaft tip style, body height, pin spacing.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder can + cylinder bushing + cylinder shaft with tip cut/knurl texture + 3 pins; optional hex nut.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Can cylinder dia 16 height 9 at (0,0). 2. Bushing cylinder dia 7 length 7 on top. 3. Shaft cylinder dia 6 length 15 from bushing top. 4. Tip: flat cut or knurled band. 5. Three pins at (0, +5.0), (0,0), (0,-5.0) down to -2.6.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0: can + bushing + shaft cylinders. LOD1: add shaft tip flat, pins, nut optional. LOD2: knurling, thread suggestion, can crimp, lugs.
## Simplification Rules
May omit: knurl detail, thread, crimps. Never omit: bushing, shaft length, three pins.

# G03: Non-MLCC Capacitors (OHM-028 .. OHM-040)

Group conventions used: FCO origin (arch Sec. 4), rotation 0: terminals on X axis, terminal 1 at -X (arch Sec. 6). For every polarized part in this group OHMNI fixes **terminal 1 = positive (+/anode) at -X**, negative at +X. EDA libraries differ (KiCad radial CP uses pin 1 = +; some SMD can libraries put pin 1 = -); importers must map by the `polarity` block, not by pin number.

New material tokens proposed (visual defaults, not research claims; all sRGB, roughness/metal in brackets):
- MAT_RUBBER_SEAL #26262A (0.8, 0): electrolytic bottom seal.
- MAT_CAP_DISC_COATING #C8782E (0.5, 0): epoxy/phenolic dip coating on ceramic disc, orange-brown (blue/green/tan acceptable via parameter).
- MAT_FILM_CASE_RED #B02A22 (0.45, 0): film box case (WIMA MKP-X2 case is red per opened datasheet).
- MAT_FILM_CASE_YELLOW #D9B83A (0.45, 0), MAT_FILM_CASE_BLUE #2F5FA8 (0.45, 0): alternative film colors (parameter only, not sourced).
- MAT_MICA_DIP #B9803D (0.55, 0): dipped silver mica coating (colour not verified; see PKG-MICA).
- MAT_CAN_TOP_ALU = MAT_ALUMINUM_CAN (reuse existing token; no new token).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-RADIAL_CAN

**Generator:** GEN-RADIAL_CAN. Owner of OHM-029 (radial aluminum electrolytic); also used (as a modifier) for radial polymer (OHM-032 style B) and as placeholder base for PKG-SUPERCAP.

### Shared geometry
- Cylinder (aluminum can) of diameter D, height L, axis +Z, resting on the board (standoff 0). Printed PET/PVC sleeve covers the can side and wraps ~1 mm over the top edge and down to the seal bead. Sleeve adds ~0.5 mm to D max (Panasonic/Rubycon style "phiD + 0.5 max" per ZLH drawing note; see sources).
- Top: flat aluminum disc under the sleeve overlap. For D >= 6.3 mm a pressure-relief vent score (K, Y or T shaped groove) is on the top face (Nichicon UPW drawing labels "Safety vent" with the annotation "(ø6.3up)"; the exact score shape is manufacturer-specific, de facto K/Y/T).
- Bottom: black rubber (or rubber-phenolic) seal flush with can crimp; a circumferential bead (groove) is rolled into the can wall about 1-2 mm above the bottom. (Construction knowledge, not read from an opened dimension table; bead depth RESEARCH_REQUIRED, use 0.4 mm visual default.)
- Two round tinned leads (CP wire: copper-clad steel, tinned; Nichicon drawing "tinned CP wire") exit the seal on the X axis at pitch F. Negative lead is the shorter of the two on virgin parts; **negative stripe**: a contrasting band (typically white/light, with "-" marks) running the full sleeve height on the negative side (+X, facing the negative lead).
- Lead length from can bottom: 15 mm min for bulk (Nichicon UPW drawing "15 min"; ZLH drawing "15 MIN", "4 MIN" meaning unresolved).
- L + alpha max: alpha = 1.5 for L <= 16, 2.0 for L >= 20 (Rubycon ZLH note), i.e. sleeve/seal overshoot above nominal height.

### Member dimension table (source: Vishay 517D "General Purpose Miniature Radial", Doc 42053, rev 12-Jun-13, Mouser-hosted; all values were read from a fetch-tool summary of the PDF)
| Member | D x L (mm) | F pitch | d lead | Basis / conf |

| 5x11 | 5.0 x 11.0 | 2.0 | 0.50 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 6.3x11 | 6.3 x 11.0 | 2.5 | 0.50 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 8x11.5 | 8.0 x 11.5 | 3.5 | 0.60 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 10x12.5 | 10.0 x 12.5 | 5.0 | 0.60 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 10x16 | 10.0 x 16.0 | 5.0 | 0.60 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 10x20 | 10.0 x 20.0 | 5.0 | 0.60 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 12.5x20 | 12.5 x 20.0 | 5.0 | 0.60 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 12.5x25 | 12.5 x 25.0 | 5.0 | 0.60 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 16x25 | 16.0 x 25.0 | 7.5 | 0.80 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 16x31.5 | 16.0 x 31.5 | 7.5 | 0.80 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 16x35.5 | 16.0 x 35.5 | 7.5 | 0.80 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| 18x35.5 | 18.0 x 35.5 | 7.5 | 0.80 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |

Other series (Panasonic EEU-FR listing sizes "5x11, 6.3x11.2, 8x11.5", Nichicon UPW "6.3x11, 8x15, 10x20") agree on D x L families within normal rounding (Panasonic lists 6.3x11.2 vs Vishay 6.3x11.0: 0.2 mm difference shown as a conflict, within tolerance). Pitch/lead for Panasonic, Nichicon and Rubycon were NOT confirmed from opened tables: the Mouser pages for FR/UPW showed only D x L; the Rubycon ZLH fetch gave lead diameters 0.5/0.6/0.8 and F tolerance +-0.5 but the first extraction listed F=5.0 for 8 mm and 7.5 for 10-12.5 mm, which conflicts with Vishay (3.5 and 5.0). A second extraction of the same PDF returned no per-diameter F. Treat ZLH per-diameter F as unreliable (L); Vishay values (also matching the brief's 2.0/2.5/3.5/5.0 series and classic 7.5 for 16-18 mm) are used. Sleeve D max = D + 0.5 (ZLH note, M). Tolerance F +-0.5 (ZLH, M).

Default D tolerance model: can = D exactly; sleeve = D + 0.2 visual (modelling choice).

**OHMNI DEFAULT member:** 10x16, F 5.0, d 0.6 (recognizable, mid-range). Derived coupling: F = 2.0 (D<=5), 2.5 (D 6.3), 3.5 (D 8), 5.0 (D 10-12.5), 7.5 (D 16-18); d = 0.5 (D<=6.3), 0.6 (D 8-12.5), 0.8 (D>=16).

### Generator notes
Parameters: D, L, F, d, lead_len, sleeve_color, stripe_color, stripe_side(+X default), vent(bool, auto for D>=6.3), bead_depth. Validate F <= D - 1.0 for all rows (5.0 vs 10; 7.5 vs 16: OK). Leads go to Z = -2.6 default.

### Sources
- Vishay, "517D ... General Purpose Miniature, Radial Lead", Document 42053, Revision 12-Jun-13. https://mouser.com/datasheet/2/427/VISHS74796_1-2566174.pdf (S3/S4; D, L, S, d table).
- Rubycon, "Miniature Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitors ZLH series". https://payda.krakow.pl/mpattachment/file/download/id/83 (S4; sleeve PET, d range 0.5-0.6-0.8, F +-0.5, L+alpha). Per-diameter F rejected as unreliable.
- Nichicon, "UPW 105C Low Impedance, High Reliability series" (Mouser catalog page). https://www.mouser.lt/catalog/645/750.pdf (S4; drawing labels: sleeve PET, safety vent, tinned CP wire, 15 min lead length, phi6.3 up).
- Panasonic, "EEU-FR FR series Type A (bulk)" Mouser catalog (2012). https://www.mouser.lt/catalog/catalogusd/645/918.pdf (S4; D x L list only).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SMD_CAN

**Generator:** GEN-SMD_CAN. Owner of OHM-030 (SMD aluminum electrolytic) and OHM-032 style A (SMD polymer/hybrid can, class C modifier).

### Shared geometry
- Aluminum cylinder (D x L) printed with a sleeve/or bare top disc, seated on a square-ish plastic (heat-resistant, black) base plate of side A (A = D + 0.3 for all opened rows, DERIVED, M) with **chamfered corners**: GAP-FILL CORRECTION: the two chamfered corners lie on the **POSITIVE terminal side (-X in OHMNI)**, not on the negative side as the first pass assumed. Evidence: the KiCad official footprint library fab outlines (S5; Nichicon 6.3x7.7, 8x10, 10x10, Cornell Dubilier 3x5.3, Vishay 1616 and 1821) all cut the two corners next to pad 1 (+) and draw the '+' glyph there; the black polarity marking on the sleeve/top is on the NEGATIVE side (+X). First-pass statement (negative side, from de facto recall; text-only Panasonic read) is superseded; the Panasonic drawing itself was not seen (M). Base plate thickness H (see table, meaning of H uncertain: Panasonic lists "H max" 1.8..3.5 which scales with D; interpreted as the terminal/base-plate height region; use visual 1.0 mm base plate thickness for LOD1, mark RESEARCH_REQUIRED).
- Two flat terminals exit under the base plate along X and fold up against... (gull/flat J-bend under base plate): terminal width W (0.65 for D<=8x6.2, 0.90 for D>=8x10.2), outer-to-outer extent B along X, inner gap P along X (P interpreted as gap between terminals, validated by B and A: terminal length = (B-P)/2 e.g. 6.3 mm: 2.9 mm, extends 0.6 beyond base plate side). K (0.35 +-0.2, or 0.70 +-0.20 for F/G) is the terminal bend/lead-standoff-like dimension (meaning not stated in the extract; RESEARCH_REQUIRED).
- Polarity: a black half-circle/segment (negative polarity mark) printed on the top disc at the negative side, with "-" signs on the sleeve band; base plate chamfers on the same side.
- Vent: Panasonic notes "Pressure Relief (phi10 and larger)"; larger sizes show a K-score on the top disc (de facto), smaller sizes use a rubber-seal vent not visible externally.

### Member dimension table (source: Panasonic FK series Type V, Mouser-hosted, (c) 2012; fetch-tool summary)

| B | 4.0 | 5.8 | 4.3 | 5.5 | 0.65 +-0.1 | 1.0 | 1.8 | 0.35 | MFR_DATASHEET / M |
| C | 5.0 | 5.8 | 5.3 | 6.5 | 0.65 | 1.5 | 2.2 | 0.35 | M |
| D | 6.3 | 5.8 | 6.6 | 7.8 | 0.65 | 1.8 | 2.6 | 0.35 | M |
| D8 | 6.3 | 7.7 | 6.6 | 7.8 | 0.65 | 1.8 | 2.6 | 0.35 | M |
| E | 8.0 | 6.2 | 8.3 | 9.5 | 0.65 | 2.2 | 3.4 | 0.35 | M |
| F | 8.0 | 10.2 | 8.3 | 10.0 | 0.90 +-0.2 | 3.1 | 3.4 | 0.70 | M |

| 12.5x13.5 | 12.5 | 13.5 | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | | | | | L (RS listing: dia 12.5, height 13.5, length 15 mm, Panasonic part 1084783) |
| 16x16.5, 18x16.5 | | | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | | | | | | not opened |

**Gap-fill: base plate size and chamfer from KiCad library fab outlines (S5, opened raw .kicad_mod files in Capacitor_SMD.pretty; vendor named in each descr; land patterns are NOT the part's terminals).**

| KiCad footprint (vendor in descr) | Base plate side (square) | A - D | Chamfer (45 deg leg, on the + / -X side) | Land centers x | Land size |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CP_Elec_3x5.3 (Cornell Dubilier) | 3.3 | 0.3 | 0.825 (=A/4) | +/-1.5 | 2.2 x 1.6 |
| CP_Elec_6.3x7.7 (Nichicon) | 6.6 | 0.3 | 1.0 | +/-2.7 | 3.5 x 1.6 |
| CP_Elec_8x10 (Nichicon) | 8.3 | 0.3 | 1.0 | +/-3.25 | 3.5 x 2.5 |
| CP_Elec_10x10 (Nichicon) | 10.3 | 0.3 | 1.0 | +/-4.0 | 4.0 x 2.5 |
| CP_Elec_16x17.5 (Vishay 1616) | 16.6 | 0.6 | 1.0 | +/-6.25 | 7.8 x 9.6 |
| CP_Elec_18x22 (Vishay 1821) | 19.0 | 1.0 | 1.0 | +/-6.75 | 8.8 x 9.6 |

Findings: (1) A = D + 0.3 holds for D <= 10 and is confirmed by Panasonic (4.3/5.3/6.6/8.3/10.3) AND these KiCad outlines (3.3, 6.6, 8.3, 10.3); for 16 and 18 mm the base plate is larger (16.6, 19.0), so the rule A = D + 0.3 is NOT valid above 10 mm. (2) Chamfer leg 1.0 for D >= 6.3, 0.825 for D = 3. (3) Land gap cross-check of Panasonic 'P' as the terminal gap: 6.3: land inner gap 2*2.7 - 3.5 = 1.9 vs Panasonic 1.8; 8x10: 6.5 - 3.5 = 3.0 vs Panasonic F 3.1: consistent. (4) 12.5 mm: KiCad files 12.5x13.5 and 12.5x13.4 returned 404; 12.5 base plate NOT obtained (interpolate A about D + 0.6 = 13.1 only as a flagged placeholder, L). (5) 9 mm diameter: no document found with a 9 mm SMD can (not a standard size in any opened document; flagged as not found rather than invented). (6) Column letters: a second read of the same Panasonic page (mouser.lt 866.pdf) reproduced identical numbers but with header letters shifted (I = 0.65/0.90, W = 1.0..4.6, P = 0.35/0.70, K blank, H max 1.8..3.5 as before). The numeric triple per row is identical to the first pass; only the letters differ, so the extraction does not reliably carry column headers. OHMNI keeps the geometry-checked reading (0.65 = terminal width, 1.0..4.6 = inner terminal gap, validated above) and still treats H (1.8 to 3.5) and the 0.35/0.70 column as UNRESOLVED (candidates: terminal tab height region / terminal thickness-stand-off); they are not used in geometry.

Cross-checks and conflicts: Panasonic FK 2020 datasheet (chipdip DOC012282467, dated 13-Mar-20) confirmed the same codes D, D8, E, F, G exist; EEE-FK1C471GP listed as 8 x 10.2 on Future Electronics (consistent with code F). Panasonic L = 5.8 for 4-6.3 mm differs from the 5.4 mm height used by some other vendors' 4x5.4/5x5.4/6.3x5.4 families; those vendors were not opened, so cross-vendor equivalence is NOT established (do not mix). 3 mm and 9 mm diameters are absent from the opened document. Nichicon/Rubycon SMD tables: search returned only part listings, nothing opened: RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

Nichicon/Rubycon/Panasonic manufacturer tables for 3, 12.5, 16 and 18 mm were not obtained (Nichicon e-uwt.pdf 404; no further search budget); those sizes rest on KiCad outlines (M-L).

**OHMNI DEFAULT member:** 6.3 x 7.7 (code D8). Alternative default for polymer (OHM-032): 6.3 x 7.7 with grey/blue sleeve parameter (see OHM-032).

### Generator notes
Parameters: D, L, A (=D+0.3 for D <= 10; 16.6 for D 16; 19.0 for D 18), B, P, W, H, vent_score(bool D>=10), polarity_mark, chamfer side = positive terminal (-X). Pin 1 (+) at (-(P+B)/4, 0), pin 2 (-) at (+(P+B)/4, 0) (DERIVED: terminal underside spans |x| in [P/2, B/2]). Body offset 0. Body bottom at Z = 0 (terminals under base plate; base plate rests at Z = 0 + tiny standoff 0; ignore K for LOD0/1).

### Sources
- Gap-fill (S5, opened): KiCad Capacitor_SMD.pretty CP_Elec_3x5.3, 6.3x7.7, 8x10, 10x10, 16x17.5, 18x22 .kicad_mod, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KiCad/kicad-footprints/master/Capacitor_SMD.pretty/ (base plate side, chamfer, + side). Panasonic page https://www.mouser.lt/catalog/catalogusd/645/866.pdf re-read: same numbers, shifted letters.
- Panasonic, "SMD Aluminum Electrolytics, FK Series, Type V" (Mouser catalog (c) 2012). https://www.mouser.lt/catalog/catalogusd/645/866.pdf (S4; table B..G).
- Panasonic, "Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitors (SMD Type)" 13-Mar-20. https://static.chipdip.ru/lib/282/DOC012282467.pdf (S4; code list, "Pressure Relief (phi10 and larger)").

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-TANT_MOLDED

**Generator:** GEN-TANT_MOLDED. Owner of OHM-033..036.

### Shared geometry
Rectangular black epoxy molded body L x W x H (slight mold draft, optional). Two **flat wrap-around terminals** (lead frame): each terminal leaves the end face of the body, wraps down the end and **folds under the body** to form a flat contact of length S and width F (KEMET labels: F = terminal width, S = terminal length). Anode (+) end has a **polarity stripe** and a **bevel (chamfer) on the top edge**, both at the + end (KEMET table shows "Polarity Stripe (+)" and "Polarity Bevel (+)"). Terminals are "symmetrical, compliant" (KEMET).

### Dimension table (KEMET T491, Document T2005_T491, 3/22/2013; EIA codes shown in the same table; read via fetch summary from Farnell and LCSC-hosted copies)
| Case | EIA | L | W | H | F term. width | S term. underside length | A (min) | G (ref) | E (ref) | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3216-18 | 3.2 +-0.2 | 1.6 +-0.2 | 1.6 +-0.2 | 1.2 | 0.8 (+-0.3) | 1.4 | 1.1 | 1.3 | |
| B | 3528-21 | 3.5 +-0.2 | 2.8 +-0.2 | 1.9 +-0.2 | 2.2 | 0.8 | 1.1 | 1.8 | 2.2 | |
| C | 6032-28 | 6.0 +-0.3 | 3.2 +-0.3 | 2.5 +-0.3 | 2.2 | 1.3 | 3.1 | 2.8 | 2.4 | |
| D | 7343-31 | 7.3 +-0.3 | 4.3 +-0.3 | 2.8 +-0.3 | 2.4 | 1.3 | 3.8 | 3.5 | 3.5 | |
Other columns: B (ref) 0.4/0.4/0.5/0.5, X (ref) 0.10 +-0.10, P (ref) 0.4/0.5/0.9/0.9, R (ref) 0.4/1.0/1.0/1.0, T (ref) 0.13 for all; meanings of B, X, P, R, T not established from the extract (X plausibly body-to-board gap; do not use for geometry beyond optional standoff 0.1). F +-0.1, S +-0.3, "Metric will govern".

Conflict/derivation: EIA suffix (-18, -21, -28, -31 in 0.1 mm) equals the KEMET max height (nominal + tolerance: 1.6+0.2, 1.9+0.2, 2.5+0.3, 2.8+0.3) i.e. the EIA code encodes max height. OHMNI uses the **nominal** KEMET H as default and max as max. Basis STANDARD is not claimed: the EIA-535 text itself was NOT opened, only KEMET's table showing EIA codes (manufacturer-reproduced, M). Other manufacturers (AVX/Vishay) not opened; KEMET T491 is dated 2013 (confirm for current series).

### Generator notes
Terminal contact centers at x = +-(L/2 - S/2) (DERIVED), width F along Y, thickness ~0.13 (T ref, uncertain). Body bottom at Z = 0 (+ optional 0.1 standoff). Pin 1 (+) at (-(L/2 - S/2), 0). ## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-DISC_CAP

**Generator:** GEN-RADIAL_FILM. Owner of OHM-028. Status: PARTIAL.

### Shared geometry
Flat ceramic disc (diameter D, thickness T) fully dip-coated in resin/epoxy (flame-retardant epoxy in accordance with UL 94 V-0, Vishay 561R/562R) forming a rounded "droplet" outline slightly taller than the disc: coated body width = D + coating, thickness T. Two round straight tinned leads leave the bottom of the droplet at lead spacing S on X. Leads may be **offset** ("lead offset 0.050 in (1.3 mm) nominal", Vishay: indicates the disc center is offset in height relative to the lead axis, i.e. vertical lift off the board).

### Data (all that could be established)
- Vishay 561R/562R (rev 22-Jun-09): D 0.250 to 0.560 in (6.4 to 14.2 mm), T 0.156 in (4.0 mm) for listed values, lead spacing 0.250 in (6.4) or 0.375 in (9.5), wire AWG24 (0.51 mm) or AWG22 (0.64 mm), silver-plated disc electrodes, lead offset 1.3 mm.
- Murata DE1 (part DE1E3KX102MN4AN01F, 250 VAC class): diameter 7 mm, "length 10 mm", lead spacing 10 mm (Future Electronics listing; Murata datasheet link returned HTTP 403, not opened). The meaning of "10 mm length" (body height vs lead spacing) is unresolved.
- Common general-purpose pitch 5.0 mm: NOT confirmed by an opened document (RESEARCH_REQUIRED).
- Body height above the seating plane (disc stand-off by kinked leads) NOT established: RESEARCH_REQUIRED.
### Gap-fill data (opened this pass)
- **Vishay 561R/562R re-read:** T max 0.125 in (3 mm) is stated for the drawing ("T max"), while the 0.156 in (4.0 mm) in the first pass was read from the size table: conflict, 3.0 to 4.0 (L-M). Lead length "1.250 in (32 mm) min", lead offset 0.050 in (1.3 mm) nominal for 1000 VDC, lead spacing 0.250 (6.35) or 0.375 (9.5), wire AWG 24 (0.51) or AWG 22 (0.64), leads tinned copper or tinned copper-clad steel, no coating color stated.
- **Vishay VY2 series (Y2 safety disc; vishay.com/docs/28535/vy2series.pdf, opened):** D max 7.5 to 16.0, T max 5.0 to 7.5 (by capacitance), lead dia 0.6 +/-0.05, lead spacing F 5.0, 7.5, 10.0 or 12.5 (+/-1), lead length 30 +/-5, drawing letters Dmax, Tmax, F, d, e, SH (coating extension and stand-off height; values not given in the read), epoxy resin coating, flame retardant, UL 94 V-0, tape H0 16 (kinked) or 20 (straight). This confirms 5.0 mm is a standard lead spacing for disc capacitors (resolving the first-pass RESEARCH_REQUIRED on 5.0) and that the family covers 5.0, 7.5, 10.0, 12.5.
- **Murata DE1E3KX102MN4AN01F (Future Electronics listing, re-read):** 'DE1 Series O 7 x 10 mm', 250 VAC, 1000 pF; diameter 7, 'length/height' 10, lead spacing 10 (listing only; the first-pass ambiguity between 10 mm height and 10 mm spacing remains because both are 10; the 'O 7 x 10 mm' phrase supports diameter x height).
- **KiCad Capacitor_THT footprints (S5, opened):** C_Disc_D7.0mm_W2.5mm_P5.00mm: pads (0,0) and (5,0), pad 1.6, drill 0.8, body 7 x 2.5 (diameter x width/thickness), its descr cites the Reichelt KERKO TC datasheet (cdn-reichelt.de DS_KERKO_TC.pdf, fetched but unreadable); C_Disc_D7.5mm_W5.0mm_P7.50mm: pads (0,0), (7.5,0), pad 2.0, drill 1.0, body 7.5 x 5.0, descr cites vishay.com/docs/28535/vy2series.pdf (opened above and consistent: D max 7.5, T max 5.0, F 7.5). So general-purpose small discs are thin (W 2.5) at 5.0 pitch, and safety discs thick (W 5.0) at 7.5 to 10 pitch.
- Unresolved: the Vishay K-series/TDK/Murata general-purpose disc size tables (TDK CC45 URL 403, Murata datasheet link 403 earlier, no search budget left), stand-off height SH, coating colors.

**OHMNI DEFAULT (revised):** general-purpose disc D 7.0, T 2.5, pitch 5.0, lead d 0.6, standoff 1.0 (L; SH value not read), height = D + coating allowance + standoff (placeholder 7.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 = 9.0, L). Safety/high-voltage variants use D 7.5 to 16, T 5.0 to 7.5, pitch 7.5 to 12.5 (Vishay VY2) or D 6.4 to 14.2, pitch 6.35/9.5 (561R).

# [OHM-029] Radial Electrolytic Capacitor
## Identity
Canonical: Radial electrolytic capacitor. ID OHM-029, slug cap_elec_radial. Category passive / capacitor (aluminum electrolytic). Package: PKG-RADIAL_CAN (GEN-RADIAL_CAN), default member 10x16. Mounting THT. Aliases: radial can, radial lead electrolytic, lytic. Class B, priority P0, complexity 3.

## Physical Dimensions
Member row (default 10x16): D 10.0, L 16.0, F 5.0, d 0.6 (Vishay 517D, M). Sleeve D max = D+0.5; height max = L + alpha (1.5 for L<=16, 2.0 for L>=20). Full table in PKG-RADIAL_CAN (5x11 F2.0 d0.5; 6.3x11 F2.5 d0.5; 8x11.5 F3.5 d0.6; 10x12.5/16/20 F5.0 d0.6; 12.5x20/25 F5.0 d0.6; 16x25/31.5/35.5 and 18x35.5/40 F7.5 d0.8).

## Geometry
Upright cylinder, axis +Z, bottom on board. Sleeve (PET) covers side, rolls ~1 mm over the top edge. Top: aluminum disc with vent score (D>=6.3). Bottom: black rubber seal; groove bead 1-2 mm above bottom (visual 0.4 mm deep). Stripe band on the negative side (+X).

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 round tinned leads, diameter d (0.5/0.6/0.8 by D), at (-F/2, 0) and (+F/2, 0), exit the seal vertically. Tails to Z=-2.6 default (bulk lead length 15 mm min is trimmed). Lead 1 = + at -X, lead 2 = - at +X (OHMNI convention; negative lead shorter on untrimmed parts, visual only). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Numbering 1 (+), 2 (-).

## PCB Interface
Holes: d + 0.3 to 0.4 typical (footprint, not researched). FCO origin at the lead-pair midpoint = can center; body_offset (0,0). Pin 1 (+) at (-F/2, 0). Standoff 0.

## Materials
Sleeve MAT_PVC_SLEEVE_BLACK (default; blue, green, red, dark purple by series), can top MAT_ALUMINUM_CAN, seal MAT_RUBBER_SEAL (new), leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, stripe/text MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE.

## Appearance
Sleeve color by maker/series (Panasonic FR is dark with gold or white print; Nichicon UPW/others blue/black; not verified from opened docs: visual default only). Print: value, voltage, brand, series, negative band with minus signs. Geometry vs decal: stripe may be geometry-free decal.

## Orientation Markings
Negative stripe band on +X side, full sleeve height, light color with '-' marks; top vent score. Longer lead = positive on new parts.

## Recognition Features
1) Cylindrical can, height > diameter in most rows. 2) Contrasting negative stripe. 3) Two thin leads at the correct pitch. 4) Vent score on top (D>=6.3). 5) Seal bead groove. 6) Sleeve overlapping top rim.

## Parametric Variants
D, L, F, d, sleeve_color, stripe_side, lead_len, vent. Coupled: F and d from D (Vishay table); L selects alpha; vent auto for D>=6.3; F <= D-1.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (can) + slightly larger thin cylindrical shell (sleeve, over-lap ring), disc top, bottom ring (seal), two cylinders (leads), thin arc-strip (stripe).

## Modeling Procedure
1 Pick member row. 2 Can cylinder D x L at Z=0..L. 3 Sleeve shell, over-lap ring 1 mm at top. 4 Seal disc at bottom, groove ring at Z~1.5. 5 Vent score lines on top. 6 Leads at +-F/2 from Z=-tail to Z=0. 7 Stripe on +X side. 8 Apply decals.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: cylinder + two lead stubs (no tails). LOD1: cylinder, sleeve over-lap step, top disc with vent score (D>=6.3), seal bead, stripe decal, both leads to tail. LOD2: add crimp groove profile, seal recess, rounded top edge, lead taper, sleeve seam.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: groove bead, seal recess, vent score at LOD0, lead tails at LOD0. Never omit: negative stripe/polarity side, correct F, D and L, two leads.

# [OHM-030] SMD Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitor
## Identity
Canonical: SMD aluminum electrolytic capacitor. ID OHM-030, slug cap_elec_smd. Category passive / capacitor. Package PKG-SMD_CAN (GEN-SMD_CAN), default member D8 (6.3 x 7.7, Panasonic code). Mounting SMD. Aliases: SMD can, chip electrolytic, V-chip. Class A (per manifest), P0, complexity 3.

## Physical Dimensions
Default D8: D 6.3, L 7.7, A (base plate) 6.6, B (over terminals) 7.8, W 0.65, P (inner gap) 1.8, H max 2.6 (Panasonic FK Type V, M). Table in PKG-SMD_CAN: B(4x5.8) C(5x5.8) D(6.3x5.8) D8 E(8x6.2) F(8x10.2) G(10x10.2).

## Geometry
Cylinder D x L on a square black plastic base plate of side A with the two chamfered corners (leg 1.0 for D>=6.3) on the POSITIVE side (-X; gap-fill correction of the first-pass negative-side assumption, KiCad outlines), plate thickness ~1.0 (visual; meaning of H unresolved). Top disc with black polarity half-segment on the negative side (+X) and score vent for D>=10. Two flat terminals under the plate along X.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 flat tin terminals width W; underside spans |x| from P/2 to B/2 (DERIVED); they run out from under the plate and form the visible bent contact. Pin 1 (+) at (-(P+B)/4, 0) = (-2.4, 0); pin 2 (-) at (+2.4, 0) for default. Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Thickness ~0.2 (L, UNCERTAIN).

## PCB Interface
Pads from footprint (not researched). FCO origin at terminal center = can center. body_offset (0,0). Standoff 0 (K 0.35 dimension meaning unresolved).

## Materials
Can/sleeve MAT_ALUMINUM_CAN or MAT_PVC_SLEEVE_BLACK for printed side; base plate MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK; terminals MAT_TIN_BRIGHT; top segment MAT_EPOXY_BLACK.

## Appearance
Top disc silver/aluminum with black half-circle on the negative side; sleeve black (Panasonic) with white print or gold; markings by decal.

## Orientation Markings
Negative side (+X): black top segment and '-' band on the sleeve. Positive side (-X): chamfered base-plate corners (6 KiCad fab outlines from Nichicon/CDE/Vishay agree; Panasonic drawing not seen: M).

## Recognition Features
1) Cylinder on square base plate. 2) Chamfered plate corners. 3) Black polarity segment on top. 4) Flat terminals extending beyond the plate. 5) Vent score (>=10 mm).

## Parametric Variants
D, L, A=D+0.3, B, P, W, polymer flag (OHM-032), vent. Coupled: A,B,P,W from the size code table; terminal outer extent B/2.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder; extruded square with chamfered corners; two bent strips; half-disc decal/inlay on top.

## Modeling Procedure
1 Select size row. 2 Base plate A x A x 1.0 with chamfers 1.0 (0.825 for D=3) at the two corners on the positive (-X) side. 3 Can cylinder over plate. 4 Terminals as flat strips on Z=0 spanning P/2..B/2, with 0.3 up-bend at outer end. 5 Top polarity segment. 6 Vent score if D>=10.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: cylinder + base block + two pads. LOD1: chamfered plate, terminals, polarity segment decal, vent. LOD2: terminal bend radii, crimp groove, sleeve seam, rubber seal ring.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: groove, vent at LOD0, bend radii. Never omit: polarity side, plate chamfers, terminals extending beyond plate, A/B/P ratios.

# [OHM-031] Snap-in Electrolytic Capacitor
## Identity
Canonical: Snap-in electrolytic capacitor. ID OHM-031, slug cap_elec_snapin. Category passive / capacitor. Package PKG-SNAPIN_CAN, default member 25x40 2-pin. Mounting THT. Aliases: snap-in, large can electrolytic. Class A, P2, complexity 3.

## Physical Dimensions
Default: D 25 (max 26), L 40 (max 42), terminal pitch 10.0 +-0.1, mounting hole 2.0. Range D 22/25/30/35, L 25-60 (Vishay 157 PUM-SI, M). Plastic seat disc thickness ~2 (visual, L, UNCERTAIN) is inside the L+2 allowance.

## Geometry
Tall cylinder with blue PET sleeve, flat top with vent score, black plastic seat disc at bottom, 2 or 3 stiff terminals through the seat. Sleeve overlaps the top edge and ends ~1.5 mm above seat.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2-pin: pins at (-5,0) (+) and (+5,0) (-), hole Ø2.0, protrusion 4 +-0.5 below seat (3-term drawing), cross-section 2.0 round/flat (RESEARCH_REQUIRED; use round Ø1.5 visual). 3-pin: one + pin Ø2.5 hole and two electrically connected - pins; third hole at 3.3 / 4.75 offsets (geometry unresolved; placeholder: third pin omitted at LOD0, at 3.3 mm from the - pin toward center at LOD1 marked UNCERTAIN). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT/MAT_NICKEL.

## PCB Interface
Holes Ø2.0 (2-pin) at 10.0 pitch. FCO at pin midpoint = can center, body_offset (0,0). Body bottom at Z=0 (seat). Pins protrude 4 +-0.5 mm below the seat (3-pin drawing), so tails go to Z=-4.0 (this overrides the -2.6 default, which would not allow the snap-in latch).

## Materials
Sleeve MAT_PVC_SLEEVE_BLUE, seat MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK, can top MAT_ALUMINUM_CAN, terminals MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.

## Appearance
Blue sleeve (Vishay features), white print, '-' sign band or black dot at the negative pin side. Other makers use black/gold sleeves (not verified).

## Orientation Markings
Minus pole marking band on the +X side (negative pin), '-' signs; 3-pin: two negative pins on the same side.

## Recognition Features
1) Big can 22-35 mm. 2) Blue sleeve. 3) Black seat disc with short pins. 4) Pin pitch 10. 5) Vent score on top. 6) Negative marking band.

## Parametric Variants
D (22/25/30/35), L, pins 2|3, sleeve color. Coupled: D max=D+1 (22->23 ...), L max=L+2.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder + sleeve shell + disc (seat) + 2-3 cylinders.

## Modeling Procedure
1 Seat disc D-1 x 2. 2 Can D x L above seat. 3 Sleeve, top overlap. 4 Top vent score. 5 Pins at +-5. 6 Negative band.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: cylinder + two pin stubs. LOD1: sleeve, seat, pins, vent, band. LOD2: sleeve seam, crimp groove, seat ribs.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: seat ribs, groove. Never omit: seat disc gap, pin pitch, negative marking, D and L.

# [OHM-032] Polymer Electrolytic Capacitor
## Identity
Canonical: Polymer electrolytic capacitor. ID OHM-032, slug cap_polymer. Category passive / capacitor (aluminum polymer / hybrid). **Two physical styles exist**: Style A SMD can (OS-CON/hybrid SMD, same outline as OHM-030, via PKG-SMD_CAN) and Style B radial through-hole can (Panasonic OS-CON SEPF, via PKG-RADIAL_CAN). **OHMNI DEFAULT: Style A (SMD can)**, because the manifest family is PKG-SMD_CAN and mounting 'mixed'. Aliases: OS-CON, SP-Cap (molded chip, a different shape, NOT this entry), hybrid. Class C, P1, complexity 3. Note: POSCAP/SP-Cap are molded chip polymer parts (tantalum-polymer/aluminum-polymer) in rectangular packages, handled as PKG-TANT_MOLDED-like boxes elsewhere, not here (their dimension tables were not opened).

## Physical Dimensions
Style A default: same as OHM-030 D8: D 6.3, L 7.7, A 6.6, B 7.8, P 1.8, W 0.65 (Panasonic FK dimensions used as a proxy; hybrid EEH-ZA/ZC/ZK dimensions NOT opened: L confidence). Style B: SEPF 20SEPF120M: D 6.3, height 6, lead pitch 2.5 (RS listing, M-L). Gap-fill, opened: Panasonic SEPF datasheet (docs.rs-online.com/f98b/0900766b814d75e3.pdf): letters fD (diameter 6.3 to 10.0), L max (5.5 to 13.0), F (lead spacing 2.5 to 5.0, +/-0.5), fd (lead diameter 0.45 to 0.6, +/-0.05); example row E7: fD 8.0, L max 7.0, F 3.5, fd 0.5; so the 6.3 x 6 member has F 2.5 and fd about 0.5 (row not individually read, L-M). Panasonic OS-CON sell sheet (mouser.com/pdfDocs/OS-CON_sellsheet.pdf, opened) lists OS-CON outlines (D x L, mm; SVP and SVPF being the SMD types is general knowledge, not stated in the read): SVP C6 6.3 x 7.9, A5 8.0 x 6.9, B6 8.0 x 11.9, E12 5.0 x 5.9, E7 4.0 x 5.4 (as read), and SVPF F8 10.0 x 7.9, F10 10.0 x 10.0, F12 10.0 x 12.6. Panasonic hybrid sell sheet (mouser.com/pdfDocs/HybridcapacitorSellSheet.pdf, opened) lists only D x height classes (5x6 to 10x10, 8x10 to 10x10.2, 10x12.5, 10x16.5) and no SMD case codes or base-plate data. Style A default revised: OS-CON SVP C6 outline 6.3 x 7.9 (M-L, one document; L max includes tolerance; base plate A 6.6, B 7.8, P 1.8, W 0.65 still the FK 6.3 row proxy because no OS-CON base-plate data was opened).

## Geometry
Style A: SMD can with base plate as OHM-030, usually a polarity mark bar and often a colored (silver or gold/grey) sleeve or bare can. Style B: short radial can, flat height ~ D, rubber seal replaced by epoxy/rubber seat, two leads at 2.5.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Style A: as OHM-030 (pin 1 + at -X (-2.4,0), pin 2 - at +2.4). Style B: two leads d 0.5 (UNCERTAIN, assumed from D 6.3 row), pin 1 + at (-1.25, 0), pin 2 - at (+1.25, 0).

## PCB Interface
Style A: smd_pads, FCO at terminal center. Style B: tht holes at 2.5 pitch, FCO at lead midpoint. body_offset (0,0).

## Materials
Can/sleeve MAT_ALUMINUM_CAN with MAT_PVC_SLEEVE_BLACK/_BLUE option, base MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK, terminals MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.

## Appearance
Typical polymer cans are bare/printed silver or dark with a polarity bar; exact color per series not verified (visual default MAT_PVC_SLEEVE_BLACK for style A, silver-gold for B).

## Orientation Markings
Negative side +X: marking bar/segment (A), stripe (B). Gap-fill: Panasonic SEPF datasheet shows 'Polarity marking (-)', i.e. the NEGATIVE side is marked (resolves the first-pass doubt for the radial OS-CON; one document, M-L). For SMD polymer/hybrid cans the same shape as OHM-030 applies: chamfered base-plate corners on the + (-X) side (KiCad outlines, see PKG-SMD_CAN). Other makers' polymer chips mark the positive end (molded SP-Cap/POSCAP, not this entry). OHMNI default: negative mark at +X.

## Recognition Features
1) Small SMD can or short radial can. 2) Polarity mark. 3) Base plate (A). 4) No vent score visible on small sizes. 5) Terminals beyond plate (A).

## Parametric Variants
style (A|B), D, L, sleeve_color, polarity_bar_side. Coupled: style A rows from PKG-SMD_CAN; style B from SEPF row (6.3x6, pitch 2.5).

## Recommended Base Geometry
Style A: as OHM-030. Style B: cylinder + two leads + thin ring.

## Modeling Procedure
1 Choose style. 2 Build via PKG-SMD_CAN (A) or PKG-RADIAL_CAN (B) with polymer flag (color/marking only, no new geometry).

## LOD Strategy
As OHM-030 (style A) or OHM-029 (style B).

## Simplification Rules
May omit what OHM-030/029 may omit. Never omit: style-specific terminals, polarity mark.

# [OHM-033] Tantalum Capacitor A-Case
## Identity
Canonical: Tantalum capacitor A-case. ID OHM-033, slug cap_tant_a. Category passive / capacitor (tantalum MnO2/polymer molded). Package PKG-TANT_MOLDED, member A (EIA 3216-18; metric code is the EIA code itself, L x W in 0.1 mm = 3216). Mounting SMD. Aliases: chip tantalum, EIA 3216-18, case A. Class B, P1, complexity 2. Note: EIA 3216 chip naming collides with the 1206 chip-resistor/MLCC size (3.2 x 1.6) etc.: the tantalum EIA code is a different parts family; do not confuse.

## Physical Dimensions
Member row (KEMET T491, M): L 3.2 +-0.2, W 1.6 +-0.2, H 1.6 +-0.2 (max 1.8; EIA suffix 18 = 1.8 mm, DERIVED match), terminal width F 1.2, terminal underside length S 0.8 +-0.3. See PKG-TANT_MOLDED for the other columns.

## Geometry
Rectangular molded body, black epoxy, with slight mold draft (visual 3 deg, LOD2 only). Bevel (chamfer) across the top edge at the + end and a polarity stripe on the top face at the + end. Terminals wrap from the end faces under the body.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 flat terminals, width F = 1.2 (along Y), underside contact length S = 0.8 (along X), thickness ~0.13 (T ref, uncertain), wrap up the end face (visible vertical strip). Centers of the underside contacts at x = +-1.2. Pin 1 (anode +) at (-1.2, 0), pin 2 (cathode -) at (1.2, 0). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (matte tin by KEMET 100% matte tin; gold optional).

## PCB Interface
SMD pads from the footprint (not researched). FCO origin = body center = pad-pattern center. Body bottom at Z=0 (optional standoff <= 0.1: KEMET X 0.10 +-0.10, meaning unverified). body_offset (0,0).

## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK (stripe MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE or light gray on anode end; some makers use orange/yellow bodies, not modeled), terminals MAT_TIN_MATTE.

## Appearance
Black (KEMET T491 molded case) with a polarity stripe/bevel at + end; printed value code and voltage code on top (decals). Some makers produce orange or beige bodies: not verified.

## Orientation Markings
Stripe + bevel on the top at the -X end (anode, pin 1). EDA footprints differ: some mark the cathode instead; the marking on tantalum is the ANODE (+). KEMET table: 'Polarity Stripe (+)' and 'Polarity Bevel (+)'.

## Recognition Features
1) Rectangular black block. 2) Anode stripe + bevel at one end. 3) Terminals visible wrapping the ends. 4) Correct case proportion L:W:H.

## Parametric Variants
Case (A-D), stripe_end, terminal_finish. Coupled: L, W, H, F, S by case; stripe at the end of pin 1.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box (body) with a corner-edge chamfer, two L-shaped thin strips (end face + underside), thin box for stripe.

## Modeling Procedure
1 Box L x W x H at Z=0. 2 Chamfer top edge of -X end 0.4. 3 End strips: width F, height H*0.6 on each end face, thickness 0.13. 4 Underside strips x in [+-(0.8),+-1.6], width F. 5 Stripe decal at -X end. 6 Value code decal.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + two end blocks. LOD1: bevel, stripe, L-terminals. LOD2: mold draft, terminal bend radius, top mold marking, standoff gap.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: draft, terminal radius, text. Never omit: anode stripe/bevel and which end it is on, terminals under the body, correct case size.

# [OHM-037] Film Box Capacitor
## Identity
Canonical: Film box capacitor. ID OHM-037, slug cap_film_box. Category passive / capacitor (metallized film, polyester/PP). Package PKG-FILM_BOX, default pitch 10.0. Mounting THT. Aliases: MKT, MKS, MKP, metallized film box, WIMA box. Class A, P2, complexity 2.

## Physical Dimensions
OHMNI default (inside WIMA MKS2 ranges): pitch 10.0, L 13.0, W 5.0, H 11.0, lead d 0.5. Ranges per pitch in PKG-FILM_BOX (pitch 5: L 7.2, W 2.5-11, H 6.5-16; 7.5: L 10; 10: L 13-13.5; 15: L 18-19 (Vishay 17.5); 22.5: L 26.5-28; 27.5: L 31.5-33). Basis CONSENSUS (WIMA MKS2, MKP-X2; Vishay MKP338 within +-1.5 on L).

## Geometry
Rectangular box with square-ish corners (small edge radius ~0.3 visual), flat top, resin-sealed bottom face slightly recessed, optional stand-off nubs (0.5 visual, unverified).

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 straight round leads, diameter 0.5 (0.4-1.0 by pitch), at (-P/2,0), (+P/2,0), exit the bottom through the resin; tails Z=-2.6 default; lead length 6 (L). Non-polarized: pin 1 at -X by convention.

## PCB Interface
Holes d+0.3 typical. FCO at the lead midpoint = body center in X; body centered on Y (body_offset 0,0). Standoff 0.5 visual (UNCERTAIN) or 0.

## Materials
Case MAT_FILM_CASE_RED (new; WIMA X2 red) or _YELLOW/_BLUE parameter, leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, print MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE (black print on red per WIMA).

## Appearance
Colored case (red typical for WIMA MKP-X2; MKS2/other colors not verified), printed manufacturer, series, value, voltage; resin face darker.

## Orientation Markings
None (non-polarized). Some PP/polyester parts have an outer-foil band marking: not modeled.

## Recognition Features
1) Rectangular box standing upright. 2) Two straight leads at pitch. 3) Resin bottom face. 4) Colored case with print.

## Parametric Variants
pitch (5/7.5/10/15/22.5/27.5), W, H, color. Coupled: L = pitch + 3 to 4 per table; d by pitch (0.4-0.5 for <=10, 0.6 for 15, 0.8 for 22.5-27.5); W and H within pitch range.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box with edge fillets + two cylinders + thin recessed plate for resin face.

## Modeling Procedure
1 Pick pitch, W, H, L. 2 Box centered on origin in X,Y, Z from standoff to standoff+H. 3 Resin face plate on bottom. 4 Leads at +-P/2 down to tails. 5 Decals.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + two leads. LOD1: edge radii, resin face, stand-off nubs, print decals. LOD2: lead taper at body exit, seam line, molded text relief.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: radii, nubs, seam. Never omit: pitch accuracy, lead pair, body proportions, color family.

OHMNI default (inside ranges): pitch 15.0, L 18.0, W 8.0, H 14.0, d 0.6. Ranges: WIMA MKP-X2 pitch 10: W 4-8, H 8.5-12.5, L 13-13.5; 15: W 5-11, H 11-18, L 18-19, d 0.5-0.8; 22.5: W 5-11, H 14-24, L 26.5-28, d 0.8; 27.5: W 9-20, H 19-39.5, L 31.5-33; 37.5: W 9-31, H 19-50, L 41.5. Vishay MKP338 4: 15: W 5-10, H 11-16.5, L 17.5; 22.5: W 7-12, H 16.5-22, L 26; 27.5: W 9-21, H 19-31, L 31; 37.5: L 42-44; 55: W 21.5, H 38.5, L 61. Conflict: L at pitch 15 18-19 (WIMA) vs 17.5 (Vishay).

## Geometry
Rectangular box with square-ish corners (small edge radius ~0.3 visual), flat top, resin-sealed bottom face slightly recessed, optional stand-off nubs (0.5 visual, unverified).

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 straight round leads, diameter 0.5 (0.4-1.0 by pitch), at (-P/2,0), (+P/2,0), exit the bottom through the resin; tails Z=-2.6 default; lead length 6 (L). Non-polarized: pin 1 at -X by convention.

## PCB Interface
Holes d+0.3 typical. FCO at the lead midpoint = body center in X; body centered on Y (body_offset 0,0). Standoff 0.5 visual (UNCERTAIN) or 0.

## Materials
Case MAT_FILM_CASE_RED, leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, print MAT_EPOXY_BLACK-like dark ink (decal).

## Appearance
WIMA MKP-X2: red case, black marking (opened datasheet). Marking includes C value, tolerance, rated voltage, X2 subclass, safety approvals logos, date code (Vishay list). Vishay body color not stated.

## Orientation Markings
None (non-polarized). Some PP/polyester parts have an outer-foil band marking: not modeled.

## Recognition Features
1) Rectangular box standing upright. 2) Two straight leads at pitch. 3) Resin bottom face. 4) Colored case with print.

## Parametric Variants
pitch (10/15/22.5/27.5/37.5/55), W, H. Same couplings as OHM-037; pitch >= 15 recommended for X2 default.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box with edge fillets + two cylinders + thin recessed plate for resin face.

## Modeling Procedure
Same as OHM-037 with X2 defaults; add approval-mark decals (not geometry).

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + two leads. LOD1: edge radii, resin face, stand-off nubs, print decals. LOD2: lead taper at body exit, seam line, molded text relief.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: radii, nubs, seam. Never omit: pitch accuracy, lead pair, body proportions, color family.

# [OHM-039] Silver Mica Capacitor
## Identity
Canonical: Silver mica capacitor. ID OHM-039, slug cap_mica. Category passive / capacitor (dipped silver mica). Package PKG-MICA, default CD15 row. Mounting THT. Aliases: dipped mica, CD15, CD19. Class A, P3, complexity 2.

## Physical Dimensions
Default (Cornell Dubilier CD15, M): L 11.4, H 9.1, T 4.3, lead spacing S 5.9, lead d 0.6. Gap-fill: these are values inside, at the low-length end of, the CD15 ranges (L 11.4 to 12.7, H 8.4 to 10.9, T 4.3 to 6.4; S 5.9 and d 0.6 are fixed for the style); the first-pass claim that they were 'the largest case' was wrong. CD19: L 16.3 to 18.3, H 12.7 to 15.2, T 4.8 to 9.4, S 8.7, d 0.8. CD10 (S 3.6, d 0.4), CD30 (S 11.1, d 1.0) and CD42 (S 27.0, d 1.0) ranges are in PKG-MICA. The coating colour is not stated in the CDE page (no opened source), visual default only.

## Geometry
Flat rounded slab (dip coating): front face L x H with rounded top corners (radius ~H/6 visual), thickness T, slightly convex faces; two leads exit the bottom face symmetric about the center.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 round leads d 0.6 (CD15) at (-S/2,0), (+S/2,0), exit the bottom edge, straight; tails default. Non-polarized; pin 1 at -X. Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (tinned; plating not verified).

## PCB Interface
Holes by footprint. FCO at lead midpoint = body center in X. Slab width along X is L; slab thickness along Y is T. Standoff 0 (dip meniscus gives a small gap, UNCERTAIN, 0.5 visual).

## Materials
Body MAT_MICA_DIP (new, color not verified), leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, print MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE or dark ink.

## Appearance
Dipped coating glossy; color varies (commonly tan/brown/red/blue); printed value/voltage/tolerance code; color not verified from any opened document.

## Orientation Markings
None (non-polarized).

## Recognition Features
1) Flat dipped slab with rounded top. 2) Two thin leads at the bottom. 3) Glossy colored coating. 4) Proportion L:H:T about 11.4:9.1:4.3.

## Parametric Variants
style (CD15/CD19/custom), L, H, T, S, d. Coupled: S < L; d by style (0.6/0.8).

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box with rounded top corners and slightly bulged faces; two cylinders.

## Modeling Procedure
1 Slab L x T x H with top radius. 2 Bulge faces 0.2. 3 Leads at +-S/2. 4 Decal.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + two leads. LOD1: rounded top, leads, decal. LOD2: face bulge, meniscus at lead exit, lead taper.

Conflict kept: Murata 7 mm disc at 10 mm spacing vs Vishay 6.4/9.5; thickness 2.5 (general purpose) vs 3 to 4 (1 kV) vs 5 to 7.5 (Y2): these are different product classes, not a measurement conflict.

Round disc with coating, outline a droplet: circle diameter D plus coating, thickness T, rounded edges; flat faces; two leads from the bottom, spacing S.

# G04 Inductors, Chokes, Transformers (OHM-044 to OHM-055)

Research notes for the group. Source-handling note: most fetches were summarised by the fetch tool (small model), and several distributor/aggregator pages (RS Components, lioncircuits, ozdisan, Farnell, jiepei, TME) were the only place a number was visible. Those values are tagged S4/S5 and given confidence M or L accordingly. Where a dimension could not be established it is marked RESEARCH_REQUIRED and the OHMNI DEFAULT is explicitly a placeholder (basis UNCERTAIN). Mechanical drawings were NOT visually inspected; only text was extracted.

Family-wide appearance note (ferrite vs resin vs paint): 
- Ceramic-core chip (PKG-SMD_IND_WW): beige/tan or white ceramic core, matte; Coilcraft 0603CS uses a single color dot on top (opened datasheet) that is not a unique identifier.
- Molded shielded (SRP style): dark gray/black molded composite, slightly matte, flat top, laser/ink mark. Color is general practice, not read from the opened datasheet.
- Semi-shielded (SRN style): ferrite drum with "magnetic epoxy resin" coating (opened datasheet says so); resin looks dark gray/black.
- Unshielded open drum: bare ferrite (MAT_FERRITE_DARK) with exposed winding, sometimes a paint/lacquer or sleeve.
- Radial drum / WE-TI: ferrite drum with winding, usually inside a heat-shrink sleeve or lacquer (WE-TI page: "heat shrinking tube version").
- Toroid: coated (epoxy/paint/lacquer) ferrite or powder core; coat color is a parameter (general practice, unverified for specific series).
- Transformers: bobbin plastic (black/natural) + ferrite core (dark gray, matte) + tape wrap.

## PROPOSED MATERIAL TOKENS (not in 00_architecture.md Section 7)
| Token | Use | Base color | Rough | Metal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MAT_CERAMIC_CORE_BEIGE | ceramic-core chip inductor body | #D9CBA8 | 0.7 | 0 |
| MAT_MOLDED_COMPOSITE_DARK | molded powder-core power inductor body | #26272A | 0.6 | 0 |
| MAT_RESIN_COAT_BLACK | epoxy/resin coat on semi-shielded drum | #1E1E20 | 0.5 | 0 |
| MAT_WIRE_ENAMEL_COPPER | visible winding | #B0602A | 0.35 | 0.6 |
| MAT_HEATSHRINK_BLACK | sleeve (also usable in other colors via param) | #17171A | 0.5 | 0 |
| MAT_COIL_COAT (param color) | toroid/axial lacquer/epoxy coating | param | 0.45 | 0 |

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SMD_POWER_IND
Generator: GEN-SMD_INDUCTOR (modes `molded`, `semi_shielded`, `drum_open`).
Shared geometry: square-ish or rectangular body L x W x H. Three construction variants:
1. `molded` (shielded, e.g. Bourns SRP7028A): body is a molded block, flat top, lead-frame terminals exiting the bottom edges at the two short ends and folded under the body (tin finish).
2. `semi_shielded` (e.g. Bourns SRN6045): ferrite drum with magnetic resin coating on top; terminals are tin-plated clips/plates at the bottom of two opposite sides.
3. `drum_open` (OHM-046, e.g. Bourns SDR0604 / Sumida CDRH style): bare ferrite drum core with visible winding, two terminals at the bottom (the datasheet lists a Ferrite DR core, enameled copper wire).
Generator notes: body footprint rounded corners r = 0.3 (DEFAULT, L), terminals as two bottom pads centered at +-pad_pitch/2. Chamfer top edges 0.2 (DEFAULT) for molded.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-AXIAL_IND
Generator: GEN-AXIAL (shared with PKG-AXIAL_RES owned by G02; I did not read G02's file, so only deltas are documented).
Deltas versus an axial resistor: the body is a molded/dipped cylinder with rounded ends (a ferrite drum core with winding inside) carrying 3-4 color bands for the value code (de facto convention, not verified in opened documents), body diameter small relative to length, leads straight axial.

| Member | Body diameter | Body length | Lead diameter | Basis | Conf |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bourns 78F (e.g. 78F100J-RC, 78F681J-RC) | 2.79 | 7.11 (ozdisan listing title "78F681J-RC INDUCTOR 680uH 2.79X7.11 AXIAL"; DERIVED cross-check: RS overall 57.91 = 7.11 + 2 x 25.4, i.e. two 1.00 in leads) | 0.51 | S4 RS + S4 ozdisan, arithmetic cross-check | M |
| OHMNI default | 2.79 | 7.11 | 0.51 | as above; lead length uncut 25.4 (DERIVED) | M |

Consistency with G02 PKG-AXIAL_RES (G02 owns the axial generator): cylinder along X, axis Z = D/2 (1.395), lead axis on the body axis, lead bends 90 deg down at X = +/-P/2 with inner radius 1.0*d, tail to Z = -2.6, uncut lead length NOT modeled. G02 pitch rule P = smallest multiple of 2.54 >= L_nom + 4d gives 7.11 + 2.04 = 9.15 -> 10.16 for 78F, matching the entry default. Band layout fractions of G02 (4-band) are reused; first band nearest terminal 1 (-X). Differences: inductors use their own color code (Bourns 78F value code not opened; de facto standard color code assumed) and body is a molded/coated dumbbell-ish cylinder.
Sources: RS https://uk.rs-online.com/web/p/leaded-inductors/8604060 (S4; ferrite DR core, axial leaded; overall 57.91) and ozdisan https://www.ozdisan.com/en/p/fixed-inductors-468/bourns-78f681j-rc-611056 (S4, opened second pass: 2.79 x 7.11 axial). Bourns 78F datasheet is on bourns.com and is robots.txt-blocked for the fetch tool; DigiKey page for 78F221J gave no dimensions. Vishay IM not opened. Vishay IM not opened.

# [OHM-044] SMD wirewound inductor
## Identity
Canonical: SMD wirewound inductor (ceramic-core chip). Package: 0603 imperial / 1608 metric, Coilcraft 0603CS representative. Aliases: ceramic chip inductor, RF chip inductor, 0603CS. Variants: 0805CS 2.29 x 1.73 x 1.52, 1008CS 2.92 x 2.79 x 2.03 (Coilcraft product pages, max values; terminal length and land pattern not extracted). Class A, priority P1, complexity 3, mounting smd. Family PKG-SMD_IND_WW member 0603CS.
## Physical Dimensions
L 1.80 max, W 1.12 max, H 1.02 max (+0.152 if solder counted). Terminal length 0.38 (DEFAULT, Coilcraft D ref, mapping unverified, L). Basis MFR_DATASHEET, confidence H for L/W/H, L for terminal length.
## Geometry
Rectangular ceramic core with square-ish profile; two wraparound end caps; winding visible between caps (general construction, wire visibility not verified). Top is flat. No chamfers at LOD1.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
2 terminals, matte tin over nickel over silver-glass frit (from datasheet). Terminal 1 at -X, terminal 2 at +X. Centers at x = +-0.71 (DERIVED: 0.90 - 0.38/2).
## PCB Interface
Land pattern values E/G etc. exist in the datasheet but their mapping was not verified: RESEARCH_REQUIRED. Underside at Z=0. Body centered on pad pattern; body_offset 0.
## Materials
Body MAT_CERAMIC_CORE_BEIGE (proposed); terminals MAT_TIN_MATTE; dot decal color varies.
## Appearance
Beige/tan to white ceramic; single color dot (red, black, yellow, blue etc.) on top marks value group, not unique (opened datasheet). OHMNI default dot color: red.
## Orientation Markings
Dot is on the top face; datasheet does not state which end. OHMNI default: dot near terminal 1 (-X). Part is non-polarized.
## Recognition Features
Beige ceramic body; two bright tin end caps; single color dot; very small chip.
## Parametric Variants
length, width, height, term_len, dot_color. Coupled: term_len < L/3.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Box + two end-cap boxes (clipped U shape) + optional dot disc decal.
## Modeling Procedure
1 Box L x W x H centered, Z from 0. 2 Add caps at each end of length term_len wrapping 4 faces (thickness 0.03 over body). 3 Add dot decal 0.2 dia on top. 4 Assign materials.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0: body box/cylinder + terminal boxes. LOD1: all terminals, top chamfers, dot/pin-1 marks as decals, winding as band. LOD2: fillets, winding turns, wire exits, lead bends.
## Simplification Rules
May omit: winding turns, dot decal at LOD0. Never omit: end caps contrast, size ratio.

# G05: Diodes (OHM-056 to OHM-072)

Group G05 research output. Owner of families PKG-DO_AXIAL, PKG-MELF, PKG-SOD, PKG-SMX, PKG-BRIDGE_DIP, PKG-BRIDGE_ROUND. OHM-070 is an instance of PKG-SOT23 (owned by G07) and documents deltas only.

## Group-wide notes (apply to every entry below)

1. **Evidence level (Section 17.7).** All sources were read through a text-extraction fetch tool, not by looking at drawings. Where a Vishay outline lists bare numbers without leader text (SMA/SMB/SMC), the assignment of numbers to features was inferred from value magnitude and from the same ordering across the three drawings; those values are capped at confidence M and the inference is stated.
2. **Polarity convention used by OHMNI for all two-terminal diodes.** Terminal 1 = CATHODE at -X, terminal 2 = ANODE at +X, cathode band/bar at the -X end of the body. This matches the common KiCad-style diode footprint convention (pin 1 = K), which is stated from general EDA practice and was NOT verified in an opened document. EDA libraries differ (some use anode = pin 1, for example Eagle/Orcad-style "A,C"); the importer must map by net/function, not by number. The physical rule (cathode = band end) IS confirmed by opened manufacturer documents (cited per family).
3. **Footprint pitches of axial parts** (hole spacing 7.62/10.16/15.24 mm) are footprint choices, not package dimensions. They are OHMNI defaults with basis DERIVED/UNCERTAIN, and the lead is simply long enough to span them.
4. **New material tokens proposed** (coordinator to merge):
   - `MAT_DIODE_GLASS_AMBER` : #A5561E, roughness 0.12, metallic 0, alpha 0.85 (DO-35/MiniMELF glass diode body; visual default, glass colour varies by maker from amber/orange to translucent to black-coated).
   - `MAT_DIODE_BAND_SILVER` : #D2D2CE, roughness 0.5 (cathode band on molded bodies; silver to white).
   - `MAT_DIODE_BAND_BLACK` : #0B0B0C, roughness 0.5 (cathode band on glass bodies).
   - `MAT_DIODE_END_CAP` : #B9BBBE, roughness 0.35, metallic 1.0 (MELF metal end caps, tin plated; alias of MAT_TIN_BRIGHT is acceptable).
5. Dimension table notation: `a-b` is the credible range. "Default" is the OHMNI deterministic default.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-DO_AXIAL

**Generator:** GEN-AXIAL (axial two-lead through-hole, diode mode). Members: DO-35 (JEDEC DO-204AH), DO-41 (DO-204AL), DO-201AD.

**Shared geometry.** A straight cylindrical body with its axis along X, lying on the board (body underside Z = 0, so the axis height Z = D/2). Two round leads of diameter d_lead leave the body ends on the axis, run straight along X to the hole centers at X = +/- pitch/2, bend 90 degrees downward (inside bend radius about 1 x d_lead; outer radius = inner + d_lead), and run down through the board. Cathode end (-X) carries a band. Two body types in this family:

- **Glass (DO-35 signal diodes, also glass DO-41 and glass MiniMELF types):** translucent amber/orange or dark glass cylinder, leads emerge from the end faces; black cathode band.
- **Molded epoxy (DO-41 rectifiers, DO-201AD power):** matte black cylinder, silver/white cathode band near the cathode end. Vishay's documents describe the cathode marker as "color band denotes cathode end" (DO-41, DO-201AD) and "cathode identification" (DO-35).

The bodies are straight cylinders in the drawings read; end-face doming, mold flash and the glass bead/slug are not described in any opened source (not modeled; LOD2 may add a tiny end-face fillet).

**Member table (mm)**

| Member | Body length L | Body diameter D | Lead dia d | Lead length (min, straight stock) | OHMNI default pitch | Default hole dia | Basis / confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DO-35 (DO-204AH) | default 3.4; Vishay 1N4148: max 3.4; Topline: 3.03-4.44 | default 1.7; Vishay 1.5-1.75; Topline 1.52-2.29 | default 0.5; Vishay max 0.55; Topline 0.46-0.56 | 25.4 min (both) | 7.62 (0.300 in) | 0.9 | MFR_DATASHEET + MFR_DRAWING, two sources conflict on body size; M |
| DO-41 (DO-204AL) | default 4.6; Vishay 4.1-5.2 | default 2.4; Vishay 2.0-2.7 | default 0.8; Vishay 0.71-0.86 (a second pair 0.58-0.66 is for "E" suffix parts) | 25.4 min | 10.16 (0.400 in) | 1.1 | MFR_DATASHEET (single manufacturer); M |
| DO-201AD | default 8.4; Vishay 7.2-9.5 | default 5.05; Vishay 4.8-5.3 | default 1.27; Vishay 1.22-1.32 | 25.4 min | 15.24 (0.600 in) | 1.6 | MFR_DATASHEET (Vishay 1N5400 series; two copies of the same figure); M |

Derived: hole diameter = lead diameter + 0.3 to 0.4 (OHMNI default, basis DERIVED, not a package dimension). Minimum legal pitch for generator = L + 2 x (2 x d_lead + 0.5) (DERIVED safety constraint so the bend clears the body).

**Standard names.** Vishay drawings opened name "DO-35 (DO-204AH)", "DO-204AL" and "DO-201AD". JEDEC outline text itself was not opened; JEDEC numbers are used only as printed in Vishay documents. De facto: the 7.62/10.16/15.24 pitches.

**Generator notes.**
- Parameters: body_type (glass|molded), L, D, d_lead, pitch, band_width, band_color, tail_below_board_top (default 2.6 per architecture).
- Band width: not given in any opened source; OHMNI default = 0.18 x L (UNCERTAIN, L); real parts range roughly from a thin ring to about a fifth of body length.
- Pin 1 (cathode) at (-pitch/2, 0), pin 2 (anode) at (+pitch/2, 0). Origin = pad-pattern center = body center, so `body_offset_mm = [0, 0]`.
- Lead path in the XZ plane: straight from body end at Z = D/2, to X = +/-pitch/2 minus bend radius, arc down, then vertical to Z = -(1.6 + 1.0).

**Sources (family)**
1. Vishay, 1N4148 datasheet, Document 81857, Rev. 1.4, 06-Jul-17 (copy at embedded.fel.cvut.cz/sites/default/files/kurzy/ETC/Literatura/1n4148___Vishay.pdf). S3/S4. DO-35 (DO-204AH): body length 3.4 max, body diameter 1.5-1.75, lead diameter 0.55 max, lead 25.4 min, "cathode identification".
2. Topline, DO35 Outline (https://www.topline.tv/drawings/pdf/DO_Devices/DO35_Outline.pdf). S2. A 25.40 min, B 3.03-4.44, C 0.46-0.56, D 1.52-2.29 mm; "Cathode is marked by band". CONFLICT: Topline body is larger than Vishay's (3.4 max length, 1.75 max diameter). Both shown; OHMNI defaults sit at the common region.
3. Vishay, 1N4002 thru 1N4007 datasheet, Document 88503, Rev. 23-Feb-11 (copy at sites.units.it/carrato/didatt/E_web/doc/datasheet_componenti_discreti/1N4002_vishay.pdf). S3/S4. DO-204AL (DO-41): 1.0 in (25.4) min leads, 0.160-0.205 in (4.1-5.2) body length, 0.080-0.107 in (2.0-2.7) body diameter, lead diameter 0.028-0.034 in (0.71-0.86) and 0.023-0.026 in (0.58-0.66); note "Lead diameter is for suffix E part numbers" (which pair this note refers to is not resolved in the extracted text); "Color band denotes cathode end".
4. Vishay General Semiconductor, 1N5400 thru 1N5408, Document 88516 (RS copy: assets.rs-online.com/v1698967741/Datasheets/38a88739ffdf24a2be6f571e97040ca3.pdf, Rev. 02-Apr-08; USC copy ece-classes.usc.edu/ee459/library/datasheets/1N5400.pdf, Rev. 04-Nov-09). S3/S4. DO-201AD: body length 0.285-0.375 in (7.2-9.5), body diameter 0.190-0.210 in (4.8-5.3), lead diameter 0.048-0.052 in (1.22-1.32), leads 1.0 in (25.4) min; "Color band denotes cathode end". Both copies give the same numbers.

**Research confidence (family):** Dimensions M; Geometry M (simple cylinders; band width and end-face detail unsourced); Materials/appearance M.
**Validation:** pitch >= L + clearance for all three members; lead diameter < body diameter for all members; the DO-35 sources overlap (1.52-1.75 diameter, 3.03-3.4 length) which is where the default sits.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-MELF

**Generator:** GEN-SMD_DIODE (cylinder mode). Members: MiniMELF (SOD-80 family; Vishay calls the Zener case "MiniMELF Glass Case (SOD-80C)"), MELF (DO-213AB as named by Vishay on GL41).

**Shared geometry.** A cylindrical glass (or molded plastic, for GL41 per Vishay "Plastic" in the extracted summary of doc 80128) body with its axis along X, resting on the board (axis height Z = D/2). Each end is capped with a metal (tin-plated) cylindrical end cap of length c; the caps ARE the terminals (no leads). The cathode band is a colored ring on the body near the -X end cap (cathode). The caps' outside diameter is the same as or slightly larger than the body (GL41: second diameter D2 = 2.67 with tolerance 0 to -0.20 vs D1 = 2.41). Terminal contact center = X = +/-(L/2 - c/2) at Z = 0 (cylinder bottom line).

**Member table (mm)**

| Member | Overall length L (incl. caps) | Body diameter D | End cap length c | Cap diameter | Basis / confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMELF (SOD-80) | default 3.5; BZV55 doc: 3.4-3.6 (0.134-0.142 in); doc 80128: 3.3-3.7 | default 1.5; BZV55: 1.4-1.6 (0.055-0.063 in) | default 0.38; BZV55: 0.28-0.48 (0.011-0.019 in) | = D (not separately given) | MFR_DATASHEET + MFR_DRAWING; M |

**Band.** Cathode band color varies: BZV55 doc says "Blue" band; GL41 doc says "1st band denotes type and positive end (cathode)" (i.e. the first of possibly several bands at the cathode end). OHMNI default: single band, width 0.3 x L for MiniMELF is NOT sourced; default band width 0.35 (MiniMELF) and 0.5 (MELF), UNCERTAIN, L.

**Generator notes.** Parameters: L, D, c, cap_D, band_width, band_color, body_material (glass or plastic). Origin at midpoint of the two caps (symmetric, body_offset (0,0)). ## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SOD

**Generator:** GEN-SMD_DIODE (flat-lead mode). Members: SOD-123, SOD-323 (JEITA SC-76), SOD-523 (JEITA/JEDEC code SC-79 as printed by Nexperia).

**Shared geometry.** A rectangular molded body (length along X, width along Y), top slightly domed/flat, with two flat gull-wing leads leaving the two X-end faces near the lower part of the body, bending down to a flat foot that lies on the board. **Terminal/foot positions.** Overall length (lead tip to lead tip) is larger than body length: SOD-123 3.7 vs 2.7 body (Vishay BAT42W: 3.7 +/-0.15 and cathode bar length 2.7 +/-0.15). Foot length (the part resting on the pad) is NOT stated in the opened outlines; OHMNI defaults (UNCERTAIN, L): SOD-123 0.85, SOD-323 0.60, SOD-523 0.35 (taken from the magnitude of the recommended land callouts in Vishay documents). Terminal center X = +/-(overall/2 - foot/2).

# [OHM-056] DO-35 signal diode

## Identity
- Canonical name: DO-35 signal diode
- ID: OHM-056  slug: `do35_diode`
- Category: semiconductor / diode (rectifier/signal)
- Physical package: PKG-DO_AXIAL.DO-35 (DO-204AH)
- Mounting type: tht, horizontal axial (body lies on the board)
- Aliases: DO-204AH, DO-35
- Common variants: 1N4148 (Vishay datasheet opened); other glass signal, Zener and small Schottky types are commonly supplied in DO-35
- Class B, priority P0, complexity 2

## Physical Dimensions
Restated from PKG-DO_AXIAL member DO-35: body length 3.4 (range 3.03-4.44), body diameter 1.7 (range 1.5-2.29), lead diameter 0.5 (range 0.46-0.56), lead stock 25.4 min, hole pitch 7.62 (OHMNI default), hole diameter 0.9 (DERIVED: lead dia + 0.3 to 0.4). Overall height above board = 1.7 (body diameter, axis at Z = 0.85). Overall X extent at board surface = pitch + lead dia = 8.12. Tail bottom Z = -2.6 (default).

## Geometry
Primary: cylinder, axis X, length 3.4, diameter 1.7, underside on Z = 0, center at origin. Secondary: cathode band, a ring of width 0.6 (OHMNI default, UNCERTAIN) flush with the -X end face, radially 0.01 proud of the body (decal acceptable). Body is a glass tube, no visible chamfer in the sources. Two leads: round, diameter 0.5, axis on Z = 0.85.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Count 2. Round wire leads, diameter 0.5, from each end face along X to X = +/-(3.81 - bend radius), 90 degree downward bend with inside radius = 0.5 (OHMNI default, UNCERTAIN), then vertical through the hole to Z = -2.6. Numbering: terminal 1 = cathode at (-3.81, 0), terminal 2 = anode at (+3.81, 0). Material MAT_TIN_MATTE (plated copper/steel core; plating type not stated for this member, treat as tin). PCB penetration 1.6 + 1.0.

## PCB Interface
Through-hole, two plated holes dia 0.9 at X = +/-3.81, Y = 0 (pitch 7.62). FCO origin = midpoint of the two holes = body center; `body_offset_mm = [0, 0]`. Body rests on the board (standoff 0). Pitch is adjustable to other axial footprints (see Parametric Variants) as long as pitch >= 6.4. Pin 1 (cathode) at (-3.81, 0).

## Materials
Body MAT_DIODE_GLASS_AMBER; band MAT_DIODE_BAND_BLACK; leads MAT_TIN_MATTE. New tokens (proposed in group notes): MAT_DIODE_GLASS_AMBER, MAT_DIODE_BAND_SILVER, MAT_DIODE_BAND_BLACK.

## Appearance
Glass body: translucent amber/orange (OHMNI default MAT_DIODE_GLASS_AMBER); other makers use clear or black-painted glass. Cathode band black. Leads bright tin.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode = band end, at -X (terminal 1). Source confirmation: Vishay 1N4148 outline (cathode identification) and Topline DO35 outline ('Cathode is marked by Band'). Anode at +X. EDA libraries differ on whether pin 1 is cathode or anode; OHMNI model uses pin 1 = cathode. The band is the ONLY polarity cue.

## Recognition Features
1. Straight cylinder 3.4 x 1.7 with two long axial leads that bend 90 degrees down
2. Cathode band at the -X end (high contrast against the body)
3. Translucent amber glass body
4. Lead pitch 7.62, body centered between the holes
5. Bent leads visible above the board

## Parametric Variants
Safe parameters: L, D, d_lead, pitch, band_width, body_type (glass|molded), tail depth. Coupled: pitch >= 6.4; hole = d_lead + 0.35; axis Z = D/2; band_width <= 0.3 x L. Other standard pitches (e.g. 12.7) are valid for the same body (vertical/stand-up mounting is NOT covered; would be a separate variant).

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (body), thin ring/cylinder shell (band), two cylinders (straight leads) + two quarter-torus (bends) + two vertical cylinders (tails).

## Modeling Procedure
1. Create body cylinder along X, radius D/2, centered at X = 0, base at Z = 0.
2. Add band ring at the -X end (width band_width).
3. Create each lead: straight cylinder from the end face to X = +/-(pitch/2 - R), quarter torus (R = inside bend radius + d/2) turning to -Z, vertical cylinder to Z = -2.6.
4. Assign materials; set terminal 1 = -X lead.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: body cylinder (8 to 12 segments) + two straight stub cylinders reaching Z = -2.6 (no bend); no band geometry. LOD1: body, band as a separate ring, leads with 90 degree miter bends (no radius), 16 segments. LOD2: filleted bend radius, 24+ segments, optional end-face edge fillet, optional visible dumet slug/bead in glass.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: lead bend radius, end-face fillet, text, tail below board (LOD0 only). NEVER omit: cathode band (at least a color change at the -X end), the two lead hole positions, lead-to-body axial alignment, correct body length/diameter.
