# [OHM-057] DO-41 rectifier diode

## Identity
- Canonical name: DO-41 rectifier diode
- ID: OHM-057  slug: `do41_diode`
- Category: semiconductor / diode (rectifier/signal)
- Physical package: PKG-DO_AXIAL.DO-41 (DO-204AL)
- Mounting type: tht, horizontal axial (body lies on the board)
- Aliases: DO-204AL, DO-41
- Common variants: 1N4001-1N4007 (Vishay 1N4002-1N4007 datasheet opened, molded epoxy); Zener and Schottky types also come in DO-41; glass-bodied DO-41 exists (Vishay doc 80128 lists a glass DO-204AL), use body_type=glass
- Class B, priority P0, complexity 2

## Physical Dimensions
Restated from PKG-DO_AXIAL member DO-41: body length 4.6 (range 4.1-5.2), body diameter 2.4 (range 2.0-2.7), lead diameter 0.8 (range 0.71-0.86), lead stock 25.4 min, hole pitch 10.16 (OHMNI default), hole diameter 1.1 (DERIVED: lead dia + 0.3 to 0.4). Overall height above board = 2.4 (body diameter, axis at Z = 1.2). Overall X extent at board surface = pitch + lead dia = 10.96. Tail bottom Z = -2.6 (default).

## Geometry
Primary: cylinder, axis X, length 4.6, diameter 2.4, underside on Z = 0, center at origin. Secondary: cathode band, a ring of width 0.9 (OHMNI default, UNCERTAIN) flush with the -X end face, radially 0.01 proud of the body (decal acceptable). Body is a molded cylinder; sources show no chamfers. End faces flat. Optional LOD2: 0.1 edge fillet. Two leads: round, diameter 0.8, axis on Z = 1.2.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Count 2. Round wire leads, diameter 0.8, from each end face along X to X = +/-(5.08 - bend radius), 90 degree downward bend with inside radius = 0.8 (OHMNI default, UNCERTAIN), then vertical through the hole to Z = -2.6. Numbering: terminal 1 = cathode at (-5.08, 0), terminal 2 = anode at (+5.08, 0). Material MAT_TIN_MATTE (plated copper/steel core; plating type not stated for this member, treat as tin). PCB penetration 1.6 + 1.0.

## PCB Interface
Through-hole, two plated holes dia 1.1 at X = +/-5.08, Y = 0 (pitch 10.16). FCO origin = midpoint of the two holes = body center; `body_offset_mm = [0, 0]`. Body rests on the board (standoff 0). Pitch is adjustable to other axial footprints (see Parametric Variants) as long as pitch >= 8.8. Pin 1 (cathode) at (-5.08, 0).

## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK; band MAT_DIODE_BAND_SILVER; leads MAT_TIN_MATTE. New tokens (proposed in group notes): MAT_DIODE_GLASS_AMBER, MAT_DIODE_BAND_SILVER, MAT_DIODE_BAND_BLACK.

## Appearance
Matte black epoxy body, silver/white cathode band (MAT_DIODE_BAND_SILVER) near the -X end, leads matte tin. Text (part number, logo) is a decal only.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode = band end, at -X (terminal 1). Source confirmation: Vishay 1N4002-1N4007 outline: 'Color band denotes cathode end'. Anode at +X. EDA libraries differ on whether pin 1 is cathode or anode; OHMNI model uses pin 1 = cathode. The band is the ONLY polarity cue.

## Recognition Features
1. Straight cylinder 4.6 x 2.4 with two long axial leads that bend 90 degrees down
2. Cathode band at the -X end (high contrast against the body)
3. Matte black molded body, larger than a resistor of the same lead pitch only in diameter
4. Lead pitch 10.16, body centered between the holes
5. Bent leads visible above the board

## Parametric Variants
Safe parameters: L, D, d_lead, pitch, band_width, body_type (glass|molded), tail depth. Coupled: pitch >= 8.8; hole = d_lead + 0.35; axis Z = D/2; band_width <= 0.3 x L. Other standard pitches (e.g. 12.7) are valid for the same body (vertical/stand-up mounting is NOT covered; would be a separate variant).

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (body), thin ring/cylinder shell (band), two cylinders (straight leads) + two quarter-torus (bends) + two vertical cylinders (tails).

## Modeling Procedure
1. Create body cylinder along X, radius D/2, centered at X = 0, base at Z = 0.
2. Add band ring at the -X end (width band_width).
3. Create each lead: straight cylinder from the end face to X = +/-(pitch/2 - R), quarter torus (R = inside bend radius + d/2) turning to -Z, vertical cylinder to Z = -2.6.
4. Assign materials; set terminal 1 = -X lead.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: body cylinder (8 to 12 segments) + two straight stub cylinders reaching Z = -2.6 (no bend); no band geometry. LOD1: body, band as a separate ring, leads with 90 degree miter bends (no radius), 16 segments. LOD2: filleted bend radius, 24+ segments, optional end-face edge fillet, optional visible dumet slug/bead in glass.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: lead bend radius, end-face fillet, text, tail below board (LOD0 only). NEVER omit: cathode band (at least a color change at the -X end), the two lead hole positions, lead-to-body axial alignment, correct body length/diameter.

# [OHM-059] MiniMELF diode

## Identity
- Canonical name: MiniMELF diode
- ID: OHM-059  slug: `minimelf_diode`
- Category: semiconductor / diode (MELF)
- Physical package: PKG-MELF.MiniMELF (SOD-80 family (Vishay: SOD-80C))
- Mounting type: smd, cylindrical body with metal end-cap terminals
- Aliases: MiniMELF, SOD-80
- Common variants: Zener (BZV55 opened), switching diodes (LL4148-type), small Schottky in MiniMELF
- Class B, priority P2, complexity 2

## Physical Dimensions
Restated from PKG-MELF.MiniMELF: overall length 3.5 (range 3.4-3.6), body diameter 1.5 (range 1.4-1.6), end cap length 0.38 (range 0.28-0.48), end cap diameter 1.5. Overall height above board = 1.5. Terminal contact centers at X = +/-1.56.

## Geometry
Primary: cylinder along X, length 2.74 between caps, diameter 1.5, axis at Z = 0.750. Secondary: two metal end-cap cylinders length 0.38, diameter 1.5, flush with the body ends (overall length 3.5). Cathode band: ring of width 0.35 on the body immediately next to the -X end cap, radius +0.005 (decal acceptable). No flats or chamfers in the sources (cylinder rolls; real parts may have none).

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Count 2. The two end caps are the terminals (type: metal end cap). Cap contact line on the board at Z = 0, center X = +/-1.56; contact length approx 0.38 along X, width approx the chord of the cylinder (use full cap). Terminal 1 = cathode cap at (-1.56, 0), terminal 2 = anode cap at (+1.56, 0). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (tin-plated; GL41 doc: matte tin plated ends). No PCB penetration.

## PCB Interface
smd_pads; origin FCO = midpoint between the two end caps = body center; body_offset (0, 0). Standoff 0 (cylinder tangent to board). Pad centers at X = +/-1.56 nominal; land pattern (see family) is separate. Rotation 0: axis along X, cathode (band) at -X.

## Materials
Body MAT_DIODE_GLASS_AMBER (use dark glass #1C1C20 for 1N4148-type; amber is OHMNI default) ; end caps MAT_TIN_BRIGHT; band MAT_DIODE_BAND_BLACK (or color of the product; BZV55 doc: blue).

## Appearance
Glass diodes: dark glass/black-coated body with a colored cathode band (BZV55 documented as blue; many 1N4148-type parts black or dark with a black/colored band). Metal caps bright. Plastic MELF (GL41/DO-213AB): black body, band near cathode.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode = band end at -X. Source: Vishay BZV55 doc 88315 ('Blue' cathode marking), Vishay GL41 doc 88548 ('1st band denotes type and positive end (cathode)'). Terminal 1 = cathode in OHMNI convention; libraries differ.

## Recognition Features
1. Small cylinder with bright metal end caps
2. Cathode band ring next to one cap
3. Cylindrical silhouette (no flat top)
4. Overall length to diameter ratio about 2.3:1 (MiniMELF) or 2:1 (MELF)

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: L, D, cap length, cap diameter, band width/color, body material. Coupled: cap diameter >= D; 2 x cap < L; axis height = cap diameter/2.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (body) + two slightly larger cylinders (caps) + thin ring (band).

## Modeling Procedure
1. Create body cylinder along X between the caps, radius D/2.
2. Add caps at each end (length cap, radius capD/2).
3. Add band ring next to the -X cap.
4. Set center of cylinder axis at Z = capD/2 and assign materials; terminal 1 = -X cap.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: single cylinder with 8 segments (caps merged), no band. LOD1: body + 2 caps (16 segments) + band ring. LOD2: 32 segments, slight end-cap edge chamfer, glass transparency.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: end-cap chamfer, marking text. NEVER omit: cylinder shape, bright caps vs dark body, cathode band, correct L and D.

Secondary: two metal end-cap cylinders length 0.51, diameter 2.57, flush with the body ends (overall length 5.0). Cathode band: ring of width 0.5 on the body immediately next to the -X end cap, radius +0.005 (decal acceptable). No flats or chamfers in the sources (cylinder rolls; real parts may have none).

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Count 2. The two end caps are the terminals (type: metal end cap). Cap contact line on the board at Z = 0, center X = +/-2.245; contact length approx 0.51 along X, width approx the chord of the cylinder (use full cap). Terminal 1 = cathode cap at (-2.245, 0), terminal 2 = anode cap at (+2.245, 0). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (tin-plated; GL41 doc: matte tin plated ends). No PCB penetration.

## PCB Interface
smd_pads; origin FCO = midpoint between the two end caps = body center; body_offset (0, 0). Standoff 0 (cylinder tangent to board). Pad centers at X = +/-2.245 nominal; land pattern (see family) is separate. Rotation 0: axis along X, cathode (band) at -X.

## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK ; end caps MAT_TIN_BRIGHT; band MAT_DIODE_BAND_BLACK (or color of the product; BZV55 doc: blue).

## Appearance
Glass diodes: dark glass/black-coated body with a colored cathode band (BZV55 documented as blue; many 1N4148-type parts black or dark with a black/colored band). Metal caps bright. Plastic MELF (GL41/DO-213AB): black body, band near cathode.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode = band end at -X. Source: Vishay BZV55 doc 88315 ('Blue' cathode marking), Vishay GL41 doc 88548 ('1st band denotes type and positive end (cathode)'). Terminal 1 = cathode in OHMNI convention; libraries differ.

## Recognition Features
1. Small cylinder with bright metal end caps
2. Cathode band ring next to one cap
3. Cylindrical silhouette (no flat top)
4. Overall length to diameter ratio about 2.3:1 (MiniMELF) or 2:1 (MELF)

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: L, D, cap length, cap diameter, band width/color, body material. Coupled: cap diameter >= D; 2 x cap < L; axis height = cap diameter/2.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (body) + two slightly larger cylinders (caps) + thin ring (band).

## Modeling Procedure
1. Create body cylinder along X between the caps, radius D/2.
2. Add caps at each end (length cap, radius capD/2).
3. Add band ring next to the -X cap.
4. Set center of cylinder axis at Z = capD/2 and assign materials; terminal 1 = -X cap.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: single cylinder with 8 segments (caps merged), no band. LOD1: body + 2 caps (16 segments) + band ring. LOD2: 32 segments, slight end-cap edge chamfer, glass transparency.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: end-cap chamfer, marking text. NEVER omit: cylinder shape, bright caps vs dark body, cathode band, correct L and D.

Primary: rectangular block 4.25 x 2.65 x 2.15, centered at X = 0, Y = 0, underside at Z = 0.1. Secondary: cathode bar across the top at the -X end, width 0.9, full body width (decal or 0.01 raised). Terminal 1 = cathode at (-2.0, 0); terminal 2 = anode at (2.0, 0). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. OHMNI DEFAULT PACKAGE: SOD-123 (PKG-SOD.SOD123), chosen because it is the most common small-signal/low-current Schottky package family and shares a generator with the other SOD parts. Geometry identical to the selected package member. No Schottky-specific physical feature exists in the opened sources. Default is the SOD-123 box with flat gull-wing leads and cathode bar at -X.

Black molded body; marking by a silver bar at the cathode end; manufacturers print a 1-3 character code or part-number fragment. Appearance is the same as other SOD-123 diodes.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode = marked bar at the -X end (all members). Source: Nexperia SOD123 'The marking band indicates the cathode'; Vishay BAT42W (Schottky) 'cathode bar'. Terminal 1 = cathode in OHMNI convention.

## Recognition Features
1. Same silhouette as PKG-SOD.SOD123
2. Cathode bar at -X
3. Two flat feet at the X ends

Safe parameter: package_member (SOD123 | SOD323 | SMA | SMB | DO-41 | DO-201AD) with all member dimensions inherited. Coupled: none beyond the member.

As PKG-SOD.SOD123 (box + two bent strips + bar).

1. Select the package member (default SOD-123).
2. Instantiate the member generator with the member's defaults.
3. Add the marking text decal 'SK'/'Dxx' optional (decal only).
4. Terminal 1 = cathode at -X.

## LOD Strategy
As the selected member: LOD0 box + end blocks; LOD1 bent leads + bar; LOD2 bend radii.

As the selected member. NEVER omit the cathode bar. A Schottky symbol is not drawn on the body; no visual difference from a switching diode is required.

# [OHM-069] TVS diode

## Identity
- Canonical name: TVS diode
- ID: OHM-069  slug: `tvs_diode`
- Category: semiconductor / diode (TVS)
- Physical package: PKG-SMX.SMB (default; alternates PKG-SMX.SMA, PKG-SMX.SMC)
- Mounting type: smd (default package) ; through-hole alternatives listed
- Aliases: TVS diode, TVS diode
- Common variants: SMAJ/SMBJ/SMCJ series, unidirectional (band) and bidirectional C/CA (no band); axial and MELF TVS also exist but are not covered
- Class C, priority P1, complexity 2

## Physical Dimensions
OHMNI DEFAULT PACKAGE: SMB (DO-214AA), PKG-SMX.SMB: body 4.32 x 3.62 x 2.15, lead span 5.40, lead width 2.2, thickness 0.23, foot 1.1, standoff 0.1. Alternates: PKG-SMX.SMA (SMAJ-type) and PKG-SMX.SMC (SMCJ/1.5SMC-type). The Vishay SMBJ datasheet (doc 88392) states case DO-214AA (SMBJ).

## Geometry
Geometry identical to PKG-SMX.SMB. Parameter bidirectional=false draws the cathode band; bidirectional=true omits it.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
As PKG-SMX.SMB: terminal centers X = +/-2.425. Unidirectional: terminal 1 = cathode at (-2.425, 0), terminal 2 = anode at (+2.425, 0). BIDIRECTIONAL: both terminals electrically equivalent; geometry identical, the terminal numbering 1 (-X) and 2 (+X) is arbitrary.

## PCB Interface
As PKG-SMX.SMB: origin = body center, standoff 0.1, body_offset (0, 0).

## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK, leads MAT_TIN_MATTE (Vishay SMBJ: 'matte tin plated leads'), band MAT_DIODE_BAND_SILVER (unidirectional only).

## Appearance
Black body, silver band at cathode end for unidirectional types; bidirectional types show no band (only the marking text, e.g. '...CA'). Part marking is a decal only.

## Orientation Markings
UNIDIRECTIONAL: cathode band at -X (Vishay SMBJ doc 88392: 'For unidirectional types the band denotes cathode end, no marking on bidirectional types'). BIDIRECTIONAL (suffix C or CA): NO band at all; geometry otherwise identical. Parameter `bidirectional` removes the band.

## Recognition Features
1. Same silhouette as PKG-SMX.SMB
2. Cathode band present ONLY on unidirectional types
3. J-lead feet visible under the body outline
4. Wide lead width (2.2) compared with small diode packages

## Parametric Variants
Safe parameters: package_member (SMA|SMB|SMC), bidirectional (bool, default false). Coupled: band shown iff bidirectional = false.

## Recommended Base Geometry
As PKG-SMX.SMB (box + two folded strips + optional band).

## Modeling Procedure
1. Instantiate PKG-SMX.SMB.
2. If bidirectional is false add the cathode band at -X, else add no band.
3. Terminals at +/-2.425; terminal 1 = -X.

## LOD Strategy
As PKG-SMX.SMB.

## Simplification Rules
NEVER omit the band on unidirectional parts; NEVER add a band on bidirectional parts (bidirectional parts have none). Otherwise as PKG-SMX.

# [OHM-070] Dual diode SOT-23

## Identity
- Canonical name: Dual diode SOT-23
- ID: OHM-070  slug: `dual_diode_sot23`
- Category: semiconductor / diode (dual)
- Physical package: PKG-SOT23 (owned by G07), member SOT23 3-lead; JEDEC TO-236AB as printed by Nexperia
- Mounting type: smd
- Aliases: BAV70 / BAV99 / BAW56-type dual diode, SOT-23 dual switching diode
- Common variants: Common cathode (BAV70), series (BAV99), common anode (BAW56 class)
- Class B, priority P1, complexity 2

## Physical Dimensions
Package body and leads are owned by PKG-SOT23 (G07); do not re-derive. Nexperia SOT23 outline as read for cross-checking only: D 2.8-3.0 (nom 2.9), E 1.2-1.4 (nom 1.3), A 0.9-1.1, A1 0.1 max, lead width 0.38-0.45, lead thickness 0.09-0.15, lead length 0.45-0.55, lead span 2.1-2.5, pitch 1.9 (pin1-pin2), minimal pitch 0.95. No dimension delta for OHM-070 versus any other 3-pin SOT-23 part.

## Geometry
Identical to the PKG-SOT23 3-lead body. Delta: none in geometry. Dual diodes use only the standard 3-lead SOT-23 body; no extra marking geometry (no band, no dot required). Pin 1 is identified by the lead arrangement (two leads on one long side, one on the other) and, if the family generator provides it, an optional pin-1 dot decal; marking text (e.g. 'A7', 'JY') is decal only and differs by maker.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Per PKG-SOT23 (G07). Architecture rule: pins 1-2 on the -Y side with pin 1 at -X, pin 3 on the +Y side. Contact centers copied from G07's final PKG-SOT23 section (second pass): pin 1 (-0.95, -1.0), pin 2 (+0.95, -1.0), pin 3 (0, +1.0), i.e. |y| = 1.0 for the 3-lead member (G07: DERIVED from the Diodes land pattern center-to-center 2.0 and HE/2 - foot/2 = 1.03). The first-pass 0.9 is superseded. Pin usage deltas: COMMON CATHODE (Nexperia BAV70 SOT23): pin 1 anode (diode 1), pin 2 anode (diode 2), pin 3 common cathode. SERIES (Nexperia BAV99 SOT23): pin 1 anode (diode 1), pin 2 cathode (diode 2), pin 3 cathode of diode 1 joined with anode of diode 2. COMMON ANODE (BAW56): pin 1 cathode (k1), pin 2 cathode (k2), pin 3 common anode, from the Philips datasheet 'High-speed double diode BAW56' dated 2003 Mar 25 pinning table (opened second pass; Nexperia's own BAW56_SER PDF URL returned 404, so the Philips-era copy is the evidence, M confidence, since a manufacturer datasheet from the same device lineage that Nexperia inherited). Pinning of the three configurations therefore: BAV70 (1=A1, 2=A2, 3=common K), BAV99 (1=A1, 2=K2, 3=K1/A2), BAW56 (1=K1, 2=K2, 3=common A).

## PCB Interface
Per PKG-SOT23: smd_pads, origin FCO = center of the three-pad pattern. Pin 1 at (-0.95, -1.0). OHM-070 adds no footprint difference.

## Materials
As PKG-SOT23: body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK, leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.

## Appearance
Black SOT-23 body, leads bright tin. All three internal configurations are PHYSICALLY IDENTICAL; they differ only by printed marking code and pin function. Default OHMNI configuration for the generic entry: common cathode (BAV70 pinout); all three pin mappings are now sourced.

## Orientation Markings
No cathode band. Pin 1 location follows the architecture SOT-23 rule (pin 1 at -X on the -Y side). Polarity is carried by the pin-to-function table above, not by a physical mark.

## Recognition Features
1. Standard 3-lead SOT-23 silhouette (inherited from PKG-SOT23)
2. Optionally a pin-1 dot/marking decal
3. Marking code decal

## Parametric Variants
Parameter `configuration`: common_cathode | series | common_anode (metadata only; geometry unchanged). Coupled: none.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Delegate to PKG-SOT23 generator (G07). No additional primitives.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Call the PKG-SOT23 3-lead generator with the standard SOT23 member.
2. Attach metadata `configuration` and the pin-function table.
3. Optional marking decal.

## LOD Strategy
As PKG-SOT23 (G07).

## Simplification Rules
As PKG-SOT23. Nothing specific to OHM-070 may be omitted or added; geometry is shared.

6. G07 PKG-SOT23 final section (this spec, second pass 2026-10-02): contact |y| = 1.0 for SOT23-3, x = -0.95, 0, +0.95.
4. Panjit BAW56 series datasheet (https://pdf.direnc.net/upload/baw56-sot23-150ma-100v-diyot-datasheet.pdf and panjit.com.tw BAV70 PDF, REV.03S 19 Jul 2017): configuration drawings (common anode/cathode/series); no pin labels.

- Common variants: DB101-DB107 (DB-1), DF005M-DF10M (Vishay DFM); SMD MBS-style is a proposed addition (RESEARCH_REQUIRED)
- Class A, priority P2, complexity 2

## Physical Dimensions
From PKG-BRIDGE_DIP: body 8.4 (Y) x 6.3 (X) x 3.2 (Z, range 3.05-3.30, M), row spacing 7.62 (X), pin pitch 5.08 (Y), lead diameter 0.51, lead length below body 3.81-4.69 (default 4.25), tail below board 2.6 (default truncation; real tail = 4.25 - standoff - 1.6). Body underside at standoff 1.0 (candidate from unassigned 0.89-1.14 dimension, L, UNCERTAIN). Overall height above board = 4.2 (derived: standoff + body height).

## Geometry
Primary: rectangular box 6.3 (X) x 8.4 (Y) x 3.2 (Z), long axis along Y, centered at the origin, underside at Z = 1.0 (standoff candidate; set to 0.3 if the shoulder form proves different). Secondary: four leads leaving the body at the lower part of the X-faces (two on each long side at Y = +/-2.54), running outward to X = +/-3.81, then bending down (outside bend radius about 0.5) through the board. Marking: '+', '-' and AC symbols printed on top (decal); a small corner bevel or notch at the pin-1 end is typical but NOT confirmed in any opened source. Body corners may be chamfered; not sourced.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Count 4, round leads dia 0.51 (Hottech typ; flat vs round unconfirmed). Positions (FCO origin at pattern center): pin 1 (-3.81, +2.54), pin 2 (-3.81, -2.54), pin 3 (+3.81, -2.54), pin 4 (+3.81, +2.54) (architecture dual-row rule: rows parallel to Y, row spacing along X, counter-clockwise numbering from the top-left). Pin function (+, -, AC, AC) per pin: RESEARCH_REQUIRED (Vishay: 'Polarity: As marked on body'); OHMNI default pin 1 = '+' as a geometry placeholder only. Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.

## PCB Interface
tht_holes: four holes dia 0.9 at (-3.81, +2.54), (-3.81, -2.54), (+3.81, -2.54), (+3.81, +2.54) (hole dia DERIVED: lead 0.51 + 0.4). FCO = center of the four holes = body center; body_offset (0, 0). Standoff 1.0 (candidate).

## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK; leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT; printed symbols MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE decals.

## Appearance
Black epoxy block with printed type code (e.g. 'DB107', 'DF06M'), white or silver '~' '~' '+' '-' symbols. Gloss low.

## Orientation Markings
Pin 1 at (-X, +Y). Polarity marks (+, -, ~) are printed; which lead is which is RESEARCH_REQUIRED beyond the Vishay statement 'Polarity: As marked on body'. A corner bevel at pin 1 is not confirmed.

## Recognition Features
1. Black 8.4 x 6.3 block with four legs in a 2 x 2 pattern 5.08 x 7.62
2. Printed + - ~ ~ symbols
3. Legs flare outward from the body before going down
4. Body higher than a signal diode (about 3.2 mm) and standing about 1 mm off the board

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: body L/W/H, row spacing (7.62), pitch (5.08), lead diameter, standoff, tail depth. Coupled: row spacing > body width; pitch < body length. Do not change pitch/row to other values without a new source.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box (body) + four bent cylinders (leads).

## Modeling Procedure
1. Create the body box (X 6.3, Y 8.4, Z 3.2) at Z = 1.0.
2. Create four lead paths: horizontal stub from the body X-face to X = +/-3.81, then vertical to Z = -2.6.
3. Place leads at Y = +/-2.54.
4. Add symbol decals; set pin 1 at (-3.81, +2.54).

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: body box + four tail cylinders. LOD1: body + leads with miter bends + symbols decals. LOD2: bend radii, body corner bevels, marking relief (if confirmed).

## Simplification Rules
May omit: body chamfers, text. NEVER omit: four leads at 5.08 x 7.62, body size, symbol decals (+ and ~).

# [OHM-072] Round bridge rectifier

- Aliases: WOG (Vishay), WOM (MCC), WOB (DigiKey supplier-package label for EVVO W06/W10), W005-W10 round bridge
- Common variants: W005G-W10G (Vishay WOG), W02M-W10M (MCC WOM)
- Class A, priority P3, complexity 2

From PKG-BRIDGE_ROUND: body diameter 9.1 (8.84-9.86), body height 5.0 (4.1-5.6), lead diameter 0.76 (0.71-0.81), lead length 25.4 min (generator trims to the 2.6 below-board tail; the full stock length is NOT modeled), lead square pitch 5.08 (range 4.6-5.6, M; 5.6 is the upper bound, not a conflict), standoff 0.5 (UNCERTAIN). Overall height above board = 5.5.

## Geometry
Primary: cylinder, axis Z, diameter 9.1, height 5.0, underside at Z = 0.5, centered at the origin. Secondary: four straight round leads of diameter 0.76 emerging from the underside at the corners of a square of side 5.08 (range 4.6-5.6; pin coordinates below), running down through the board; '+' marking on top. A mark or notch near the + lead is typical but not confirmed in the opened documents. Top face flat.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Count 4, straight round leads. CCW numbering from top-left: pin 1 (-2.54, +2.54), pin 2 (-2.54, -2.54), pin 3 (+2.54, -2.54), pin 4 (+2.54, +2.54). Function per pin (AC, AC, +, -; MCC WOM labels AC, AC, +, -): RESEARCH_REQUIRED which position is which; OHMNI default pin 1 = '+'. Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (MCC: silver plated copper).

## PCB Interface
tht_holes: four holes dia 1.1 at (+/-2.54, +/-2.54) (DERIVED: lead 0.76 + 0.34). FCO = square center = body center; body_offset (0, 0). Standoff 0.5.

## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK; leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT; printed marks MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE decals.

## Appearance
Black round epoxy disc/puck, printed '+' and type code; leads bright. Gloss low.

## Orientation Markings
Polarity by printed '+' (Vishay WOG diagram shows +/- markings). Pin 1 = top-left (-X, +Y) by OHMNI rule; which lead is + is RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

## Recognition Features
1. Round black puck 9.1 dia x 5.0
2. Four long straight leads on a square
3. Printed '+' on top
4. Body floating slightly above the board

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: diameter, height, lead diameter, lead square pitch, standoff. Coupled: pitch x sqrt(2) + lead dia < diameter.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (body) + four cylinders (leads) + optional decal.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Create body cylinder (dia 9.1, height 5.0) at Z = 0.5.
2. Create four leads from Z = 0.5 down to Z = -2.6 at (+/-2.54, +/-2.54).
3. Add '+' decal near pin 1.
4. Assign materials.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: cylinder (12 segments) + four tail cylinders. LOD1: 24-segment body, leads 8 segments, decals. LOD2: 48 segments, edge fillet, lead entry detail.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: top edge fillet, text. NEVER omit: four leads on the square, round body, the polarity decal.

# G06: LEDs (OHM-073 to OHM-086)

Status: written by research agent G06. Conventions follow 00_architecture.md (FCO origin, Z up, top view +X right / +Y up, MAT_* tokens, Section 17 addenda). Dimensions are mm.

**Evidence caveat (read first).** Every document was read through a summarizing fetch tool. Most LED datasheets (Kingbright, Lite-On, Lumileds, OSRAM, Cree, Worldsemi V6) came back WITHOUT the numbers printed inside the package drawing (only notes, tolerances, revision). Numbers below therefore come from: (a) Vishay datasheets whose drawing callouts came through as text (TLHR540x, VLMW15, VLMW13, VLMTG14, VLMA31, WS2812B V5 text), (b) distributor/marketplace listing size lines (Kingbright via globalspec, S4), (c) KiCad library footprints (S5; derived from manufacturer datasheets, coordinates are LAND PATTERNS or fab outlines, not terminal geometry). Per Addendum 7, drawing-callout figures are capped at M. Values with no opened support are marked UNCERTAIN/RESEARCH_REQUIRED and the entry is `status: partial`.

**LED-wide conventions (OHMNI decisions).**
- Terminal 1 = CATHODE for all 2-terminal LEDs (THT, chip, PLCC-2), placed at -X; terminal 2 = ANODE at +X. This matches the KiCad LED_THT / LED_SMD convention (pad 1 = K). Other EDA libraries (and IEC-style "A=1") differ; the importer must map by pad name.
- `led_color` is a parameter (red, orange, amber/yellow, green, blue, white). Default OHMNI color for previews: red.
- Lens is a separate sub-body from the case/lead frame so the renderer can apply MAT_PLASTIC_CLEAR (water-clear) or MAT_PLASTIC_DIFFUSED (tinted by led_color).
- Chip LEDs: PKG-LED_CHIP may SHARE the box+terminal-band code of GEN-CHIP_2T (body L/W/H, two end bands) but NOT its materials/decals: it adds an emitter window/lens, a cathode mark, and different body colors. Recommendation to Codex: implement GEN-LED_CHIP as a thin wrapper that calls the GEN-CHIP_2T box/terminal builder with LED dimensions, then adds lens window + cathode mark. Do not reuse PKG-CHIP2T dimension rows (LED heights differ from resistors/MLCCs).

---

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-LED_THT

**Shared geometry (generator GEN-LED_THT).** Round epoxy lamp: from bottom to top: (1) a flange/rim (disc of diameter D_flange, thickness t_flange) with a flat cut on the CATHODE side (-X), (2) a cylindrical barrel of body diameter D, (3) a hemispherical (or slightly flattened/ellipsoidal) dome of radius D/2 on top. Two straight leads emerge from the flange underside along Z, centered on X at +/-pitch/2, pitch 2.54 mm (0.100 in). Anode lead is longer than cathode (cut-and-clinch convention for new parts). Internal reflector cup/die/anvil are visible through clear lenses only; they are LOD2-optional.
- Total height H is measured from flange underside (Z=0 at seating) to dome apex.
- Barrel height = H - t_flange - D/2 (DERIVED).
- Flat on cathode side: vertical planar cut across the flange (and slightly into the barrel base) at x = -(D_flange/2 - flat_depth).
- Lens variants: diffused (MAT_PLASTIC_DIFFUSED, tinted) vs water-clear (MAT_PLASTIC_CLEAR); both same outline.
- Leads: square/rectangular 0.5 mm class; Vishay lists "0.5 +0.15/-0.05" (read as lead cross-section dimension; square vs round not confirmed in extracted text, drawing). OHMNI default: square 0.5 x 0.5.

| 5MM (OHM-074) | 5.0 +/-0.15 H | 5.8 +/-0.15 H-M | 8.7 +/-0.3 M | 1.0 DERIVED (8.7 - 7.7) M | 2.54 nom M | 0.5 (+0.15/-0.05) M | Vishay TLHR540x (S3), KiCad LED_D5.0mm pitch 2.54 |

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-LED_CHIP

**Shared geometry (GEN-LED_CHIP).** Rectangular chip-LED case (EIA 0402/0603/0805/1206 imperial = 1005/1608/2012/3216 metric) with two end terminals on X. Differences from PKG-CHIP2T: (1) the top has an emitter window or low dome lens (water-clear or diffused) occupying roughly the central 40-60% of the length (UNCERTAIN, manufacturer-specific); (2) cathode identification by a mark (green/colored tint on cathode half, notch, or cathode-end Au-plated surface per Vishay VLMTG1400); (3) heights differ by vendor; (4) case is plastic/PCB-substrate (white or black base) not ceramic/MLCC. Terminals are flat gold/tin metallization wrapping the ends (Vishay 0603: pad ~0.4 long per extraction). Can SHARE GEN-CHIP_2T box and terminal-band routines (see LED-wide conventions); cannot share PKG-CHIP2T rows.

# [OHM-073] 3 mm THT LED

## Identity
Canonical name: 3 mm THT LED. ID: OHM-073. Category: optoelectronic. Subcategory: LED (through-hole lamp). Physical package: 3 mm T-1 lamp. Mounting: tht. Aliases: 3 mm T-1 lamp, T-1 LED, 3mm LED. Common variants: diffused/clear, 4 colors+white, low-profile (not modeled). Class B (member of PKG-LED_THT). Priority P0. Complexity 3.

## Physical Dimensions
Family member 3MM (see PKG-LED_THT). Restated (second pass, Vishay TLDR4400 / TLUR4400, drawings 6.544-5264.01-4 and 6.544-5255.01-4): body diameter 2.9 +/-0.1 (nominal 3 mm class), flange diameter 3.2 +/-0.15, total height 4.4 +/-0.3 (flange underside to dome apex), flange thickness 0.4 (+0.15/-0.05), dome radius 1.4 (drawing R1.4), lead pitch 2.54. First-pass placeholders (3.8 / 5.0 / 0.8) are superseded: they were an analogy to the 5 mm lamp and the sourced flange is only +0.3 over the body. KiCad LED_D3.0mm outline r=1.5 (S5) is a courtyard-style circle, not the lamp body.

## Geometry
Flanged round lamp: flange disc (thin, with flat on -X), barrel cylinder, hemispherical dome. Derived barrel height = H - tf - D/2. Lens outline same for diffused or clear.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Two straight square leads, 0.5 x 0.5 (UNCERTAIN square vs round), pitch 2.54, parallel to Z. Terminal 1 = cathode at (-1.27, 0) (short lead, flat side); terminal 2 = anode at (+1.27, 0) (long lead). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (tin-plated; silver-plated variants exist). Tail bottom Z = -2.6 default (cathode); anode tail OHMNI default 1.0 mm longer at LOD2 only (difference not source-verified). No bend at default; optional kink/stand-off not modeled.

## PCB Interface
Footprint: 2 THT holes, drill 0.9 (KiCad LED_D5.0mm/D3.0mm, S5), land 1.8, round pad 2 / square pad 1 (cathode). FCO origin at the midpoint between holes: (0,0) is the body axis. Body flange underside at Z = 0 + standoff (0 default). Pin 1 (cathode) at (-1.27, 0).

## Materials
Lens: MAT_PLASTIC_DIFFUSED (tinted by led_color) or MAT_PLASTIC_CLEAR (water-clear). Leads: MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Optional internal lead frame/reflector (MAT_TIN_BRIGHT/MAT_NICKEL) visible only through clear lens at LOD2. No new tokens.

## Appearance
Colors (typical): red #FF2A1A-ish translucent, orange, amber/yellow, green, blue, white (milky or clear). Diffused lamps show uniformly tinted translucent epoxy; water-clear lamps show the lead frame and die cup. Decal separation: none required; only geometry. Manufacturer variation: dome slightly flattened on wide-angle parts.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode: (1) flat cut on the flange/barrel on the -X side, (2) shorter lead on -X, (3) larger internal anvil/flag on cathode side visible in clear lenses. Anode: long lead at +X. Flag EDA differences: some libraries put anode as pin 1.

## Recognition Features
1) Dome silhouette. 2) Flange with cathode flat. 3) Two leads at 2.54 pitch. 4) Lens tint/clear. 5) Overall height class.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: led_color, lens, dome_profile, lead_len. Coupled: barrel height from H, flange diameter from D.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (flange) boolean-cut by a plane for the flat; cylinder (barrel); sphere or revolve profile (dome); two box extrusions for leads.

## Modeling Procedure
1) Make flange cylinder D_flange x t_flange, base at Z=standoff. 2) Cut flat at x = -(D_flange/2 - flat_depth). 3) Add barrel cylinder D x (H - t_flange - D/2). 4) Add dome of radius D/2 (hemisphere) on top. 5) Merge as single lens sub-body. 6) Add two leads at x=+/-1.27 from Z=-2.6 (cathode) / longer (anode, LOD2) up to flange underside. 7) Assign materials.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: flange disc + barrel cylinder + hemisphere, two lead stubs omitted or minimal. LOD1: flat on flange, both leads to the board tail, lens material. LOD2: lead-length difference, dome ellipticity, internal cup/anvil in clear variant, flange fillet.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: internal cup/die, lead length difference, fillet. NEVER omit: the flange/rim, the cathode flat, 2.54 lead pitch, dome shape, lead holes alignment.

## Sources
See PKG-LED_THT sources. Specific: Vishay TLDR4400 (https://www.vishay.com/docs/83001/tldr4400.pdf, S3, drawing 6.544-5264.01-4): all dimensions above. Vishay TLUR4400/TLUR4401 (https://www.vishay.com/docs/83054/tlur440.pdf) and TLHG44K1M2 (https://www.vishay.com/docs/80319/tlhg44k1m2.pdf), drawing 6.544-5255.01-4: same numbers, body/flange labels swapped in extraction (cross-check). KiCad LED_D3.0mm (S5: pitch 2.54, pad 1 square cathode, drill 0.9). Kingbright L-934SRD-J4 DSAM7493 V.1A 16-Nov-2012 opened earlier: no drawing numbers.

## Research Confidence
Dimensions M (three Vishay documents from two drawings agree; Addendum 7 caps drawing-callout figures at M). Conflict kept: the label association body 2.9 / flange 3.2 comes from the TLDR4400 extraction and is reversed in the TLUR4400/TLHG44K1M2 extractions; adopted because the flange must exceed the body (same as the 5 mm drawing) and because 3.2 + 2.9 equals the set in all three. A second flange figure 3.4 +/-0.15 is unassigned (probably a shoulder or lead sub-dimension) and unused. Flange flat depth and lead cross-section shape (square vs round) remain UNCERTAIN but do not block use. Geometry M, materials M. # [OHM-074] 5 mm THT LED

## Identity
Canonical name: 5 mm THT LED. ID: OHM-074. Category: optoelectronic. Subcategory: LED (through-hole lamp). Physical package: T-1 3/4 lamp. Mounting: tht. Aliases: T-1 3/4 lamp, T-1 3/4, 5mm LED. Common variants: diffused/clear, 4 colors+white, low-profile (not modeled). Class B (member of PKG-LED_THT). Priority P0. Complexity 3.

## Physical Dimensions
Family member 5MM (see PKG-LED_THT). Restated: body diameter 5.0, flange diameter 5.8, total height 8.7 (flange underside to dome apex), flange thickness 1.0, lead pitch 2.54. Basis and confidence per family table. Primary OHMNI THT LED. Kingbright WP7113/L-1503 are same T-1 3/4 class (dims not extracted).

## Geometry
Flanged round lamp: flange disc (thin, with flat on -X), barrel cylinder, hemispherical dome. Derived barrel height = H - tf - D/2. Lens outline same for diffused or clear.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Two straight square leads, 0.5 x 0.5 (UNCERTAIN square vs round), pitch 2.54, parallel to Z. Terminal 1 = cathode at (-1.27, 0) (short lead, flat side); terminal 2 = anode at (+1.27, 0) (long lead). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (tin-plated; silver-plated variants exist). Tail bottom Z = -2.6 default (cathode); anode tail OHMNI default 1.0 mm longer at LOD2 only (difference not source-verified). No bend at default; optional kink/stand-off not modeled.

## PCB Interface
Footprint: 2 THT holes, drill 0.9 (KiCad LED_D5.0mm/D3.0mm, S5), land 1.8, round pad 2 / square pad 1 (cathode). FCO origin at the midpoint between holes: (0,0) is the body axis. Body flange underside at Z = 0 + standoff (0 default). Pin 1 (cathode) at (-1.27, 0).

## Materials
Lens: MAT_PLASTIC_DIFFUSED (tinted by led_color) or MAT_PLASTIC_CLEAR (water-clear). Leads: MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Optional internal lead frame/reflector (MAT_TIN_BRIGHT/MAT_NICKEL) visible only through clear lens at LOD2. No new tokens.

## Appearance
Colors (typical): red #FF2A1A-ish translucent, orange, amber/yellow, green, blue, white (milky or clear). Diffused lamps show uniformly tinted translucent epoxy; water-clear lamps show the lead frame and die cup. Decal separation: none required; only geometry. Manufacturer variation: dome slightly flattened on wide-angle parts.

## Orientation Markings
Cathode: (1) flat cut on the flange/barrel on the -X side, (2) shorter lead on -X, (3) larger internal anvil/flag on cathode side visible in clear lenses. Anode: long lead at +X. Flag EDA differences: some libraries put anode as pin 1.

## Recognition Features
1) Dome silhouette. 2) Flange with cathode flat. 3) Two leads at 2.54 pitch. 4) Lens tint/clear. 5) Overall height class.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: led_color, lens, dome_profile, lead_len. Coupled: barrel height from H, flange diameter from D.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder (flange) boolean-cut by a plane for the flat; cylinder (barrel); sphere or revolve profile (dome); two box extrusions for leads.

## Modeling Procedure
1) Make flange cylinder D_flange x t_flange, base at Z=standoff. 2) Cut flat at x = -(D_flange/2 - flat_depth). 3) Add barrel cylinder D x (H - t_flange - D/2). 4) Add dome of radius D/2 (hemisphere) on top. 5) Merge as single lens sub-body. 6) Add two leads at x=+/-1.27 from Z=-2.6 (cathode) / longer (anode, LOD2) up to flange underside. 7) Assign materials.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: flange disc + barrel cylinder + hemisphere, two lead stubs omitted or minimal. LOD1: flat on flange, both leads to the board tail, lens material. LOD2: lead-length difference, dome ellipticity, internal cup/anvil in clear variant, flange fillet.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: internal cup/die, lead length difference, fillet. NEVER omit: the flange/rim, the cathode flat, 2.54 lead pitch, dome shape, lead holes alignment.

Rectangular epoxy block, vertical, with rounded or flat top (flat top default), sometimes a lens bulge; flat edge marking on cathode side. Two straight leads from the underside.

MAT_PLASTIC_DIFFUSED or MAT_PLASTIC_CLEAR for block; MAT_TIN_BRIGHT leads.

## Appearance
Tinted translucent block; flat color tint of led_color. Cathode side often marked by a flat or corner chamfer.

Cathode side: chamfered top edge or flat on -X side (default chamfer 0.5 UNCERTAIN). EDA polarity differs.

1) Rectangular silhouette. 2) Cathode-side chamfer/flat. 3) 2.54 pin pitch. 4) Translucent tinted body.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: length, width, height, color, lens, orientation. Coupled: pitch fixed 2.54.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box + chamfer + two leads.

## Modeling Procedure
1) Box L x W x H at Z=0. 2) Chamfer top cathode edge. 3) Add leads. 4) Assign lens material.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 box; LOD1 chamfer, leads; LOD2 top lens bulge, fillets.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: lens bulge. NEVER omit: cathode mark, pitch.

1) Box 5.0 x 5.0 x 1.6. 2) Cut cavity, add resin disc. 3) Chamfer top-left corner 0.6. 4) Add six side leads. 5) Materials.

LOD0 box; LOD1 cavity, chamfer, 6 leads; LOD2 J-bend, dies, resin dome.

# [OHM-086] Star LED module

## Identity
Canonical name: Star LED module. ID: OHM-086. Category: optoelectronic. Subcategory: LED. Physical package: 20 mm MCPCB star with one high-power emitter. Mounting: smd. Aliases: LED star, 20 mm star, MCPCB star. Class D. Priority P3. Complexity 4.

## Physical Dimensions
Per cutter.com.au MCPCB-XP20Star: 20 x 20 x 1.7 mm, board thickness 1.65 mm, copper base, ENIG; emitter footprint 3.45 x 3.45. Second pass: LEDSupply INDUS 1-Up Cree XP-E2 20 mm star is described as a 20 mm HEXAGONAL star MCPCB with four large solder pads (https://www.ledsupply.com/leds/1-up-cree-xlamp-xpe2-white-high-power-led, S4), and an RS-hosted 20 mm star datasheet (https://nonprod.docs.rs-online.com/8a51/0900766b810b03f6.pdf, S4) states 'star is nominal 20 mm A/F' (across flats), MCPCB thickness 2 mm, and M3 mounting-hole centres 17.5 mm. So the OHMNI outline is a hexagon 20.0 across flats (outline parameter hex|round, default hex), thickness 1.65-2.0 (default 1.65, vendor range), mounting holes M3 (3.2 drill assumed UNCERTAIN) at 17.5 centre spacing. Overall height DERIVED = 1.65 + emitter H 2.0 = 3.65 (UNCERTAIN L). Pad rectangles and optic holes: still RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

## Geometry
Hexagonal disc (20 mm across flats, default; round selectable) 1.65 thick with solder-mask top, central emitter (OHM-085 instance), 4 small wire pads (2 anode, 2 cathode) near the rim; vendor-dependent star lobes and optic pin holes.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Wire pads rectangular, size RESEARCH_REQUIRED (default 3.0 x 2.0 UNCERTAIN L), placed on +/-X axis; plus the emitter's own pads (child OHM-085). Not modeled: wires.

## PCB Interface
Assembly: board is mounted by thermal adhesive, so its standoff is 0 and its footprint is a wire/pad pattern with emitter at origin. FCO origin = emitter center. Emitter must not be re-originated.

## Materials
Base MAT_COPPER (exposed edge), top solder mask via proposed token MAT_MCPCB_MASK_WHITE (#EDEDE8, 0.5); pads MAT_GOLD; emitter materials from OHM-085.

## Appearance
White solder-mask disc with silver copper edge, gold pads, + and - silk markings, a bright emitter in the center.

## Orientation Markings
+ and - silkscreen near the wire pads. Emitter cathode marker as OHM-085.

## Recognition Features
1) 20 mm across-flats hex disc (or round). 2) Emitter at center. 3) + / - wire pads. 4) Thickness 1.65.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: diameter, thickness, emitter member, outline (hex default | round | lobed star). Coupled: emitter pad pattern.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Cylinder + OHM-085 child + 4 thin boxes (pads) + silk decals.

## Modeling Procedure
1) Disc D x 1.65 with underside at Z=0. 2) Insert OHM-085 on top (Z=1.65). 3) Add pads. 4) Add silk decals.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 disc + emitter box; LOD1 + pads + dome; LOD2 optic holes, lobes.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: lobes, optic holes. NEVER omit: disc, emitter, +/- pads.

Cross-vendor caution: the RS sheet and LEDSupply may describe a different board from cutter's XP20Star; they are not proven identical. Validation: height 3.65 DERIVED; 17.5 hole spacing fits inside 20 across-flats hex.

# G07: Transistor / Power Packages (OHM-093 to OHM-102)

Group scope: PKG-TO92, PKG-SOT23 (3/5/6 lead), PKG-SOT89, PKG-SOT223, PKG-TO126, PKG-TO220, PKG-TO247, PKG-DPAK, PKG-D2PAK, PKG-POWERPAK. Generators: GEN-TO_LEADED (THT) and GEN-SMD_POWER (SMD), per 00_architecture.md Section 15.

## Reader notes that apply to the whole file

1. **Evidence level (Section 17.7).** Every source below was read through a text-extraction fetch tool that summarizes PDFs, not by looking at drawings. Several extracted tables were visibly scrambled (columns shifted, symbols mislabeled). Where a source's table was internally implausible I say so, and I use only values corroborated by a second document or by the document's own title line (for example "20.45 mm x 15.6 mm x 4.95 mm body"). No confidence above M is given for a figure that depends on interpreting a symbol.
2. **Rotation relative to datasheet.** All packages are drawn in OHMNI orientation (Section 6), not datasheet orientation. The applied rotation is stated in each family.
3. **THT tails.** Real TO-92/TO-126/TO-220/TO-247 leads are 12.7 to 15 mm long when uncut. Models use the Section 4 default truncated tail (Z = -2.6) unless an entry says otherwise. This is a modeling truncation, not a package property.
4. **Pin-1 reading of SOT-23 in Section 6.** Section 6 lists SOT-23 inside the "dual-row, rows parallel to Y, pin 1 top-left" row AND gives a separate SOT-23 sentence ("pins 1-2 on the -Y side, pin 1 at -X"). These describe two different 90-degree rotations. This file follows the explicit SOT-23 sentence (rows parallel to X, pin 1 at bottom-left), which is also the datasheet-standard orientation. See "Convention problems" at the end.
6. **Second pass (2026-10-02).** Search and fetch worked again. Added values below come from further S2 documents (Vishay, onsemi, Microchip, NXP/Nexperia, ST via a distributor copy, AOS, TI) still read through text extraction, so drawing-symbol meanings remain inferred and confidence stays capped at M where a symbol had to be interpreted. Where a second-pass document contradicts a first-pass value both are shown and the adopted one is named.
5. **Source tiers.** Nexperia/NXP outline PDFs, onsemi case outlines, Vishay drawings, Diodes Inc package files are S2. Octopart-hosted copy of a Vishay drawing is S4. Manufacturer web pages are S3/S4.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SOT23

**Members:** SOT23-3 (JEDEC TO-236AB per Nexperia SOT23 outline header), SOT23-5 (SOT25, SC-74A per Nexperia SOT753 header; Nexperia name TSOP5), SOT23-6 (SOT26, SC-74 per Nexperia SOT457 header; Nexperia name TSOP6). Used by OHM-094 (G07), OHM-070 (G05), OHM-120, OHM-121 (G08).

**Shared geometry.** Rectangular molded body, long axis along X (the row direction), 2.8 to 3.1 mm long, 1.2 to 1.7 mm wide (Y), about 1.0 to 1.1 mm thick. Gull-wing leads exit the two long side faces (the faces perpendicular to Y) at roughly mid body height, bend down, and end in a flat foot parallel to the board. Leads sit on 0.95 mm pitch along X. Small 0 to 8 degree draft on the body, lead exit slightly below the body mid-plane (not sourced as a number; cosmetic).

**Pin numbering (OHMNI, converted from datasheet standard).** Datasheet standard: viewed from top, pin 1 at bottom-left, numbering counter-clockwise (bottom row left to right, then top row right to left). OHMNI Section 6 SOT-23 sentence is identical: pins 1.. on the -Y side starting at -X, remaining pins on +Y side. No mirror and no rotation is applied. Pin positions below are lead-foot contact centers (Section 17.1) with FCO origin at the center of the pad pattern.

**Member dimension table** (mm; D = body length along X, E = body width along Y, H = body+lead overall height from seating plane, HE = lead-tip to lead-tip span along Y).

| Pins | 3 | 5 | 6 | |
| Pitch e1 (along X) | 0.95 | 0.95 | 0.95 | Nexperia SOT23 e1=0.95, SOT753 e=0.95, SOT457 e=0.95; Diodes SOT26 e=0.95. CONSENSUS (H) |
| Body length D default (min-max) | 2.9 (2.8-3.0) | 2.9 (2.7-3.1) | 2.9 (2.7-3.1) | Nexperia SOT23 D 2.8/2.9/3.0; SOT753 D 2.7-3.1; SOT457 D 2.7-3.1. Diodes SOT23 H 2.80-3.00 typ 2.90; SOT25 C 2.70-3.00 typ 2.80; SOT26 E 2.70-3.00 typ 2.80 (see conflict note) |

Diodes SOT23 C 2.30-2.50 typ 2.40; SOT25 H 2.90-3.10 typ 3.00; SOT26 D 2.90-3.10 typ 3.00 (per Diodes extracted tables, symbol assignment inferred). Nexperia SOT23 vs Diodes: 2.5 vs 2.4 (small conflict); Microchip C04-104 (3-lead SOT-23 TT) E 2.10-2.64 brackets both. **Conflict notes.** (a) Nexperia SOT23 gives only one nominal for HE, E, D; Diodes gives ranges. The OHMNI defaults sit inside both. (b) Nexperia SOT457 extraction contained implausible entries (HE 0.013, Lp 0.25, v 0.23) which are shifted columns; those entries were discarded. (c) Nexperia SOT753 extraction gave bp max 0.26 and c min 0.10 which contradict Diodes' 0.35-0.50 lead width; the Nexperia lead-width value is NOT used for 5/6 lead. Real SC-74A lead widths are normally larger; treat lead width as M. (d) The JEDEC TO-236AB reference appears in the opened Nexperia SOT23 outline header and is cited as such; JEDEC document text itself was not opened. Header references for SC-74A (SOT753) and SC-74 (SOT457) are JEITA-style names as printed by Nexperia.

**Pin coordinates (OHMNI, mm, FCO origin).** x offsets are along the 0.95 pitch.

SOT23-3: pin1 (-0.95, -1.0), pin2 (+0.95, -1.0), pin3 (0, +1.0). (Pin 3 is centered on the +Y side. The e=1.9 mm span between pin 1 and pin 2 is Nexperia SOT23 e=1.9, e1=0.95.)
SOT23-5: pin1 (-0.95, -1.2), pin2 (0, -1.2), pin3 (+0.95, -1.2), pin4 (+0.95, +1.2), pin5 (-0.95, +1.2). The center top position (0, +1.2) is empty.
SOT23-6: pin1 (-0.95, -1.2), pin2 (0, -1.2), pin3 (+0.95, -1.2), pin4 (+0.95, +1.2), pin5 (0, +1.2), pin6 (-0.95, +1.2).
All use the same body center (0, 0); body_offset (0, 0). **Cross-group reconciliation (pass 2).** G05 (OHM-070) and G08 (OHM-120, OHM-121) read G07 for the contact Y and wrote it as -Yc / RESEARCH_REQUIRED_see_PKG-SOT23; both already use pin 1 at x = -0.95, bottom row on -Y, so the orientation agrees with G07. The values they should adopt are the ones above: contact |y| = 1.0 for SOT23-3 (G05 OHM-070) and 1.2 for SOT23-5/-6 (G08), x = -0.95, 0, +0.95. Pin 1 mark: a small molded dimple on the top face near pin 1 corner OR no mark (many SOT-23 parts have none; the part marking orientation defines pin 1). Default LOD1: decal dot only.

**Generator notes (GEN-SMD_POWER, sub-generator SOT23).** Parameters: pin_count in {3,5,6}, D, E, A, A1, b, c, foot length, lead-tip span. Body = box with draft at LOD2. Lead = three-segment polyline (horizontal stub from body side, 40 to 60 degree down bend of vertical length approx (body_mid height - c), flat foot), swept with rectangular b x c section. Coupled: HE = 2*(lead contact Y) + foot length. Do not add a thermal pad.

**Family sources.** Nexperia outline drawings SOT23 (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/outline-drawing/SOT23.pdf, 12 Oct 2022, JEDEC TO-236AB), SOT753 (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/outline-drawing/SOT753.pdf, 31 May 2022, SC-74A), SOT457 (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/outline-drawing/SOT457.pdf, 3 Mar 2023, SC-74); Diodes Inc package files SOT23 (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Package-Files/SOT23.pdf), SOT25 (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Package-Files/SOT25.pdf), SOT26 (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Package-Files/SOT26.pdf). Revision dates for Diodes files not shown in extraction. All S2, text-extraction. Pass 2 added: Microchip drawing C04-104 Rev C, 3-lead SOT-23 (TT) (https://onlinedocs.microchip.com/oxy/GUID-A2F9191F-AF17-4DDB-81BD-F8DF95CC2D5A-en-US-3/GUID-9066C761-A689-4C9B-A8F1-3DA5AFFB3032-high.pdf: e 0.95, e1 1.90, A 0.89-1.12, A1 0.01-0.10, A2 0.79-1.02, D 2.67-3.05, E 2.10-2.64, E1 1.16-1.40, b 0.30-0.54, c 0.08-0.20, L 0.13-0.60) and Microchip C04-091-OT Rev H, 5-lead SOT-23 (via the Octopart-hosted MCP6006 drawing, https://sigma.octopart.com/166548960/technical_drawing/Microchip-MCP6006T-E-OT.pdf; symbols scrambled, used only as the 2.80 span hint); onsemi case 318 SOT-23 (TO-236) 2.90x1.30x1.00 1.90P (issue AU, 14 Aug 2024, title only); ADI RT-3 SOT-23-3 drawing states compliance with JEDEC TO-236-AB (extraction scrambled, not used for numbers). S2.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SOT89

**Shape.** Flat molded body 4.5 (X) x 2.5 (Y) x 1.5 (Z). Three leads on the -Y side at 1.5 mm pitch. The center lead continues inside the package to a wide metal tab/heat-spreader that exits the opposite (+Y) face and bends down to a soldering foot. The center lead and the +Y tab are the same electrical pin (pin 2, collector/drain/output). Nexperia: JEDEC TO-243, JEITA SC-62 (from opened SOT89 header).

Derivation: HE/2 = 2.05, minus L/2 = 0.52 gives about 1.5. Tab lies on +Y. Section 6 3-lead rule satisfied (leads along X, pin 1 at -X, tab +Y). Pass-2 check: onsemi 528AG H 4.05-4.25 measured "at datum plane C" gives the same 4.1 span.
**Tab detail.** The tab protrudes about (HE - E)/2 = 0.8 mm beyond the body on +Y. The visible tab width 1.73 (onsemi D2 1.60-1.90) is narrower than the body (2.5 wide in Y is the body thickness direction; the 4.5 length is along X). Tab bends down at the +Y end to a flat foot of about the same length as the lead feet.
**Variants.** SOT-89-5: onsemi 528AB (23 Nov 2009): same D 4.40-4.60 and E 2.40-2.60, e 1.40-1.60, H 4.25-4.45, L 1.10-1.50, lead thickness c 0.30-0.50; pin map not captured (see OHM-207).
**Generator note:** same sub-generator as DPAK-class SMD but with three flat leads and a wide center tab; no thermal pad under the body.
**Family sources:** Nexperia SOT89 outline (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/outline-drawing/SOT89.pdf, 12 Nov 2024); Diodes SOT89.pdf (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Package-Files/SOT89.pdf); onsemi case 528AG SOT-89 3-lead (https://www.onsemi.com/download/package-drawing/pdf/528ag.pdf, issue 04 Mar 2014, pass 2) and 528AB SOT-89 5-lead (https://www.onsemi.com/download/package-drawing/pdf/528ab.pdf, 23 Nov 2009, pass 2). S2.

| Lead styles | straight (default, bulk), bent/kinked (tape and reel), formed (ammo) | onsemi 29-11 header lists straight, bent, formed |

**Lead forms.** STRAIGHT is the OHMNI default. Bent and formed ("inline kink") are parameter options. Second-pass findings: (1) onsemi case 182-06 (TO-92 (TO-226), issue 18 Apr 1998) lists G 1.27 BSC and H 2.54 BSC with the note "lead dimension is uncontrolled in P and beyond dimension K minimum" (K 12.70 min), so the formed form re-spreads from 1.27 to 2.54 mm adjacent spacing (outer leads move out 1.27 each, centre lead stays), and the bend happens inside the uncontrolled zone P just below the body (Nexperia L1 gives that zone as 2.5 max). (2) TI LP0003A (TO-92, drawing 4215214/C, 04/2025) shows a straight option (bulk) and a formed option (tape and reel / ammo) with 2.54 spacing and reference callouts "(1.5) TYP" and "(0.51) TYP"; the two extraction runs assigned different meanings to those callouts, so kink height, kink angle and bend radius remain RESEARCH_REQUIRED. Modeled option: leads straight from the body for `kink_start` mm (default 2.5, the uncontrolled zone upper bound) then a step to 2.54 mm adjacent spacing (lead axes at -2.54, 0, +2.54) when `lead_form = formed`; spacing SOURCED (M), kink shape UNCERTAIN.

**OHMNI orientation.** Section 17.3: leads in a row along X, pin 1 at -X. Flat marked face toward -Y, dome toward +Y; viewed from the flat face pin 1 is on the left. Pin 1 is NOT always emitter; function mapping is outside scope. Lead axes: pin1 (-1.27, 0), pin2 (0, 0), pin3 (+1.27, 0). OHMNI decision: the lead row lies on y = 0 and the body bbox is centered on it, so the flat face is at y = -thickness/2 and the dome apex at y = +thickness/2 (DERIVED, L; in real parts the leads are closer to the flat face than the midline, but no opened source gives the offset). body_offset (0, 0).

**Standoff.** Default 0 (body bottom at Z = 0, per Section 5). Real parts commonly sit 0.5-2 mm above the board; `standoff_mm` is a parameter 0-3.
**Family sources:** Nexperia SOT54 (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/outline-drawing/SOT54.pdf, 30 Jan 2017); onsemi case outline 29-11 (https://www.onsemi.com/download/package-drawing/pdf/29-11.pdf); Diodes TO92.pdf (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Package-Files/TO92.pdf); second pass: onsemi case 182-06 (https://www.onsemi.com/pub/Collateral/182-06.PDF, TO-92 (TO-226), 04/18/1998, doc 98ASB42118B; A 4.45-5.21, B 4.32-5.33, C 3.18-4.19, D 0.407-0.533, G 1.27 BSC, H 2.54 BSC, K 12.70 min, L 6.35 min); TI LP0003A TO-92 (https://ti.com/lit/pdf/msot002, drawing 4215214/C, 04/2025; straight and formed options, 2.54 formed spacing, 12.7 min lead); onsemi 135AN (TO-92 3 4.825x4.76) header only. S2, text-extraction.

- 3-lead (default): pins at x = -2.54, 0, +2.54, y = 0.
- 2-lead: center lead absent (pins 1 and 3 at -2.54, +2.54, i.e. 5.08 pitch). onsemi 340AZ "TO220-2 10.16x15.37x4.19, 5.08P" and 221AG "TO-220 FULLPACK, 2-LEAD" support this.
- 5-lead straight (Nexperia/NXP SOT263): 1.7 mm pitch, pins at x = -3.4, -1.7, 0, +1.7, +3.4; body 15.5 x 10 x 4.3 (D 15.2-15.8, E 9.7-10.3, A 4.1-4.5); lead width 0.6-0.8. Staggered/formed TO-220-5 geometry: RESEARCH_REQUIRED (the LTC 05-08-1491 extraction lists lead span callouts 5.84-6.86 and 8.38-9.40 that could not be assigned).
- 4-lead TO-220: no document found, RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

- Horizontal/bent-down mounting forms exist; not modeled (RESEARCH_REQUIRED).

Assumption that the leads are centered on the plastic thickness is L-M (the drawing's Q 2.60-2.84 would match a lead plane 2.72 from the back face against 2.86 assumed).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-DPAK

**Naming (read this).** "TO-252", "DPAK", "SOT428", "DPAK-3" and "TO-252AA" are the same footprint family. The opened Nexperia SOT428 header literally reads "JEDEC TO-252, industry code DPAK". onsemi calls its drawing "DPAK-3 6.10x6.54x2.28, 2.29P" (case 369AA, document 98AON13126D). Diodes calls it "TO252 (DPAK)". "D2PAK" is NOT this package (see PKG-D2PAK) and "IPAK" (TO-251) is the through-hole sibling with straight leads (not opened, not modeled). Variants with 2 or 5 leads exist (TO-252-2L/-5L) but were not opened; RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

**Shape.** Molded body about 6.1 (X) wide, 6.6 (Y) long and 2.3 (Z) tall. A metal tab (drain) is embedded in the plastic with its underside exposed and extends about 1.1 mm past the plastic on the +Y edge (5.33 wide at the tip), forming the heat-spreader soldered to a copper pad. Two leads (pins 1 and 3) on the -Y side at 2.29 mm pitch; the center lead is cropped (absent or a stub up to 1.02 long) and the tab IS pin 2/4.

**Closure check (pass 2).** H 9.91 = plastic 6.58 + tab extension 1.08 + 2.25 of lead beyond the plastic. 2.25 equals the 1.59 foot plus a bend run, so the plastic is E long and the tab protrudes about 1.1. If E were plastic plus tab the leads would run 3.4 mm beyond it, which does not fit a 1.59 foot. The first-pass plastic length of 5.3 (from Nexperia D1, assignment inferred) is withdrawn.

**Pin positions (OHMNI, FCO).** Leads toward -Y, tab on +Y (Section 6). pin1 (-2.29, -4.1), pin3 (+2.29, -4.1), tab/pin 2 (and drain) at (0, +2.5) (pad center). Derivation: lead foot center = 9.91/2 - 1.59/2 = 4.16, rounded to 4.1; Diodes land pattern puts the lead pad centers at +/-4.05 and tab pad center at 2.5 relative to a 10.70 pad extent. The pad bbox center = origin. The cropped middle lead (pin 2) is omitted by default; optional stub protruding up to 1.0 from the plastic.
**Z structure (DERIVED, M-L).** Tab underside at Z = 0 (tab 0.6 thick, embedded, bottom exposed); plastic Z 0.08 .. 2.29; leads exit the -Y plastic face at Z about 1.2 and bend down to the foot at Z = 0 .. 0.52. Plastic y in [-2.705, +3.875]; tab tip at y = +4.955; body bbox (plastic + tab) center (0, +1.13).
**Family sources:** Nexperia SOT428 (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/outline-drawing/SOT428.pdf, 20 May 2022, JEDEC TO-252 / DPAK); NXP SOT428 PDF (https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/package-information/SOT428.pdf, table scrambled, only the "plastic body may have 45 degree chamfer" note used); onsemi 369AA (https://www.onsemi.com/pub/Collateral/369AA.PDF, issue C, title line only, table not captured in two attempts); Diodes TO252-DPAK.pdf (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Package-Files/TO252-DPAK.pdf); pass 2: Vishay D-PAK (TO-252AA) "M" doc 95627 rev 24-Jun-16 (https://www.vishay.com/docs/95627/d-pakto-252aa-m.pdf) and Vishay TO-252AA doc 71197 rev 03-Oct-2022 (https://www.vishay.com/docs/71197/to252aa.pdf). S2.

**Naming.** D2PAK = TO-263 (JEDEC reference per Nexperia SOT404 header: "D2PAK (JEDEC reference TO-263)"). Also seen: onsemi "D2PAK, 3-LEAD, STRAIGHT" (case 418), which is the unformed through-hole variant, and Diodes "TO263-5" (5-lead, 1.7 mm pitch). ## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-POWERPAK

**Scope and DISTINCTION (do not confuse).** PKG-POWERPAK in this file is **Vishay PowerPAK SO-8 (single)**: a 5.15 x 6.15 mm body, about 1.04 mm tall, eight leads (pins 1-3 source, 4 gate, 5-8 drain) on 1.27 mm pitch on the two long sides, with a large exposed drain pad on the underside. It is NOT:
- **SO-8FL / DFN5 5x6** (onsemi case 488AA "DFN5 5x6, 1.27P (SO-8FL)", opened): same 5.15 x 6.15 footprint class but only FIVE terminals (pins 1-3 source, pin 4 gate, pin 5 = the exposed drain pad as a single large lead), height 1.20-1.35 mm (vs 1.04 mm). Different pin geometry. Documented here only as a distinction; not an OHMNI entry. Dimensions from the opened onsemi extraction; table partly questionable (exposed-pad entries E1 5.70-5.90 x D1 4.70-4.90).
- **PowerPAK SO-8L** (Vishay, opened in https://www.vishay.com/docs/76666/powerpak.pdf, drawing 6067 rev 18 Sep 2023): A 1.00-1.10, D1 4.80-5.00, E 6.05-6.25, lead width 0.33-0.49, L 0.62-0.82 (with gull-wing-like leads). A separate package.
- **LFPAK / PSOF / DFN-type "SO-8 style" packages** (not opened). Do not model with this family.

**Shape (PowerPAK SO-8 single, Vishay drawing 5881, document 71655, rev 13-Feb-17; table re-read in pass 2 from the official Vishay datasheets Si7898DP and SiR180DP).** Molded body; leads are flat, formed from the lead frame, barely extending beyond the plastic. Bottom-side: exposed copper drain pad plus separate source/gate pads (source pins 1-3 and gate pin 4 on one long side; drain pins 5-8 attached to the pad on the other side).

# [OHM-093] TO-92 transistor
## Identity
- Canonical name: TO-92 transistor (3-lead, straight leads)
- ID: OHM-093, slug `transistor_to92`
- Category: semiconductor / bipolar or small-signal MOSFET / regulator (any 3-lead TO-92 function)
- Physical package: PKG-TO92 (JEDEC TO-92 per Nexperia SOT54 header; onsemi also names it TO-226)
- Mounting: THT
- Aliases: TO-92, TO-226 (onsemi title), SOT54 (Nexperia), SC-43A (JEITA per Nexperia header)
- Common variants: straight leads (default), bent/kinked leads (tape and reel), formed leads (ammo pack); 2-lead and 3-lead.
- Class A (manifest), P0, complexity 2; parametric = yes.
## Physical Dimensions
Per PKG-TO92. Default: body 4.6 (width, X) x 3.7 (thickness, Y) x 4.8 (height, Z), lead spacing 1.27, lead 0.45 x 0.40, uncut length 12.7-15.0 (modeled tail to Z=-2.6). Basis CONSENSUS (3 manufacturers), confidence M because symbol meanings differ between documents.
## Geometry
Extruded D-shape: flat front face (-Y) and a half-cylindrical back (+Y) of radius about thickness. Body height 4.8 with the dome axis vertical. The dome is a half-ellipse in the XY section (half-width 2.3 in X, depth 3.7 in Y total including the flat-to-diameter offset: model as a half-cylinder of radius 2.3 plus 1.4 mm of straight box thickness at the flat side, which together give 3.7). Top of the dome slightly rounded (R about 0.5, LOD2). Bottom face flat. Flat face is slightly recessed / marking panel (cosmetic).
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
3 leads, flat ribbon 0.45 wide (X) x 0.40 thick (Y), lead axes at x = -1.27, 0, +1.27 (pitch 1.27, outer to outer 2.54), y = 0. Straight, emerging from the flat bottom, extending to Z = -2.6 (truncated). Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Pin 1 at -X when the flat face looks toward -Y (viewer at -Y). Numbering 1, 2, 3 left to right. Function assignment (EBC, CBE, GDS etc.) varies by part and is not a geometry concern.
## PCB Interface
THT holes; pin 1 at (-1.27, 0). Common footprints use 2.54 mm inline pitch (leads 1.27 spacing, in-line) or the staggered "formed" 2.54 pitch for bent-lead parts. Standoff default 0. FCO origin = middle lead, body_offset (0, 0).
## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK (marking face lighter laser region optional); leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
## Appearance
Black matte body; white or lighter-gray marking on the flat face (part number, date code). Lead finish bright tin. Some regulators/references have a gray body. Decals optional at LOD0.
## Orientation Markings
The flat face itself is the orientation feature; no pin-1 dot. Pin 1 is leftmost looking at the flat face.
## Recognition Features
1. Half-round dome with flat face. 2. Three thin parallel leads at 1.27 mm spacing. 3. Roughly 4.6 x 4.8 body with long straight leads. 4. Flat face direction (-Y).
## Parametric Variants
lead_form {straight, kinked, formed}, kink_start 0-2.5 (default 2.5, below the body), standoff 0-3, tail length, body size sliders within source ranges. Coupling: lead spacing fixed 1.27 for straight; formed form re-spreads to 2.54 adjacent spacing (onsemi 182-06 H, TI LP0003A), kink below the body only; kink height/angle UNCERTAIN.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Extrude a D-profile along Z; three swept rectangular leads.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Build the D profile (flat at y = -T/2, half-round back). 2. Extrude 4.8 in Z from Z = 0 (plus standoff). 3. Round the top edge (LOD2). 4. Add three leads from the bottom to Z = -2.6. 5. Apply flat face decal.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0: D-extrusion + three thin boxes. LOD1: leads and flat face, top edge bevel, decal. LOD2: dome rounding, lead shoulder, mold parting line.
## Simplification Rules
May omit: parting line, ejector marks, lead shoulder. Never omit: flat face direction, dome, three leads at 1.27 spacing.

Resolved in pass 2: formed-lead adjacent spacing 2.54 (onsemi 182-06 H 2.54 BSC against G 1.27 BSC; TI LP0003A 2.54), kink located inside the uncontrolled zone just below the body (onsemi note, Nexperia L1 2.5 max). # [OHM-094] SOT-23 transistor
## Identity
- Canonical name: SOT-23 transistor (3-lead)
- ID OHM-094, slug `transistor_sot23`; Category semiconductor / transistor (BJT, small MOSFET); Package PKG-SOT23 member SOT23-3; Mounting SMD
- Aliases: SOT-23, SOT23-3, TO-236AB (JEDEC reference printed in Nexperia SOT23 header; JEDEC text not opened)
- Variants: SOT-23-3 is the entry; SOT-23-5 and -6 are OHM-120/121. SOT-23R/ reverse pinouts exist (function).
- Class B, P0, complexity 2; parametric yes.
## Physical Dimensions
Per PKG-SOT23, SOT23-3 column: D 2.9, E 1.3, A 1.0, A1 0.05, b 0.38, c 0.11, HE 2.5, foot 0.45, pitch 0.95 (e = 1.9 between pin 1 and 2). Basis CONSENSUS / MFR_DRAWING, M-H.
## Geometry
Box body 2.9 x 1.3 x about 0.95 (thickness at body, A less standoff and lead), edges drafted 0-8 degrees (LOD2). Gull-wing leads on both long sides: two on -Y, one centered on +Y.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
3 gull-wing leads, 0.38 wide, 0.11 thick, foot 0.45, lead exit near mid-body. Pin 1 (-0.95, -1.0), pin 2 (+0.95, -1.0), pin 3 (0, +1.0). Counter-clockwise numbering from top view, pin 1 bottom-left (matches Section 6 SOT-23 sentence and datasheet standard). Pin 3 is the lone pin on the opposite side. Material MAT_TIN_BRIGHT/MATTE.
## PCB Interface
SMD pads (Diodes land pattern: 0.8 x 0.9 pads at 2.0 center spacing across Y, pad X1 1.35 for pin 3). Standoff 0.05. FCO at the center of the pad pattern (0, 0); body_offset (0, 0).
## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK; leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
## Appearance
Black matte, laser/ink code (1-3 characters) on top; no standard pin-1 mark. Color range black to dark gray.
## Orientation Markings
No mandatory pin-1 mark; the lone pin side is +Y. Optional pin-1 dot decal at the (-X,-Y) corner. Marking orientation is by convention.
## Recognition Features
1. 2.9 x 1.3 body with three leads (2 + 1). 2. Lone lead centered on the long side. 3. Gull-wing feet. 4. Very low height (about 1 mm).
## Parametric Variants
Body D/E within ranges, lead width, standoff; pin_count 3 (this entry). Coupled: HE = 2*|pin y| + foot length.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Box + three swept gull-wing leads.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Body box from Z = 0.05 (standoff) to top Z = 1.0. 2. Leads: stub from body face at mid height, bend down 45 degrees, foot to Z = 0. 3. Mirror for the +Y lead at x = 0. 4. Code decal.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + three foot boxes. LOD1: gull-wing leads, top-face decal. LOD2: draft, lead bend radii.
## Simplification Rules
May omit: draft, lead radii, marking text. Never omit: 2+1 lead arrangement, pin 1 at bottom-left, gull-wing silhouette.

# [OHM-095] SOT-89 transistor
## Identity
- Canonical name: SOT-89 transistor; ID OHM-095, slug `transistor_sot89`; semiconductor / transistor; PKG-SOT89; SMD
- Aliases: SOT89, TO-243 (JEDEC per Nexperia header), SC-62 (JEITA per header), SOT-89-3
- Variants: 3-lead (this), 5-lead SOT-89-5 exists but not opened.
- Class A, P2, complexity 2.
## Physical Dimensions
Per PKG-SOT89: body 4.5 x 2.5 x 1.5, outer-lead pitch 1.5 (3.0 outer to outer), lead span 4.1, outer lead width 0.45, center lead 0.52, tab 1.73, lead thickness 0.40, foot 1.05. M-H (three documents: Nexperia, Diodes, onsemi 528AG).
## Geometry
Flat body with chamfered edges; three leads on -Y; the center lead widens into a tab visible on +Y (the tab face is a flat metal plate at the +Y end, bent down).
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Pin 1 (-1.5, -1.5), pin 2 (0, -1.5) plus tab foot (0, +1.5), pin 3 (+1.5, -1.5). Outer leads 0.45 wide; center lead 0.52 at its foot. Tab foot width 1.73. Thickness 0.40. Pin 2 = tab. Material tin.
## PCB Interface
SMD; Diodes land pattern: outer pads 0.58 x 1.63, center pad 0.76 wide, tab pad 1.933 wide, total 4.53. Standoff 0.05. body_offset (0, 0).
## Materials
Body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK; leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
## Appearance
Black body, laser code on top; metal tab shows tin-matte.
## Orientation Markings
No pin-1 dot; the tab side is +Y and pin 1 is at -X on the lead side. Some bodies have a molded corner chamfer toward pin 1 (not verified).
## Recognition Features
1. Three leads on one side with a wide tab opposite. 2. 4.5 x 2.5 flat body. 3. Center lead is the wide tab's continuation.
## Parametric Variants
pitch fixed 1.5; tab width, lead width, standoff.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Box with sloped chamfers, 3 gull-wing leads, 1 wide tab.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Body box 4.5 x 2.5 x ~1.4 at Z up to 1.5. 2. Outer leads at x = +/-1.5 to the -Y foot. 3. Center lead at x = 0 to -Y foot. 4. Tab at +Y: plate 1.73 wide leaving the +Y face, bent down, foot at Z = 0. 5. Decal.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0 box + four feet; LOD1 bent leads/tab; LOD2 chamfers/radii.
## Simplification Rules
May omit chamfers, marking. Never omit the wide +Y tab and 3-lead arrangement.

# [OHM-096] SOT-223 transistor/regulator
## Identity
- Canonical name: SOT-223 transistor/regulator; ID OHM-096, slug `transistor_sot223`; semiconductor / transistor or LDO regulator; PKG-SOT223; SMD
- Aliases: SOT223, SC-73 (JEITA per Nexperia header), SOT-223-4, TO-261 (not seen in opened documents; omitted)
- Variants: 3 small leads + 1 tab (4 terminals); regulators map pins as GND/OUT/IN with tab = OUT or GND; function not geometric.
- Class A, P0, complexity 2.
## Physical Dimensions
Per PKG-SOT223: body 6.5 x 3.5 x 1.65, pitch 2.3, lead width 0.70, tab 3.0, thickness 0.28, span 7.0, foot 0.95. M-H; corroborated by Vishay 91363 (JEDEC TO-261AA).
## Geometry
Molded box with a gull-wing 3-lead side (-Y) and a wide tab (3.0) on +Y, both bent down.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
Pin 1 (-2.3, -3.05), pin 2 (0, -3.05), pin 3 (+2.3, -3.05), pin 4 = tab (0, +3.05, width 3.0). Tab is at the opposite side of pins 1-3. Pin 4 is electrically tied to pin 2 (common). Thickness 0.28, tin.
## PCB Interface
SMD, Diodes pad layout: lead pads 1.20 x 1.60 at pitch 2.30; tab pad 3.30 x 1.60; C1 6.40; total 8.0. Standoff 0.05. body_offset (0, 0).
## Materials
MAT_EPOXY_BLACK body; MAT_TIN_BRIGHT leads/tab.
## Appearance
Black, 1-2 lines of marking; tab matte tin.
## Orientation Markings
Tab on +Y is the orientation feature; pin 1 at -X (left of three leads). Some bodies have a 45-degree chamfer or pin-1 dot at the pin-1 corner.
## Recognition Features
1. Wide tab opposite the three leads. 2. 6.5 x 3.5 body. 3. Four feet total.
## Parametric Variants
tab width, lead width, standoff. Coupled: tab foot center = lead foot center y.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Box + three narrow gull-wing leads + wide gull-wing tab.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Box 6.5 x 3.5 up to Z=1.65. 2. Three leads at x = -2.3, 0, 2.3 out of -Y face. 3. Tab 3.0 wide out of +Y face. 4. Feet to Z=0. 5. Decal.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0 box + four feet; LOD1 bent leads/tab; LOD2 radii, chamfer.
## Simplification Rules
Never omit the tab or its +Y location. May omit chamfer.

Rectangular plastic slab with a flat metal back plate on the +Y face (about 1.2 thick, flush with the back) and a through-hole near the top edge; small chamfered top corners (size not sourced). Hole passes through plate and body.

Pins at (-2.28, 0), (0, 0), (+2.28, 0). Flat leads 0.76 x 0.5 with a wider (1.32) shoulder just below the body. Pin 2 tied to the plate. Tin.

Metal back faces +Y; pin 1 at -X when viewed from the marking face.

1. Tall slab with hole near top. 2. Three leads at 2.28. 3. Metal back plate.

hole on/off, standoff, lead length.

Box with a cylindrical through-cut; three rectangular leads.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Body box 7.6 x 2.6 x 10.8 from Z = standoff, y in [-1.3, +1.3]. 2. Metal plate on the +Y face, y in [+0.1, +1.3]. 3. Cut hole Ø3.2 at 3.75 below the top along Y. 4. Leads to Z = -2.6. 5. Decal.

# [OHM-098] TO-220 transistor/MOSFET
## Identity
- Canonical name: TO-220 transistor/MOSFET (3-lead default); ID OHM-098, slug `transistor_to220`; semiconductor / power transistor, MOSFET, regulator; PKG-TO220; THT
- Aliases: TO-220AB (JEDEC per Nexperia SOT78 header and an opened manufacturer drawing "within allowable dimensions of Rev. J of JEDEC TO-220AB"), SOT78, TO-220-3, TO220
- Variants: 3-lead (default); 2-lead (center lead absent, pitch 5.08, onsemi 340AZ); 5-lead straight 1.7 mm pitch (Nexperia SOT263, OHM-208 proposed); 4-lead and formed/staggered leads (RESEARCH_REQUIRED); fully isolated TO-220F / FullPAK (onsemi 221AG 2-lead, 221AH 3-lead).
- Class A, P0, complexity 3; parametric yes.
## Physical Dimensions
Per PKG-TO220 (second-pass values): width 10.1 (X), overall height 15.25, thickness 4.45 (plastic 3.18 + tab 1.27), tab protrusion above plastic 6.22, hole Ø3.8, pitch 2.54, lead 0.8 x 0.45 (shoulder 1.27 wide over 3.56), uncut length 13.7. M-H (hole position L).
## Geometry
Upright slab: plastic (10.1 x 3.18 x 9.03) with small top-corner chamfers; metal tab on +Y (10.1 wide, 1.27 thick) rising 6.22 above the plastic; Ø3.8 hole through the tab, center about 3.2 below the tab top (DERIVED, L; the hole circle must fit inside the 6.22 exposed height and the opened drawings give no location callout I could read); top corners of the tab rounded/chamfered (size not sourced; 1 mm cosmetic). Leads exit the bottom face.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
3 leads at x = -2.54, 0, +2.54, y = 0. Each lead has a wider shoulder (1.27 wide, 3.56 long, the zone where the manufacturer drawing leaves lead dimension and finish uncontrolled) below the plastic, then narrows to 0.8 x 0.45 down to the tail (truncated Z = -2.6). Pin 1 at -X. Pin 2 center, electrically tied to the tab. 2-lead variant omits pin 2. 5-lead straight variant: pins at x = -3.4, -1.7, 0, +1.7, +3.4 (SOT263, 1.7 pitch), lead width 0.6-0.8; formed (staggered) lead geometry RESEARCH_REQUIRED. Tin plated.
## PCB Interface
THT holes (typical 1.0-1.2 mm drills; not sourced). Footprint pad pattern = 3 holes at 2.54. FCO at pin 2. body_offset (0, +0.64) (plastic y in [-1.59, +1.59], tab to +2.86; DERIVED, assumes leads centered on the plastic thickness; consistent with the drawing's Q 2.60-2.84 if Q is the lead-plane-to-back distance, interpretation L). Standoff default 0; `standoff` 0-3 supported.
## Materials
Plastic MAT_EPOXY_BLACK; tab MAT_NICKEL or MAT_TIN_MATTE (satin silver); leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Isolated variant: plastic everywhere, no metal.
## Appearance
Black body with marking on -Y face, silver tab on back. TO-220F: all black with silver leads.
## Orientation Markings
Metal tab at +Y; pin 1 at -X (left looking at the marked front). Front face is the plastic -Y face.
## Recognition Features
1. Tab with mounting hole above the plastic. 2. Three leads at 2.54. 3. 10 mm width, about 15.3 mm height. 4. Tab at back, marking at front.
## Parametric Variants
lead_count {2,3,5}, isolated {false,true}, standoff, tab hole on/off, tail length. Coupled: isolated => plastic covers tab; thickness remains 4.45; lead_count 5 => pitch 1.7.
## Recommended Base Geometry
Two boxes (plastic, tab), cylindrical cut, three stepped lead extrusions.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Plastic box y in [-1.59, 1.59], Z from standoff to standoff+9.03. 2. Tab plate y in [1.59, 2.86], from the plastic bottom up to the tab top at standoff+15.25. 3. Cut Ø3.8 hole at Z = top - 3.2. 4. Leads: shoulder then narrow lead, Z to -2.6. 5. Decals.
## LOD Strategy
LOD0 two boxes + three lead boxes; LOD1 hole, shoulders, tab chamfer; LOD2 fillets, ejector marks, lead bends.
## Simplification Rules
Never omit hole, tab, three leads. May omit shoulders at LOD0.
