## Orientation Markings
Pin names silkscreened along the header; pin 1 is the left pin when the display reads upright with the header at the bottom; VCC/GND order varies, check silkscreen.

## Recognition Features
1. Small square PCB with 4 holes. 2. Black rectangular glass panel with active window. 3. 4-pin header at the bottom edge. 4. Silkscreen text.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: pcb_size (26/27/30), pcb_color, header_pin_count (4/7), hole_diameter, standoff (header housing 2.5). Coupled: panel width <= pcb width; header row inside the PCB; holes near the PCB corners (qeda numbers for 27 mm board).

Box PCB; box glass panel; thin box active decal; box + cylinders for header; cylinders for hole cuts.

1. PCB with holes and header holes. 2. Spacer + panel. 3. Active-area decal. 4. Header housing under PCB, pins through. 5. Silkscreen decals.

LOD0: PCB box + panel box. LOD1: holes, header pins and housing, active window decal. LOD2: flex fold, silkscreen, solder joints, glass edge bevel.

# [OHM-143] 3225 SMD crystal
## Identity
- Canonical name: 3225 SMD crystal; ID OHM-143; slug xtal_3225
- Category: frequency; Subcategory: SMD quartz crystal, metal-lid ceramic package
- Physical package: PKG-XTAL_SMD member XTAL_SMD.3225; surface mount
- Names: metric code 3225 = 3.2 x 2.5 mm (00_architecture Section 12); imperial code not used in the industry for these, do not confuse with chip sizes.
- Aliases: 3225 crystal, 3.2x2.5 SMD crystal. Variants: 2-pad vs 4-pad (see family note), height, load capacitance (electrical only).
- Class B, priority P0, complexity 2.

## Physical Dimensions
Restated from PKG-XTAL_SMD: length (X) 3.2, width (Y) 2.5, height default 0.8, max 1.0 (NDK NX3225GD: 0.80 typ, max 1.0; Abracon ABM8G 1.0 max; Epson FA-238 0.7 and TSX-3225 0.6 are thinner vendor variants). Tolerance L/W +/-0.1 (NDK). Pads (OHMNI default, DERIVED/UNCERTAIN; real values RESEARCH_REQUIRED): 1.0 (X) x 0.9 (Y), centers X +/-1.1, Y +/-0.8. Basis MFR_DATASHEET for L/W/H max; confidence M for L/W/H, L for pads.

## Geometry
Ceramic base box 3.2 x 2.5 x ~0.56 (about 70 percent of height, DERIVED) topped by a metal lid 3.0 x 2.3 x ~0.24 (lid inset 0.1 per side, DERIVED, UNCERTAIN) that sits on the ceramic ring. Four metallized pads wrap the bottom corners and appear as small notches or wraparound strips on the side faces (castellation optional at LOD2). Lid has a small chamfer or corner mark; the part-number print reads left to right with pin 1 at the upper-left corner (NDK/Epson; Abracon prints pin 1 at lower-left).

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
4 flat pads: pad numbering (OHMNI default: pin 1 top-left per NDK/Epson, counter-clockwise; Abracon variant has pin 1 bottom-left): 1 = (-1.1, 0.8), 2 = (-1.1, -0.8), 3 = (1.1, -0.8), 4 = (1.1, 0.8) (counter-clockwise direction inferred; vendor texts fix only pin 1). Pads 1 and 3 are the crystal terminals, 2 and 4 are NC/ground (diagonal). Pad shape flat rectangle 1.0 x 0.9, thickness 0.02 (visual), MAT_GOLD. 2-pad variant (not default): pads at the two short ends, full width. DELTA vs Addendum 17.2 recorded in the family section.

## PCB Interface
SMD pads on the land pattern; body centered on the pad pattern: body_offset (0,0). Standoff 0 (underside at Z = 0). Pin 1 at (-1.1, 0.8) (center of the pad contact area).

## Materials
Base MAT_CERAMIC_PKG_TAN (proposed token; alt MAT_CERAMIC_ALUMINA_WHITE), lid MAT_STEEL_STAINLESS/MAT_NICKEL (brushed), pads MAT_GOLD, print MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE.

## Appearance
Silver-gray metal lid with a laser-printed frequency/code and a dot or chamfer on the pin-1 corner; the ceramic base is tan to light brown (visible as a thin band). Variation by vendor in print format; Abracon notes the chamfer may be at pin 1, 2 or 4, so the print orientation, not the chamfer, identifies pin 1.

## Orientation Markings
Pin 1 at the upper-left (-X,+Y) when the lid print reads left to right (NDK/Epson convention; Abracon parts: lower-left, parameter pin1_corner). Add a pin-1 dot on the lid near that corner (OHMNI convention) and a chamfered lid corner at LOD2.

4 flat pads 1.0 x 0.9 (UNCERTAIN) at pad centers 1 = (-1.1, 0.8), 2 = (-1.1, -0.8), 3 = (1.1, -0.8), 4 = (1.1, 0.8) per Addendum 17.2 (pin 1 top-left, counter-clockwise). Silver lid with printed frequency code and a pin-1 dot at the top-left corner; tan ceramic edge band. MEMS variants are black molded.

Pin 1 dot or chamfer at the top-left corner (-X,+Y); no official corner marking is stated in the opened Abracon/SiTime texts (RESEARCH_REQUIRED). Delta vs Abracon crystals (pin 1 bottom-left) recorded.

Two stacked boxes, four pad plates, dot decal.

LOD0: single box. LOD1: base + lid, four pads, pin-1 dot. LOD2: castellations, lid chamfer, seam.

Gap-fill (Murata CSTLS catalog page, S4 copy): CSTLS_G (3.40-10.00 MHz): L 8.0 +/-1.0 (in-line), height 5.5 +/-0.5 (Murata's 'W'), thickness T 3.5 +/-0.3 (varies with frequency and internal capacitors); CSTLS_X (16-70 MHz): L 5.5 +/-1.0, height 6.5 +/-0.5, T 3.5 +/-0.3. Lead pitch 2.5 +/-0.2, lead dia 0.48 +/-0.05 (both members). The RS listings (8 x 3 x 5.5 and 5.5 x 3.5 x 6.5) agree on L and height and give T = 3 (inside the 3.5 +/-0.3 tolerance). Default now L 8.0 (X), T 3.5 (Y, first pass 3.0), height 5.5 (Z). Murata's table also prints a 'lead length (ref.) 0.7' value that is not reliable in the extraction and is not used. 3 round leads dia 0.48 +/-0.05, pitch 2.5 +/-0.2 (Murata CSTLS catalog). In-line rule: Addendum 17.3 (in-line 3-pin THT run along X, pin 1 at -X). Pin 1 at (-2.5, 0), pin 2 (ground, center) at (0, 0), pin 3 at (+2.5, 0). Resonator terminals are pins 1 and 3; the electrode order is symmetric so polarity is none. MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Tail -2.6.

Through-hole, 3 holes in a row, pitch 2.5, drill ~0.8 (UNCERTAIN); body_offset (0,0); standoff 0 (UNCERTAIN).

Body MAT_RESONATOR_COAT_BLUE (proposed; actual Murata CSTLS color not verified, L), leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, print MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE.

Resin-dipped molded block with a printed part code/frequency; color varies by series (blue for the CSTLS class is unverified).

None (symmetric); pin 2 center lead is ground. Optional print marking facing -Y.

## Recognition Features
1. Small three-leaded rounded block. 2. Leads in a row at 2.5 pitch. 3. About 8 x 3.5 x 5.5 mm. 4. Printed code.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: body_x/y/z, lead_pitch, lead_length, color. Coupled: body_x >= 2 x lead_pitch + 3.0.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box with filleted top edges; three cylinders.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Box with top fillets. 2. Three leads. 3. Print decal.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0: box + 3 cylinders. LOD1: top fillets, print. LOD2: lead bends/shoulder, resin edge softening.

## Simplification Rules
May omit: print, fillets. NEVER omit: three leads in a row, body size class.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-HDR_PIN

Generator: GEN-HEADER (shared with PKG-HDR_SOCKET). Members: 1xN straight (OHM-150), 2xN straight (OHM-151), right-angle (OHM-154, class C variant).

### Shared geometry
- De facto standard 2.54 mm (0.100 in) pitch breakaway male header. No JEDEC/IEC number is claimed.
- Plastic base: rectangular block, long axis along Y (row direction), length = N x 2.54 mm (no end allowance; the base is exactly N pitches long, so strips butt together). Width along X = 2.54 mm (1 row) or 5.08 mm (2 rows). Height Z = 2.54 mm. Base underside seats at Z = 0.
- Pins: square 0.64 mm cross-section, centered in each 2.54 x 2.54 cell. Mating end above base 6.0 mm, tail below base 3.0 mm, so total pin length 11.54 mm. Mating tip and tail tip have a pyramidal (4-sided) lead-in chamfer (size not sourced; OHMNI default 0.25 mm x 45 deg, UNCERTAIN, cosmetic).
- Optional (not sourced, common practice, LOD2 only): V-notch break grooves across the base between positions at the pitch boundaries, and small chamfers on the base top edges (OHMNI default 0.2 mm).

### Generator rule (N positions)
- Pin i (1xN): center y_i = ((N-1)/2 - (i-1)) x 2.54, x = 0. Pin 1 at +Y end (Section 6 single-row rule).
- 2xN: pin 2k-1 at x = -1.27, pin 2k at x = +1.27, y_k = ((N-1)/2 - (k-1)) x 2.54. Pin 1 at (-1.27, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54). Here N is positions per row (total pins 2N).
- Base length along Y = N x 2.54; pin-pattern center coincides with base center, so body_offset = (0, 0) under FCO.
- N range: 1 to 40 per row is the OHMNI default limit (de facto breakaway strips; Samtec TSW is cataloged in 1-xx lengths but the maximum was not read from a source).
- No intrinsic pin-1 feature on the plastic (no polarization key on unshrouded headers). Pin 1 is a decal/silkscreen item only.

### Member dimension table (mm)

| pitch | 2.54 | 2.49 | 2.59 | MFR_DATASHEET (WE-PHD-PIN: 2.54 +-0.05) | H | Samtec: 2.54 (.100) per SAM-TSW-CAT |
| pin square | 0.64 | 0.49 | 0.79 | MFR_DATASHEET (WE-PHD-PIN q = 0.64 +-0.15); Samtec .025 in SQ = 0.635 | H | two manufacturers agree |
| base height | 2.54 | 2.39 | 2.69 | DERIVED: 11.54 - 6.0 - 3.0; matches unlabeled 2.54 +-0.15 in WE-PHD-PIN table | M | label not tied to a feature by the extraction |
| mating length above base | 6.0 | 5.8 | 6.2 | MFR_DATASHEET (WE-PHD-PIN, 6.0 +-0.20; consistent with total 11.54 +-0.20) | M | Samtec offers many post lengths (SAM-TSW-CAT: 2.41 to 31.24 mm) so this is a lead-style parameter |
| tail below base | 3.0 | 2.8 | 3.2 | MFR_DATASHEET (WE-PHD-PIN, 3.0 +-0.20) | M | Samtec tail range 2.41 to 30.99 mm |

Parameter variants (pitch): 2.0 mm and 1.27 mm headers exist commercially but NO source for them was opened. RESEARCH_REQUIRED: 2.0 mm and 1.27 mm pin header base size, pin size and lengths. The generator must expose `pitch` but only 2.54 is specified here; do not scale other dimensions linearly for other pitches.

### Right-angle variant (OHM-154), PKG-HDR_PIN.RA
- Same pin cross-section and pitch. The pin is bent 90 degrees: mating segment horizontal (mating direction +X by OHMNI choice, Section 18.5), tail vertical down into the board.
- Gap-fill findings (second pass):
  - Mating segment beyond the body: 6.0 (WE-PHD-RA drawing labels 6.0 +-0.2, tail 3.0 +-0.2, and a 1.5 +-0.2 label; the KiCad generic 2.54 mm angled-header footprints, descr "6mm pin length", place the body's rear face exactly 1.5 mm from the tail axis and the pin tip 6.0 beyond the body's front face, which fixes the meaning of the 1.5 label as tail-to-body-rear distance). Harwin M20 THT right-angle (HARWIN-M20-RA, RS listing of M20-9753646): mating pin 5.8, tail 3.0 (second manufacturer, 0.2 shorter than Wurth). Adopted: 6.0 (min 5.8).
  - Body depth (along X) 2.54: KiCad fab outline 1.5 to 4.04 (1x02) and 4.04 to 6.58 (2x02); Harwin M20-8890245 (SMT right-angle sibling) lists 2.50 height above PCB and 11.50 length, supporting a body about 2.5 mm thick per row. Row-to-row 2.54 (WE-PHD-RA 2x2 label 2.54 +-0.1).
  - 2xN tail columns are 2.54 apart (KiCad 2x02 pads at x = 0 and 2.54), body rear face 1.5 from the NEAR tail column (4.04 from the far column). The far-column pin must be the upper pin (else its horizontal run would collide with the near-column tail), so far column = upper row = odd pins.
  - Samtec -RA/-RE tables (SAM-TSW-CAT-RA, 5.84 / 4.83 / 7.37 / ... and 1.52 / 4.06 callouts): the fetch tool assigned letters inconsistently across two reads, so NONE of the Samtec RA numbers is used. The first-pass reading ("post length 5.84", "height ref 3.02/5.56/8.13") is withdrawn as unreliable.
  - NOT resolved: body height above the board (stacked 2.54 per row assumed) and horizontal pin axis height (1.27 per row assumed); no right-angle drawing with those callouts was readable. Amphenol 10129378 was not found.
- OHMNI RA geometry (axis height and body height UNCERTAIN, L; the rest M):
  - Rows r = 0 (lower) and r = 1 (upper, 2xN only). Horizontal pin axis Z = 1.27 + 2.54 r.
  - Tail columns (FCO origin = center of the tail hole pattern): 1xN at x = 0; 2xN upper row tail at x = -1.27, lower row tail at x = +1.27.
  - Base block: Z from 0 to rows x 2.54 (UNCERTAIN); Y length N x 2.54; X extent [+1.5, +4.04] for 1xN (body center x = +2.77) and [+2.77, +5.31] for 2xN (body center x = +4.04). Mating segment projects 6.0 beyond the +X face (tip at x = 10.04 for 1xN, 11.31 for 2xN). Tails drop to Z = -3.0.
  - The vertical leg and the horizontal run behind the body (1.5 mm for the lower/near pin, 4.04 mm for the upper/far pin) are exposed, not hidden in the body.
  - Pin numbering: 1xN pin 1 at +Y end. 2xN: odd pins upper row (-X tail column), even pins lower row (+X tail column), pin 1 at (-1.27, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54). This matches the KiCad angled-header numbering with the Y axis flipped (KiCad is Y-down; pin 1 at the far-tail column, pin 3 below it).
  - FCO origin at the center of the tail hole pattern; body_offset = (+2.77, 0) for 1xN, (+4.04, 0) for 2xN. (First-pass value (0, 0) with a centered body is withdrawn.)
  - Bend: inner radius about 0.3 mm at LOD2 (UNCERTAIN, cosmetic); LOD0/1 use a mitered square elbow.

### Sources
WE-PHD-PIN, SAM-TSW-CAT, SAM-TSW-PRINT, SAM-TSW-SSW-SPEC, HARWIN-M20-9990245, HARWIN-M20-RA, HARWIN-M20-8890245, WE-PHD-RA, KICAD-FP (see tables at top).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-HDR_SOCKET

Generator: GEN-HEADER. Members: 1xN (OHM-152), 2xN (OHM-153).

### Shared geometry
- De facto 2.54 mm female header strip. Black insulator block, N x 2.54 + 0.4 long (Y; Harwin 0.4, Wurth 0.5 end allowance; the block is centered on the pin pattern). Body height 8.5 mm class (Samtec SSW 8.51 mm = .335 in; Wurth WR-PHD socket 8.5 +-0.15; Harwin M20-78xx height above PCB 8.5). Width: 2.54 mm single row (Samtec .100 in per position; Harwin 2.50), Wurth lists a 3.1 +-0.3 width figure (outlier, kept as max). Double row width: Samtec -D lists 4.95 mm (.195 in); generator default 5.08 is nominal row-to-row 2.54 x 2 (no 2-row Harwin/Wurth drawing opened).
- Top face: one square-to-round contact opening per position, centered in each cell, with an entry chamfer (opening size not sourced; OHMNI default 1.0 mm square/round with 0.25 mm 45 deg chamfer, UNCERTAIN, cosmetic). Metal contact is invisible except gold/steel tint inside the hole at LOD2.
- Tails: square 0.64 mm default (UNCERTAIN; Wurth lists pin diameter 0.74 +-0.15; Samtec lists the receptacle as .025 in SQ POST SOCKET meaning it accepts a 0.64 post) descending below the base to Z = -3.0 default; Samtec tail range 2.29 to 7.87 mm.

### Generator rule
Identical to PKG-HDR_PIN: pin positions, pin 1 at +Y end (1xN) or at (-1.27, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54) (2xN), FCO origin at the pad pattern center, body_offset (0,0). Body length is N x 2.54 + end_allowance (0.4, gap-fill; was N x 2.54 in the first pass), centered on the pin pattern. Tails: Harwin 3.0 below board (matches the OHMNI default); Samtec options 2.29 to 7.87.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-JST_SH

Generator: GEN-WIRE_CONN. JST SH, 1.0 mm pitch SMD. Default SM04B-SRSS-TB (side entry); top-entry BM04B-SRSS-TB included as a parameterized variant (dimensions below from KICAD-FP only).

Axis note (gap-fill). KiCad's SM04B footprint has pin 1 at the left with the mating face toward the bottom of the view (+y_kicad). Transforming without mirroring (rotation, X_O = -y_k, Y_O = -x_k) puts pin 1 at +Y and the mating face at -X. The first-pass entry used mating +X with pin 1 at +Y, which is a mirror image of the footprint. This pass adopts mating toward -X for the side-entry member (decision flagged for the coordinator; Section 18.5 says side-entry parts mate toward +Y, but with the single-row-along-Y rule that would force pin 1 to a side that does not match the real part).

Note on `length`: in this MKDS series the Farnell "a" values equal N x 5.08 (block length), unlike the MSTB header series where a = (N-1) x 5.08. The PXC-MKDS-CHIPDIP extract printed "a = 15.24" for its 4-position title, which does not fit N x 5.08 (would be 20.32); that extract is treated as unreliable for "a" and only its 9.8 / 13.8 / 0.9 / 1.3 values are used.
Cross-check: Wurth WR-TBL 4065B (push-in, not screw) 3-pos 5.08: L 16.64, heights 13.50/14.40, depth 8.20 (WE-TBL-4065B).
Not opened: Weidmuller, Camdenboss, Kuxin.
Sources: RS-MKDS, NOVA-MKDS, WE-TBL-4065B, PXC-MKDS-BD, PXC-MKDS-CHIPDIP, PXC-MKDSN, KICAD-FP.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-PLUG_TERM

Generator: GEN-TERMINAL, class D assembly: header (shrouded, soldered) plus mating plug (screw terminal). OHMNI representative: Phoenix Contact MSTBA 2,5/N-G-5,08 (right-angle header) with MSTB 2,5/N-ST-5,08 plug. The vertical sibling MSTBVA 2,5/N-G-5,08 is a parameter (`header_orientation`).

Gap-fill: the Phoenix datasheet copies give the header envelope consistently in both orientations: MSTBA 2,5/2-G-5,08 (1757242) l 12.0, w 12.16, h 12.1 total, 8.6 without solder pin, pin 3.5; MSTBVA 2,5/2-G-5,08 (1755736) l 8.6, w 12.16, h 15.9 total, constructional height 12.0, solder pin 3.9. The 12.0 and 8.6 swap between the two, so both are the same shroud (12.16 x 8.6 x 12.0 deep) rotated; the width 12.16 = N x 5.08 + 2.0.

# [OHM-150] 1xN male pin header
## Identity
- Canonical name: 1xN male pin header
- ID: OHM-150; slug `hdr_pin_1xn`; Category: connector; Subcategory: board-to-board / pin header
- Physical package: PKG-HDR_PIN, 2.54 mm (0.100 in) pitch, member 1xN straight, default N = 8
- Mounting: THT
- Aliases: breakaway header, 0.1 in header strip, Samtec TSW, Wurth WR-PHD 6130xx, Harwin M20-999 style
- Common variants: pins per row N = 1..40; tail/mating length options; gold or tin plating; 2.0 mm and 1.27 mm pitch (RESEARCH_REQUIRED, not sourced)
- Class B, priority P0, complexity 2
## Physical Dimensions
Values from PKG-HDR_PIN family table, restated:
- pitch 2.54 (H); pin 0.64 square (H); base height 2.54 (M); base width 2.54 (M, Harwin M20-9990245 overall 5.08 x 2.54 for 1x2); base length N x 2.54 (M)
- pin above base 6.0 (M; Harwin 6.1), tail 3.0 (M; Harwin 3.00); total pin 11.54 (M; Harwin 11.64); overall height above board 8.54; lowest point Z = -3.0
- default N = 8: base length 20.32
## Geometry
- Single rectangular black base, 2.54 (X) x N x 2.54 (Y) x 2.54 (Z), underside at Z = 0.
- Square pins pass vertically through the base cell centers; each pin has a pyramidal lead-in at both tips.
- Optional LOD2 detail (unsourced common practice): shallow V-notch break grooves across the top face at the boundaries between positions; 0.2 mm base top-edge chamfer; slight draft on base sides is not modeled.
- No shroud and no polarization key.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
- Count: N (N per row x 1); square 0.64 x 0.64, brass/copper alloy, gold or tin finish (MAT_GOLD default, MAT_TIN_BRIGHT variant).
- Pitch 2.54 both directions; pin Z range -3.0 to +8.54.
- Pin 1 at (0, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54); numbering: 1..N from +Y end toward -Y.
- PCB penetration: tail 3.0 below base; exceeds the default 1.6 mm board, so entry overrides tail depth explicitly.
## PCB Interface
- Footprint: tht_holes, hole diameter 1.10 (WE-PHD-PIN recommended; Samtec options not read), pitch 2.54.
- FCO: origin at center of the hole pattern; body_offset (0, 0).
- Base seats at Z = 0, standoff 0 (stand-off bumps on base underside not modeled).
- Holes: 1 x N column at x = 0.
## Materials
- Base: MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK.
- Pins: MAT_GOLD (default; WE-PHD gold plated), MAT_TIN_BRIGHT as variant. No new tokens.
## Appearance
- Base black (matte), pins gold or bright tin; no markings on the part. Pin-1 and pin-number silkscreen belong to the footprint layer, not to the model.
- Manufacturer variation: insulator PBT (Samtec TSW), LCP (HTSW), PA6T (Wurth), all black; some sellers use natural/white or colored bases (not modeled).
## Orientation Markings
- Unshrouded header has no pin-1 mark. Pin 1 = (0, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54); decal optional (a small triangle on the base top at the pin-1 end is an OHMNI decal convention, not manufacturer practice).
## Recognition Features
1. Square 0.64 pins projecting 6.0 above a 2.54 mm thick black base.
2. Base length exactly N x 2.54 and pitch grid.
3. Pyramid-tipped pin ends.
4. Tail below the board (omitted only at LOD0).

## Parametric Variants
- Parameters: N (1..40), pin_above (default 6.0), tail_below (default 3.0), base_height (2.54), plating, pitch (2.54 only specified).
- Coupled: base length = N x pitch; total pin = pin_above + base_height + tail_below; if pitch changes, other dims are RESEARCH_REQUIRED.
## Recommended Base Geometry
- Box (base) + N square prisms with pyramid end caps; optional notch cuts.
## Modeling Procedure
1. Build base box 2.54 x N x 2.54, bottom at Z = 0.
2. Compute pin centers with the PKG-HDR_PIN generator rule.
3. Extrude each 0.64 square pin from Z = -3.0 to Z = 8.54; add pyramid lead-ins.
4. LOD2: add break grooves and base chamfers.
5. Assign materials; export with pin-1 metadata (0, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54).
## LOD Strategy
- LOD0: base box plus one box per pin (pins may be merged into one box per row), no tails.
- LOD1: all pins with tails, pyramid tips, base.
- LOD2: LOD1 plus break grooves, base edge chamfers, optional plating tint variation.
## Simplification Rules
- May omit: grooves, chamfers, tail (LOD0), pyramid tips (LOD0).
- NEVER omit: pin count/pitch, 6.0 mating length vs 3.0 tail asymmetry, base thickness, pin-1 end coordinate.

# [OHM-152] 1xN female header
## Identity
- Canonical name: 1xN female header
- ID: OHM-152; slug `hdr_socket_1xn`; Category: connector; Subcategory: socket / female header
- Physical package: PKG-HDR_SOCKET, 2.54 mm pitch, 1xN, default N = 8

- Common variants: N = 1..40, tail length 2.29 to 7.87 (Samtec), low-profile sockets (not sourced), right-angle (not specified)
- Class B, priority P0, complexity 3
## Physical Dimensions
From PKG-HDR_SOCKET:
- pitch 2.54 (H); body height 8.5 (M); body width 2.54 (M; Samtec .100 and Harwin 2.50 agree, Wurth 3.1 outlier); body length N x 2.54 + 0.4 (M; Harwin 0.4, Wurth 0.5 end allowance)
- tail 3.0 default (M for the default value: Harwin tail 3.0; Samtec range 2.29 to 7.87), tail 0.64 square (L), hole opening 1.0 (L)
- default N = 8: length 20.32 + 0.4 = 20.72
- lowest point Z = -3.0; top Z = 8.5
## Geometry
- Black block 2.54 (X) x (N x 2.54 + 0.4) (Y) x 8.5 (Z), underside at Z = 0, centered on the pin pattern.
- Top face: 1 x N contact openings, each with a 45 degree entry chamfer; opening depth modeled to 1 mm at LOD1, full 6.35 mm insertion depth at LOD2 as a dark blind hole (Samtec insertion depth 3.68 to 6.35).
- Tails: square posts below base.
- Break grooves between positions optional at LOD2 (unsourced).
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
- Count: 8 contacts (N); tails 0.64 square (UNCERTAIN), gold or tin.
- Pin 1 at (0, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54); numbering: 1..N from +Y end toward -Y.
- Tail goes to Z = -3.0 (override).
## PCB Interface
- tht_holes, hole 1.02 (WE-PHD-SOCK), pitch 2.54; FCO at hole pattern center; body_offset (0, 0); standoff 0.
- Holes at x = 0.
## Materials
- Body: MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK (LCP/PBT/high-temp thermoplastic, all black).
- Contacts/tails: MAT_GOLD (visible inside openings at LOD2) or MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. No new tokens.
## Appearance
- Black glossy-to-matte block with a regular grid of round or square entry holes; metal contact barely visible. No printed markings.
- Manufacturer variation: body width 2.54 vs 3.1 (Wurth), hole shape (square vs round), body height 8.5 vs 8.51 (same class).
## Orientation Markings
- No pin-1 feature on the part. Pin 1 = (0, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54); silkscreen/decal only.
## Recognition Features
1. Tall (8.5) black block.
2. Regular chamfered contact openings.
3. Pitch grid and N length.
4. Tails below board.
## Parametric Variants
- Parameters: N (1..40), rows (1/2), body_height (8.5), tail_below (3.0), width (see conflict).
- Coupled: length = N x 2.54; opening count = rows x N.
## Recommended Base Geometry
- Box with array of chamfered pockets; tail prisms.

# [OHM-154] Right-angle pin header
## Identity
- Canonical name: Right-angle pin header
- ID: OHM-154; slug `hdr_pin_ra`; Category: connector; Subcategory: pin header, right angle
- Physical package: PKG-HDR_PIN.RA, 2.54 mm pitch, default 1xN with N = 8 (2xN supported)

- Common variants: 1xN, 2xN; N = 1..40
- Class C, priority P1, complexity 3
## Physical Dimensions
See PKG-HDR_PIN right-angle section. Restated defaults (gap-fill pass):
- pitch 2.54 (H); pin 0.64 square (H); horizontal mating segment 6.0 beyond the body front face (M; Wurth 6.0, KiCad 6, Harwin 5.8); tail 3.0 below the board (M; Wurth 3.0, Harwin 3.0)
- body depth along X 2.54 (M); tail axis to body rear face 1.5 for the near tail column (M; Wurth label 1.5 plus KiCad footprint)
- body height Z = rows x 2.54 (L, UNCERTAIN); horizontal pin axis Z = 1.27 + 2.54 r (L, UNCERTAIN)
- 1xN: body X from +1.5 to +4.04, tip at x = 10.04; 2xN: tails at x = -1.27 (upper) and +1.27 (lower), body X from +2.77 to +5.31, tip at x = 11.31
- Samtec right-angle numbers are NOT used (SAM-TSW-CAT-RA reads were inconsistent); the first-pass 5.84 / 3.02 / 5.56 / 8.13 figures are withdrawn
## Geometry
- Black base block, Y length N x 2.54, X depth 2.54, Z height rows x 2.54 (UNCERTAIN), underside at Z = 0. The body is NOT centered on the holes: its rear face is 1.5 mm in front of the nearest tail column (+X side). body_offset X = +2.77 (1xN) or +4.04 (2xN).
- Each pin: square 0.64 bar from the tail axis, running horizontally at the pin axis height through the body and out of the +X face by 6.0, with a pyramid tip. The vertical leg drops from the horizontal bar at the tail axis to Z = -3.0. Behind the body the horizontal bar and the upper part of the vertical leg are visible (1.5 mm behind the lower row, 4.04 mm behind the upper row for 2xN).
- 2xN: two pin levels. The far tail column (x = -1.27) carries the UPPER pins (odd numbers), the near column (x = +1.27) the LOWER pins (even numbers); this is forced by non-crossing geometry and matches KiCad pin numbering.
- Bend: mitered elbow at LOD0/1, inner radius about 0.3 at LOD2 (UNCERTAIN, cosmetic).
- No shroud, no polarization key.
## Leads / Pins / Terminals
- Count N (1xN) or 2N (2xN); square 0.64, gold (Wurth gold, Harwin gold/tin options).
- Pin 1 at (0, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54) for 1xN; (-1.27, +(N-1)/2 x 2.54) for 2xN with odd pins on the upper row. Numbering descends toward -Y.
- Tail depth below board top 3.0 (M).
## PCB Interface
- tht_holes diameter 1.10 (WE-PHD recommended; Wurth 2x2 right-angle sheet lists 1.02 +-0.05 in one read, 1.1 +-0.2 in the 1x2 sheet), holes at x = 0 (1xN) or x = +-1.27 (2xN), pitch 2.54.
- FCO origin at the center of the hole pattern; body_offset = (+2.77, 0) for 1xN and (+4.04, 0) for 2xN; mating direction +X (horizontal).
- Base seats at Z = 0 (stand-off not modeled).
## Materials
- Base MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK (Wurth PA6T black, Harwin PA black); pins MAT_GOLD (or MAT_TIN_BRIGHT). No new tokens.
## Appearance
- Black base, gold or tin pins. Horizontal pins visible from +X. No printed markings.
## Orientation Markings
- No pin-1 mark on part. Pin 1 at +Y end (decal only).
## Recognition Features
1. Horizontal pins out of a low black block, tails offset behind the block.
2. 90 degree elbow visible from the side, with exposed pin behind the body.
3. Row stacking for 2xN (staggered tails).
4. Tails below board.
## Parametric Variants
- Parameters: N, rows, mating_length (6.0), tail_below (3.0), rear_offset (1.5), bend radius.
- Coupled: body X range = [tail_near + rear_offset, tail_near + rear_offset + 2.54]; base height = rows x 2.54; axis Z = 1.27 + 2.54 r.
- Variant of PKG-HDR_PIN (class C).
## Recommended Base Geometry
- Offset box + L-shaped square-section sweeps (two straight prisms with a mitered or filleted corner).
## Modeling Procedure
1. Build the base box at X from tail_near + 1.5 to + 2.54 deeper, Y = N x 2.54, Z = 0 to rows x 2.54.
2. For each pin sweep a 0.64 square along the path: tail Z = -3.0 up to the axis height Z_r at the tail column, then +X to (body front face + 6.0).
3. Add tip pyramids.
4. Assign materials; export with pin-1 metadata and body_offset.
## LOD Strategy
- LOD0: base box plus mating-segment boxes.
- LOD1: L-shaped pins with mitered elbow, tails.
- LOD2: bend radii, tip pyramids, break grooves.
## Simplification Rules
- May omit: grooves, bend radius (LOD0/1), tail (LOD0).
- NEVER omit: horizontal mating direction, both rows when 2xN, elbow, pin-1 end, the body offset from the tail column.

- Pin 1 at (+2.0, +1.5) for SM04B N=4 (BM04B: (-1.325, +1.5)); numbering toward -Y.
## PCB Interface
- smd_pads: 4 signal pads 0.6 x 1.55 at 1.0 pitch plus 2 tab pads 1.2 x 1.8; FCO is the pad bounding box center (the pad pattern is symmetric about it in X and Y); body_offset = (-0.45, 0) (SM04B) or (+0.45, 0) (BM04B); standoff 0.
## Materials
- Housing: MAT_PLASTIC_NATURAL (ivory); tabs and contacts: MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.

## Orientation Markings

# G12A: I/O Connectors (USB, HDMI, RJ45/RJ11, 3.5 mm audio)

Group G12A, OHM-162 to OHM-171. Convention: FCO origin (Sec. 4), mating face toward +Y (Sec. 6), Z=0 board top, 17 addenda applied (terminal positions = contact-area center; drawing-callout figures capped at M).

## Group-wide evidence statement (read first)

1. Research tooling: WebFetch returns a small-model summary of a document, not the drawing image. Dimensions below that came through it are "as summarized"; drawing callouts are therefore capped at M.
2. WebSearch budget for the session ran out mid-task. Several documents that were found (Amphenol 10118194 drawing, Wurth 629105150521 drawing, Lumberg 2411_02 sheet, Molex 47346/47491 pages, FCI A-6100, Farnell MJ-073H, SJ1-352xN) were opened but contained NO dimension numbers in the extracted text. They are NOT used as dimension sources; where cited it is only for what they actually showed (part identity, tolerances, pitch).
3. USB-IF specs (USB 2.0, Type-C), HDMI Licensing outline and IEC 62680 were NOT opened (paywalled or not reached). Nothing below is cited to them. Where a standard mating dimension is written from general engineering knowledge it is tagged `RECALLED_UNVERIFIED` (basis UNCERTAIN, confidence L).
4. Primary quantitative source for pad/hole/shield-leg coordinates is the KiCad official footprint library (`KiCad/kicad-footprints`, raw `.kicad_mod` files, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com; tier S5, community-drawn from the cited manufacturer drawings; the file's own datasheet URL is listed but that datasheet was not necessarily opened). KiCad coordinates are Y-down with mating faces in varied directions. Conversion to OHMNI is stated per entry. In every entry the pad pattern was re-centered to FCO using pad/hole CENTER points (not pad edges).
5. Source tags used below:
 - KC:<file> = KiCad footprint file in `Connector_USB.pretty`, `Connector_RJ.pretty`, `Connector_HDMI.pretty`, `Connector_Audio.pretty`; fab-layer (F.Fab) extents are the footprint author's body outline, NOT a manufacturer-certified shell dimension.
 - GCT-4105 = Farnell-hosted GCT USB4105 drawing (https://www.farnell.com/cad/3307614.pdf), GCT-4731 = TME-hosted GCT USB4731 drawing (https://www.tme.eu/Document/a8fe2e31a837cf25501329c65bdb65ad/usb4731.pdf), GCT-4240 = Farnell-hosted GCT USB4240 drawing (https://www.farnell.com/cad/4782961.pdf).
 - WE-614004134726 = https://www.we-online.com/catalog/datasheet/614004134726.pdf (Wurth WR-COM USB 2.0, text summary).
 - AMP-RJE7M = https://www.farnell.com/cad/4643430.pdf, AMP-RJE7H = https://www.farnell.com/cad/4422102.pdf (Amphenol Canada RJ45 drawings).
 - JLC-PJ307 = https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/HOOYA-PJ307/C2939173 ; LCSC-PJ307N5 = https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C692542.html (distributor listings).
 - CUI-HD01 = https://www.sameskydevices.com/product/interconnect/connectors/hdmi-connectors/hd01-19-ra-th (listing page, redirected from cuidevices.com).
6. The coordinator should treat all entries here as `status: partial` unless stated; the geometry is good enough for a recognizable procedural model, but exact shell heights and tongue dimensions need a human check against manufacturer PDFs (see RESEARCH_REQUIRED lists).

7. SECOND PASS (gap-fill, 2026-10): search worked again, but WebFetch still returns small-model summaries of drawings (it cannot read dimension callouts reliably; summaries of the same drawing sometimes disagree with each other, e.g. Amphenol 54601). Results of this pass: (a) distributor product pages with text attribute tables (Digikey-fed pages on hqonline.com, lioncircuits.com, rs-online, Heilind, Molex pages via Farnell) gave several envelope numbers; (b) GCT USB4105 drawing was re-read with targeted prompts (8.94, 7.35, 6.5 max, 3.31 appear; labels not confirmable); (c) KiCad footprints for 5-pin 3.5 mm jacks (Ledino KB3SPRS, CUI SJ1-3535NG) were found and give real THT pin coordinates; (d) Wikipedia (USB hardware, HDMI, Modular connector) was opened as a weak S5 cross-check only (its summaries are inconsistent in places and are NOT used as a sole source for any M-level value). Still NOT opened in any readable form: USB-IF specs, HDMI outline, Micro-USB spec, any manufacturer drawing image. Tags: WIKI-USBHW = https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USB_hardware, WIKI-HDMI = https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HDMI, WIKI-MOD = https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Modular_connector.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-USB_A

Generator GEN-USB. Standard-A (Type A) receptacle: a rectangular bent nickel-silver/stainless sheet-metal shell with one open front end (mating face, +Y), a plastic insulator block inside carrying a flat tongue with 4 contacts on one face (the tongue is on the shell's inner "top" face for a right-angle part mounted normally; contacts face down toward the PCB in the most common right-angle orientation, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED), and a rear closure.

Shell profile (looking along Y): rectangle approx 13.1 wide x 5.8 high with a seam line on one long face and small spring dimples/latches punched inward on the outer faces (bumps visible as small rectangular windows or rounded bosses near the front). Right-angle THT variant: 4 signal pins exit the rear-bottom and go to the PCB; 2 (some mfrs 4) shell legs/tabs on the sides go through the board. Vertical variant: mating face points +Z, footprint 13-14 x ~6; not defaulted.

Default (OHMNI): right-angle THT, based on Molex 67643 footprint (KC:USB_A_Molex_67643_Horizontal; footprint datasheet URL is the Molex 676433910 SD, which could not be fetched: robots.txt). Contact positions are the standard USB-A asymmetric pattern.

| Member | Mount | Shell W (X) | Depth (Y, incl. rear) | Height (Z) | Contact pitch | Shield legs | Source / confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| USB_A.RA_THT (DEFAULT) | THT right angle | 13.1 default (min 12.9, max 13.3) | 15.26 default (KC fab -2.27..12.99 y-extent, includes rear tab) | 5.8 default (min 5.5, max 6.2), RECALLED_UNVERIFIED | 2.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 between pins 1-2, 2-3, 3-4 (KC; consistent with 2.0 mm D+/D- spacing used by Wurth footprint) | 2 x Ø2.3 holes (pad Ø3.0) at x=±6.57 from center, y=+1.355 (FCO) | KC:Molex 67643 (M for pins/legs; L for height) |
| USB_A.VERT_THT | THT vertical | 13.1 | ~6 | ~15 | same | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | not modeled |

Shell width cross-check: Wurth WR-COM 614004134726 text summary gives overall width 13.1 ±0.2 (labelled "opening width"), 19.3 ±0.3 and 17.6 ±0.3 and 13.8 ±0.2 as other callouts, contact pin Ø0.92, and 4 pins; it is an "Up Right" part so the 19.3/17.6/13.8 callouts cannot be mapped reliably to axes (RESEARCH_REQUIRED). Its KiCad footprint shows pins at pitch 2.0 along the row (0, 2, 4, 6) and 4 shell posts at ±3.5 / ±2.72 (Ø1.5 hole): this is a DIFFERENT geometry (vertical-style) and was not merged.

Generator notes: build shell as 4-wall extrusion (outer 13.1 x 5.8) with wall thickness 0.3 (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED), inner cavity open at +Y; tongue plate 12.0 wide x ~1.9 thick inside the cavity (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) with 4 gold contact strips 1.0 wide; rear plate closes the shell; shell legs bent down 90° at rear sides.

Common manufacturer differences: leg count (2 vs 4), presence of a rear tab, flange/ears at the front lip, seam on top vs bottom, dimple pattern, black vs white tongue, gold vs tin contacts.

Second-pass additions: Molex 0676430910 / 67643-0910 product page (opened via Farnell datasheet page https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/1865732.pdf and https://datasheets.ibselectronics.com/67643-0910-Molex-datasheet-141439069.pdf; both gave attribute text only, no drawing dimensions): "PC tail length 2.60 mm", "PCB thickness recommended 1.60 mm", mating and termination pitch "2.00 mm, 2.50 mm". This confirms the 2.5/2.0/2.5 pin pattern and the -2.6 mm default tail depth (M). Shell height and depth remain unsourced (the Molex SD/drawing PDF is robots-blocked and not readable through the fetch tool).

Sources: KC:USB_A_Molex_67643_Horizontal.kicad_mod (pads/fab extents), WE-614004134726 (width 13.1, pin Ø0.92), Molex 67643-0910 product page (pitch, tail length).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-USB_C

USB Type-C receptacle, USB 2.0/full-featured shell. Outline: rounded-stadium opening (a 8.34 x 2.56 mm mating cavity, corners R about 0.8-1.0 RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) inside a stamped shell of outer 8.94 x 3.26 mm at the face. The center tongue is a thin plastic (or metal-reinforced) board ~0.7 mm thick RECALLED_UNVERIFIED carrying 12 contacts per side at 0.5 mm pitch (24 total for full-featured; 16 for USB 2.0-only, where A2/A3/A10/A11/B2/B3/B10/B11 are absent). Behind the cavity the shell continues as a plastic-filled box; PCB-facing side carries staggered SMD tails in 1 or 2 rows (row separation 1.7 mm in the Amphenol part) and 4 shell legs (THT, 2 front pairs and 2 rear pairs, with 2 NPTH locating pegs on some parts).

Evidence for opening/outer sizes: GCT USB4105 drawing text: opening 8.34 (+0.06/-0.02), height 2.56 ±0.04, contact pitch 0.20 (mis-summarized; 0.5 is the contact pitch for Type-C; 0.2 is likely a different callout), mounting holes Ø0.50, shell stake length 0.95 (options 0.60/1.20), pad sizes, PCB edge clearance 1.85 min. GCT USB4731: length 8.94, width 10.00 (IP67 type), height 3.80, opening 8.34 (+0.06/-0.02), contact pitch 0.50, PCB thickness 1.20, 16 pins. GCT USB4240: overall 8.98 x 8.94 x 4.40, connector opening 3.26 x 2.53, footprint 6.65 x 5.64, 12 signal pins Ø0.40 plus 4 posts Ø0.60, 0.5 pitch, 4 legs 1.40 long. The coordinator's brief value 8.94 x 3.26 outer face is corroborated by USB4731 and USB4240 (8.94, 3.26) but 3.26 appears only in USB4240 text here. Conflict: GCT USB4105 summary lists width 8.64 and depth 5.78 (these look like footprint extents, not shell dims).

SECOND PASS, ONE CITED DRAWING (GCT USB4105-GF-A, drawing "USB4105" Rev B, 29/04/21, Farnell-hosted https://www.farnell.com/cad/3307614.pdf; shell: stainless steel, nickel plated per title-block note). Re-read with targeted prompts (text-extraction summary, so callouts are capped at M and the label for each number is unconfirmed): numbers present that are >= 3 mm are 8.94, 8.64, 7.35, 6.5 Max. (labelled with the "Plug and Receptacle Mating View" text), 5.78, 4.18, 3.68 (repeated), 3.31. Interpretation adopted: 8.94 = shell width (matches USB4731 and USB4240, three GCT drawings), 7.35 = overall shell depth front lip to rear wall (the summarizer called it a horizontal dimension; it agrees with the coordinator brief 7.3 within 0.05), 3.31 = shell height (GCT USB4105 drawing) versus 3.26 in the USB4240 listing and 3.21 for Wurth 632723300011 (distributor listing, https://lioncircuits.com/parts/632723300011) and 3.46 for USB4105-GF-A on a Digikey-fed listing (https://lioncircuits.com/parts/USB4105-GF-A; likely includes stake/tail), 8.64 and 5.78 = PCB footprint extents, 4.18/3.68 = footprint row distances (not resolved to pad coordinates), mounting holes 2 x Ø0.65 (the earlier 0.50 reading is from a different callout), stake length 0.95 default. Because the labels cannot be confirmed from the extracted text, depth 7.35 stays confidence L and height 3.26 (range 3.21-3.46) M. WIKI-USBHW lists the Type-C receptacle opening as 8.34 x 2.56 (agrees with GCT) and a receptacle depth of 7.5 (weak S5; consistent with 7.3-7.5).

Footprint decision: the GCT USB4105 KiCad footprint could not be fetched (404 at the paths tried), so pad coordinates cannot be cross-checked against it. The OHMNI default therefore keeps the Amphenol 12401610E4-2A KiCad pad pattern (S5) for pad/leg coordinates and takes SHELL dimensions from the GCT USB4105 drawing. These are two different parts: Type-C shell width, opening and 0.5 mm contact pitch are standardized, but pad row depth and leg positions differ by vendor, so a user who needs the exact GCT footprint must import it from the GCT drawing; this is flagged in entry 165.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| USB_C.AMPH_12401610E4 (DEFAULT footprint; shell dims from GCT USB4105 drawing) | KC lists 24 SMD pads A1-A12, B1-B12 (0.3 x 0.7 each, 0.5 pitch, rows 1.7 apart, B row offset 0.25 from A) | 8.94 x 7.35 x 3.26 (width 8.94 GCT USB4105/4731/4240; depth 7.35 and height 3.31/3.26 from GCT USB4105 drawing, labels unconfirmed; KC fab body 9.2 x 10.45 includes rear legs and Amphenol-specific tails) | SMD contacts + 4 THT legs + 2 NPTH | KC:USB_C_Receptacle_Amphenol_12401610E4-2A |

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-RJ45 (and variant PKG-RJ11)

GEN-MODULAR_JACK. 8P8C jack: black thermoplastic (UL94V-0) housing with an opening about 11.7 wide x 7 tall (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) for the plug, latch notch in the top face (tab-down: the plug latch faces toward the PCB), 8 spring contacts (phosphor bronze, gold flash) seen as 8 thin vertical wires inside the cavity at 1.02 mm pitch RECALLED_UNVERIFIED, pins exiting the bottom at 1.27 mm pitch in two staggered rows. Shielded versions have a bent brass/nickel (MAT_NICKEL) shell with tabs/legs.

| Member | Fab W (X) | Fab depth (Y) | Height (Z) | Pin geometry | Mount posts / shield legs | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RJ45.AMPH_54602 (DEFAULT, part 54602-908LF) | 15.3 (KC fab -3.205..12.095; hqonline listing "15.30 x 17.74 mm") | 17.74 (KC fab -3.77..13.97; same listing) | 12.70 (hqonline listing of 54602-908LF "Height 12.70mm", S4; first-pass 13.5 was recalled) | pitch 1.27, 2 rows 2.54 apart, THT hole Ø0.76 pad 1.5 | 2 NPTH Ø3.2, 11.43 apart | KC:RJ45_Amphenol_54602-x08_Horizontal (drawing c-bmj-0102 opened: metadata only) |
| RJ45.AMPH_RJHSE538X (shielded + 2 LED = "magjack with LEDs") | 16.51 (KC fab -4.695..11.815) | 15.75 (KC fab -8..7.75) | not stated | pitch 1.016 (0.04 in) row pitch, rows 1.78 apart, Ø0.89 holes | 2 shield THT Ø1.57 (pad 2.3) at x±8.13 from center, 2 NPTH Ø3.25, 4 LED pins Ø0.89 | KC:RJ45_Amphenol_RJHSE538X (drawing PDF 404) |
| RJ45.AMPH_RJE7M_188 (shielded, CAT5E, 8P8C) | 16.38 | 17.08 | 3.05 (as summarized; likely a different dim) | pitch 1.27, row spacing 3.20, 8 holes Ø0.90 | 2 shield tab spacing 1.70, PCB layout 15.80 x 11.43 | AMP-RJE7M |
| RJ45.AMPH_RJE7H_188 (unshielded, tab down, no LED) | 14.96 | 11.15 | 10.77 | pitch 1.27, PCB-edge to pin 1 2.54, mount hole 2.00 x 0.50 | | AMP-RJE7H |

CONFLICT (resolved in pass 2): depth 17.74 (54602 fab) vs 17.08 (RJE7M) vs 11.15 (RJE7H: low-profile/"shallow" part or mislabeled callout) vs 15.75 (RJHSE538X with magnetics). These are DIFFERENT parts, not measurements of one part. OHMNI default is ONE named part, Amphenol 54602-908LF: housing 15.30 W x 17.74 D x 12.70 H, taken from a distributor listing (https://www.hqonline.com/product-detail/rj11---rj45-connectors-amphenol-54602-908lf-2500324203: "Size 15.30 x 17.74mm, Height 12.70mm", datasheet link https://file.huaqiu.com/web1/M00/DA/59/o4YBAGAADk2AR-veAAIifOZkWWI728.pdf, drawing ELX-I-012613-1 dated 2012/08/30 opened: metadata only, no readable dimensions) and independently matching the KiCad fab outline 15.3 x 17.74 (width and depth agree to 0.00 in two documents: M). The other depths stay as member rows. Side note: a Wurth WR-MJ 615008137421 (tab up, LED, shielded) listing gives 13.46 x 16.25 x 13.5 x depth 15.75 (https://lioncircuits.com/parts/615008137421), the same 15.75 depth as the RJHSE538X KiCad fab, which supports the 15.75 member row. The "height 8.89" in the first RJE7M re-read equals 7 x 1.27 (contact span), not a height; RJE7M height remains unresolved.

Common mfr differences: shielded vs unshielded, LED windows (2 small rectangular windows above the opening on the front face, usually green/yellow), shield tab count, side latch ears, flanged vs non-flanged front, tab up vs tab down, depth (short ~13.5-16 vs long ~21+).

Pin-numbering: 8 contacts staggered in two rows; pin 1 on the far-left front row when looking at the front with the latch up (TIA-568, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED); OHMNI uses the KC pin-1 position after rotation (see entry).

RJ11 variant (PKG-RJ11): same shell architecture but a 6P4C/6P6C cavity about 9.7-10 wide (plug width RECALLED_UNVERIFIED), 4 or 6 contacts, pitch 1.02, shallower, no LEDs. Pass 2: Amphenol 54601 line drawing opened (envelope 12.70 / 13.20 / 18.00, axis assignment conflicting between two summaries; see entry 170). Pad layout still RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

Sources: as in table.

# [OHM-162] USB-A receptacle

## Identity
- Canonical name: USB-A receptacle (Standard-A, right-angle THT, default)
- ID: OHM-162, slug `usb_a_receptacle`
- Category: connector; Subcategory: usb
- Physical package: PKG-USB_A.RA_THT (Molex 67643-style, KC footprint)
- Mounting: tht (right angle, mating face +Y)
- Aliases: USB Type A jack, USB-A female, USB-A socket
- Common variants: vertical THT, stacked dual (Wurth 61400826021 in KC library, not studied), USB 3.0 A (9-pin, blue tongue), SMT-leg versions
- Class A, priority P1, complexity 4

## Physical Dimensions
| Dim | default | min | max | basis | conf |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| shell width X | 13.1 | 12.9 | 13.3 | MFR_DATASHEET (Wurth 614004134726 callout 13.1 ±0.2; KC Molex shield posts 13.14 apart) | M |
| shell depth Y (incl. rear) | 15.26 | 14.5 | 16 | CONSENSUS-lite: KC fab extent only | L |
| shell height Z | 5.8 | 5.5 | 6.2 | UNCERTAIN (coordinator brief, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) | L |
| contact pitch (1-2 / 2-3 / 3-4) | 2.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 | | | MFR_DRAWING via KC Molex 67643; Molex 67643-0910 product page lists mating/termination pitch "2.00 mm, 2.50 mm" (second document) | M (upgraded: two documents agree) |
| PC tail length below board | 2.6 | | | Molex 67643-0910 product page "PC tail length 2.60 mm" (S4) | M |
| pin hole Ø | 0.95 | | | KC | M |
| shield leg hole Ø / pad Ø | 2.3 / 3.0 | | | KC | M |
| overhang beyond board edge | 0 (default, edge flush with mating face) | 0 | 1.0 | UNCERTAIN: RESEARCH_REQUIRED | L |

## Geometry
Hollow rectangular shell, 4 walls ~0.3 thick (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED), open at +Y. Inside: a plastic tongue plate spanning most of the width (~12.0 wide, ~1.9-2.0 thick, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED), positioned in the lower half of the cavity so contacts face the PCB for the normal right-angle orientation, carrying 4 gold contact strips about 1.0 wide, recessed ~1 mm from the front of the tongue. Rear wall closes the shell. Seam: a visible butt seam along the top face centerline or a lap seam at the bottom (varies). Small spring dimples (3-4 raised rectangles) on the top and bottom outer faces within ~2 mm of the front lip. Shell rear tab/flange: 2 side legs bend down at the rear corners.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
- 4 signal pins, square 0.5 x 0.5 (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) tin/gold-flash, bend 90° out of the rear-bottom, tails to Z=-2.6 default (hole 0.95).
- Pin 1 = VBUS (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED function; position from KC), FCO position (3.5, -1.355). Pins 2 (1.0, -1.355), 3 (-1.0, -1.355), 4 (-3.5, -1.355). Numbering runs toward -X (this is KC rotated 180°: OHMNI x = -KC x).
- 2 shield legs (nickel), Ø2.3 holes at (±6.57, +1.355).

## PCB Interface
FCO center = bbox center of 4 pins + 2 shield holes (pad centers). Through holes Ø0.95 x4 at the pin coordinates; Ø2.3 x2 at shield positions. Body offset (0, +4.0) (fab -3.625..+11.635 in Y, center 4.005). Mating face at Y=+11.6; overhang default 0 (the footprint's board edge is not given in KC; RESEARCH_REQUIRED). Shell underside Z=0 (RESEARCH_REQUIRED standoff; plastic standoffs 0-0.5 typical).

## Materials
Shell MAT_NICKEL (or MAT_STEEL_STAINLESS); tongue MAT_PLASTIC_WHITE or MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK (white common for USB 2.0 A in many mfrs, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED), contacts MAT_GOLD, pins MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, rear insulator MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK.

## Appearance
Bright satin metal shell, dull; white or black tongue; blue tongue is USB 3.0 (variant). Decals none.

## Orientation Markings
No printed pin 1. The USB logo may be on the shell/plastic (decal optional). Asymmetric contact spacing identifies side: pins 2-3 are the close pair (2.0 mm).

## Recognition Features
1. 13.1 x 5.8 rectangular open-front metal tube with seam.
2. Visible tongue with 4 gold contacts inside.
3. 2 large side legs at the rear sides.
4. Asymmetric 4-pin row at rear.
5. Stamped dimples near lip.

## Parametric Variants
Parameters: `orientation` {right_angle, vertical}, `tongue_color`, `shell_height`, `overhang`, `leg_count` {2,4}. Coupled: shell width fixed 13.1 unless a flanged variant; pin pattern fixed; leg x-position = ±(shell_w/2 - 0) approx.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box shell minus inner box; box tongue; 4 thin boxes (contacts); 4 square prisms (pins) with an elbow; 2 box legs.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Shell outer box 13.1 x 15.26(or shell portion) x 5.8, centered at body_offset, bottom at Z=0.
2. Cut cavity 12.5 x 4.9 from +Y face, depth ~13.5 (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED).
3. Add tongue plate and 4 contact strips.
4. Add seam groove 0.05 deep and 4 dimples (LOD2).
5. Add 4 pins and 2 legs through board to tail.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 box + 2 leg boxes. LOD1 hollow shell, tongue, 4 contacts, pins, legs. LOD2 + dimples, seam, shell wall thickness, rounded corners R0.3.

## Simplification Rules
May omit seam, dimples, internal ribs. Never omit the open cavity, tongue with 4 contacts, shield legs, 4-pin asymmetric pattern.

# [OHM-163] USB-B receptacle

## Identity
- Canonical name: USB-B receptacle (square Standard-B, right-angle THT)
- ID OHM-163, slug `usb_b_receptacle`; category connector/usb; package PKG-USB_B.RA_THT (Lumberg 2411 02 style); mounting tht
- Aliases: USB Type B jack, printer-USB socket; variants: vertical (Amphenol MUSB-D511, TE 5787834), shielded/rugged
- Class A, P2, complexity 4

## Physical Dimensions
| Dim | default | min | max | basis | conf |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| shell width X | 12.0 | 11.5 | 12.5 | KC (shield posts 12.0 apart; fab 12.0 wide) | M |
| depth Y | 16.4 | 15.5 | 17 | KC fab extent | L |
| height Z | 10.9 | 10 | 11.5 | UNCERTAIN, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED | L |
| pin spacing | 2.5 (across) x 2.0 (depth) | | | KC Lumberg | M |
| pin hole Ø / pad | 0.95 / 1.6 | | | KC | M |
| shield hole Ø / pad | 2.3 / 4.0 | | | KC | M |
| overhang | 0 | 0 | 1.0 | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | L |

## Geometry
Bent-sheet shell, nearly square profile with top corners chamfered (key). Open at +Y. Inside: an insulator block hanging from the top with a tongue-less 4-contact arrangement (2 contacts on upper face, 2 on lower, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED). Seam on the bottom/rear. Rear skirt closes. 2 side legs at rear.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
4 pins in a 2 x 2 rectangle (2.5 across, 2.0 in depth). OHMNI FCO: pin 1 (-1.25,-2.43), 2 (1.25,-2.43), 3 (1.25,-0.43), 4 (-1.25,-0.43). KC to OHMNI mapping: ohm = (kc_y, kc_x) (rotate so KC +x faces +Y). 2 shield posts Ø2.3 at (±6.0, 2.43).

## PCB Interface
FCO center = bbox center of 4 pin holes + 2 shield holes. Body offset (0, +4.53), mating face Y=+12.73, shell bottom Z=0.

## Materials
MAT_NICKEL shell, MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK insulator (white/gray variants), MAT_GOLD contacts, MAT_TIN_BRIGHT pins.

## Appearance
Metal square box with chamfered upper corners; black insulator visible in cavity.

## Orientation Markings
The chamfered corners define up; pin 1 corner per KC pattern (-X, -Y rear row).

## Recognition Features
1. Square ~12 x 11 shell with chamfered top corners. 2. Open front with insulator block. 3. 2 large legs. 4. 2 x 2 pin rectangle.

## Parametric Variants
`orientation {right_angle, vertical}`, `shell_height`, `overhang`. Coupled: leg span = shell width.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Extruded chamfered-square profile (polygon extrude) minus cavity; box insulator; 4 pin prisms; 2 leg boxes.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Extrude polygon (12.0 wide, 10.9 high, 2 chamfers) 16.4 deep. 2. Cut cavity. 3. Add insulator and contacts. 4. Pins and legs.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 chamfered prism. LOD1 + cavity, insulator, pins, legs. LOD2 + seam, dimples, wall thickness.

## Simplification Rules
Never omit chamfered corners or open cavity.

## Geometry
Stadium/rounded-rectangle outer shell 8.94 x 3.26 (corner R ~1.0, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) with a 8.34 x 2.56 cavity whose corners are rounded; a thin center tongue (~0.7 thick, RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) spans the cavity (12 contacts per side visible as flat gold strips at 0.5 pitch, near the tongue front; USB 2.0 16-pin version omits the signal contacts A2/A3/A10/A11 and mirror). Shell: stamped stainless/brass, seam at rear bottom, 4 THT legs and 2 plastic NPTH pegs (one oval, one round) at rear-bottom.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
24 SMD contact tails (A1-A12, B1-B12; the KC Amphenol file) each 0.3 x 0.7 at 0.5 pitch; A row on the rear line, B row 1.7 closer to the front; the B row is offset by 0.25 in X relative to A. B12 (3.0,-2.23). (KC B row x runs +2.5 for B1 to -3.0 for B12; after negation B1 = -2.5 and B12 = +3.0.)
4 shell legs (THT): front pair (±4.49, +3.93) drill 0.5 x 1.1, rear pair (±4.13, -2.02) same. 2 NPTH pegs: KC (3.6,-4.36) oval 0.95 x 0.65 and (-3.6,-4.36) circle Ø0.65 become OHMNI (-3.6, -3.27) oval and (+3.6, -3.27) round.
Pin 1 (A1) at (2.75, -3.93).

## PCB Interface
Footprint FCO center = bbox center of all pad/hole pattern (shell legs, signal pads, pegs) = (0, KC y -1.09). Body offset (0, +1.1) for the 10.45-deep fab outline; shell front face at Y=+6.3. Top-mount: shell underside Z=0 (RESEARCH_REQUIRED: whether mid-mount cutout is needed), shell top at Z=3.26, tails flush. Overhang default 2.5 beyond the board edge line (the board edge is at Y = front-legs + ~0 in this convention, ~Y +3.9; RESEARCH_REQUIRED).

## Materials
Shell MAT_STEEL_STAINLESS or MAT_NICKEL; tongue MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK; contacts MAT_GOLD; tails MAT_TIN_BRIGHT; rear body MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK.

## Appearance
Thin, wide stainless oval ring; black center tongue visible; no markings (CC logo optional decal).

## Orientation Markings
The Type-C is flip-symmetric. A1 is defined at the +X rear row end (KC rotation). No visible keying other than slight shell asymmetry from NPTH peg shapes.

## Recognition Features
1. 8.94 x 3.26 rounded oval shell with 8.34 x 2.56 cavity. 2. Center tongue with 2 rows of gold contacts. 3. 4 side legs. 4. Row of 12 small SMD tails on 0.5 pitch (A row) plus offset B row.

## Parametric Variants
`contact_set` {24, 16, 6}, `mount` {top, mid, vertical}, `overhang`, `leg_count`, `shell_depth`. Coupled: pad X positions scale only with contact_set; B row offset 0.25 X and 1.7 Y toward front.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Rounded-rectangle extrusion (outer), rounded-rectangle cut (cavity), box tongue, thin strips, rear block.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Outer rounded profile 8.94 x 3.26 extruded 7.35 (Y). 2. Cut cavity 8.34 x 2.56 to depth ~6.5. 3. Add tongue (8.0 x 0.7). 4. Add 24/16 gold strips. 5. Add rear block, SMD tails, 4 legs, 2 pegs.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 rounded box + 4 legs. LOD1 + cavity, tongue, contacts, SMD tails. LOD2 + shell seam, solder tabs, stake geometry.

Never omit the 8.34 x 2.56 cavity and tongue; may merge SMD tails into 2 strips at LOD0.

Placeholder FCO from outermost pins and 2 shield pads at x=±5.0. Body offset (0, +5) placeholder, mating face +Y. RESEARCH_REQUIRED.

MAT_NICKEL shell, MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK tongue, MAT_GOLD contacts.

Small flat silver box with trapezoid opening.

Trapezoid key; pin 1 at +X placeholder.

## Recognition Features
Flat wide shallow opening 10.42 x 2.42; fine 19-contact rows; small side tabs.

## Parametric Variants
`scale` relative to PKG-HDMI generator; coupled: contact pitch = 0.4.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Same as OHM-167 with reduced cavity.

Use the HDMI generator with Type C parameters.

# [OHM-169] RJ45 Ethernet jack

## Identity
- Canonical name: RJ45 (8P8C) modular jack, tab-down, right-angle THT
- ID OHM-169, slug `rj45_jack`; connector/modular; PKG-RJ45.AMPH_54602; mounting tht
- Aliases: Ethernet jack, 8P8C jack, Modjack; variants: shielded (Amphenol RJE7M), magjack with 2 LEDs (Amphenol RJHSE538X), unshielded low profile (RJE7H), tab-up, SMT
- Class A, P1, complexity 4

## Physical Dimensions
| Dim | default | min | max | basis | conf |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| housing width X | 15.3 | 14.96 | 16.51 | KC fab 15.3 (54602); RJE7H 14.96; RJE7M 16.38; RJHSE538X 16.51 | M |
| housing depth Y | 17.74 | 15.75 | 17.74 | Amphenol 54602-908LF: hqonline listing 17.74 + KC fab 17.74 (two documents agree). First-pass 17.1 (from RJE7M 17.08, a different part) superseded; other depths are other parts (RJE7M 17.08, RJHSE538X 15.75, RJE7H 11.15) | M |
| housing height Z | 12.70 | 10.77 | 13.5 | Amphenol 54602-908LF listing "Height 12.70mm" (single S4 listing; capped M); first-pass 13.5 recalled and superseded; Wurth 615008137421 listing 13.5 is a different part | M |
| pin pitch (X) | 1.27 | | | KC, RJE7M, RJE7H | H |
| row spacing (Y) | 2.54 (54602), 3.20 (RJE7M), 1.78 at 1.016 pitch (RJHSE538X) | | | KC / AMP-RJE7M | M |
| pin hole Ø / pad | 0.76 / 1.5 (54602) | 0.76 | 0.90 | KC / AMP-RJE7M (0.90) | M |
| NPTH posts | 2 x Ø3.2, 11.43 apart | | | KC; AMP-RJE7M PCB layout width 11.43 | M |

## Geometry
Black thermoplastic housing; front face with plug opening about 11.7 wide x 7 tall (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) with the small rectangular latch notch cut in the (downward, for tab-down) side; 8 gold contact wires visible in the cavity roof; sides flat; rear closed. Shielded variant: nickel shell wrapping top/sides/rear with a front lip, shield legs 2 (or 4), and 2 front-side spring fingers; LED variant adds 2 rectangular windows in the front face above the opening (left and right) and 4 extra pins.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
8 pins, THT, in 2 staggered rows. KC axes: pin n at x=1.27(n-1); odd pins y=0, even pins y=-2.54. OHMNI (FCO, rotated 180°, face toward +Y): pin n at x = 4.445 - 1.27(n-1); odd pins y=-1.905, even pins y=-4.445. Pin 1 (4.445, -1.905), 2 (3.175, -4.445), 8 (-4.445, -4.445). Span 7 x 1.27 = 8.89 validated. 2 NPTH Ø3.2 at (±5.715, +4.445).
Magjack variant (RJHSE538X, mating face +Y after (x, -y) transform): pins n at x = -3.56 + 1.016(n-1); odd y=+2.03, even y=+0.25; LED pins 9,10 at (-6.86,-4.57), (-4.57,-4.57), 11,12 at (4.57,-4.57), (6.86,-4.57); 2 shield legs Ø1.57 (pad 2.3) at (±8.13, +1.14); 2 NPTH Ø3.25 at (±6.35, +4.57); pin hole Ø0.89.

## PCB Interface
Default FCO from the 8 pins and 2 NPTH. Body offset (0, +3.2), housing from y=-5.67 to +12.07 (17.74 deep, default part Amphenol 54602-908LF). Mating face Y=+12.07. Overhang default 0 (RESEARCH_REQUIRED, RJ45 jacks often have the face flush or up to ~1 mm over). Housing underside Z=0 (stand-off RESEARCH_REQUIRED).

## Materials
Housing MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK (gray/beige variants), contacts MAT_GOLD, pins MAT_TIN_BRIGHT, shield MAT_NICKEL, LED windows MAT_PLASTIC_DIFFUSED (green/amber) or MAT_PLASTIC_CLEAR. Amphenol docs (RJE7H/RJE7M) list UL94V-0 black thermoplastic, phosphor-bronze contacts with gold on mating surfaces, brass nickel-plated shield.

## Appearance
Black block with rectangular opening; metal shell silver in shielded variant. 

## Orientation Markings
The latch notch faces down (tab-down) in the default; pin 1 at +X in OHMNI; in RJE7M drawing pin 1 and 8 are labelled.

## Recognition Features
1. Rectangular ~11.7 x 7 opening with a latch notch. 2. 8 gold contacts. 3. 2 large locating posts. 4. Two staggered rows of 8 pins. 5. Shield shell + LED windows for the magjack variant.

## Parametric Variants
`shield` {none, shell}, `led_windows` {0, 2}, `tab` {down, up}, `depth`, `height`. Coupled: shield legs span = housing width - 0.2.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box housing minus box cavity, latch notch cut, 8 thin boxes, 8 pins, optional shell sheet.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Housing 15.3 x 17.74 x 12.70, bottom Z=0. 2. Cut cavity 11.7 x 7 x 14 from +Y. 3. Latch notch 4.5 x 1.5 (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED). 4. Contacts. 5. Pins (staggered). 6. Optional shell and LEDs. 7. NPTH pegs below.

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 box. LOD1 + cavity, notch, pins. LOD2 + 8 contacts, shell tabs, LED windows.

## Simplification Rules
Never omit opening, latch notch, two-row pin stagger. May omit contacts at LOD0.

## Geometry
Black rectangular plastic housing with a round front aperture and a short cylindrical collar/boss (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) projecting about 1-1.5 mm from the face; metal contact springs inside; 5 flat solder pins (tip, ring, sleeve, and 2 switch contacts) exit bottom, plus locating pegs on some parts (not in the KiCad KB3SPRS/SJ1-3535NG footprints). Metal sleeve tab on one side.

## Leads / Pins / Terminals
5 THT solder pins (tip T, tip-switch TN, ring R, ring-switch RN, sleeve S), flat tails about 0.3 x 0.9 (RECALLED_UNVERIFIED) in oval holes Ø1.3 (pad 4.0 x 2.2).
Default member KB3SPRS (KC axes: x toward the rear, mating nose toward -x, y down; converted by ohm = (-y_kc, -x_kc) then re-centered on the pad-center bbox, so mating face is +Y and no mirroring is applied; center shift in OHMNI-raw = (4.9, -1.7)):
 T (-4.9, +1.7), TN (-4.4, -5.6), RN (+2.2, -1.2), R (+4.9, -2.4), S (-0.3, +5.6). Pin 1 = T (-4.9, 1.7) (KiCad names T, TN, RN, R, S; map by name, not number). Pad centers span X ±4.9, Y ±5.6.
Body in OHMNI: X ±5.8, rear Y -6.9, body front Y +7.4, nose Y +7.4..+11.0 (mating face Y=+11.0), nose X -3.3..+2.7 (6.0 wide, axis at X=-0.3, the 3.5 mm bore axis). Pad S sits on the bore axis near the front (X -0.3).
Alternate member SJ1-3535NG: S (-1.0, 5.8), T (1.0, 3.4), R (1.0, -2.1), TN (-1.0, -5.8), RN (-1.0, -0.3); oval pad 2.8 x 1.8 with 2.0 x 1.0 oval drill; body X -5.0..+3.2 and Y -7.0..+7.0, nose Y +7.0..+11.0, nose X -3.1..+2.9; no peg holes in either KiCad footprint.
Alternate member PJ-307: pin positions RESEARCH_REQUIRED (NOT footprint-valid; do not reuse the KB3SPRS pads). SMD analogue evidence: KC PJ311 6-pad, pads 2.0 x 1.5 at x=±3.5 with NPTH Ø1.5 at (0,-4.3) and (0, 2.7) (KC axes); KC PJ320D 4-pad 1.2 x 2.5 pads with NPTH Ø1.5.

## PCB Interface
FCO = bbox center of the 5 pad centers (no peg holes in the KiCad footprint). Body offset: body Y -6.9..+7.4 (center +0.25) plus nose to +11.0; mating face Y=+11.0. Through holes: oval Ø1.3 (KB3SPRS) at the five coordinates above. Overhang default 0 (the footprint's board edge is not given; many jacks sit flush or overhang about 1 mm; RESEARCH_REQUIRED).

## Materials
MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK housing, MAT_TIN_BRIGHT pins, MAT_NICKEL sleeve tab, MAT_GOLD inner (invisible).

## Appearance
Black block, round hole, short boss; silver springs visible in the bore at LOD2.

## Orientation Markings
None; sleeve/ground tab on one side; orientation by pin layout.

## Recognition Features
1. Black block about 11.6 x 14.3 with a 6.0 wide nose on the +Y face (PJ-307 alternate: 12 x 14 x 5). 2. Round aperture on the nose. 3. 5 bottom pins in the asymmetric pattern. 4. Pegs only on some parts (none in the KiCad footprints).

## Parametric Variants
`poles` {3,4,5}, `mount` {tht, smd}, `length`, `boss_height`. Coupled: aperture centered on width, height/2.

## Recommended Base Geometry
Box housing, cylinder boss, cylinder bore cut, small boxes for pins and springs.

## Modeling Procedure
1. Body box X ±5.8, Y -6.9..+7.4, Z 0..6.0 (height placeholder). 2. Nose box 6.0 wide (X -3.3..+2.7) Y +7.4..+11.0, same height (or Ø6 round boss; nose shape in plan only is sourced). 3. Bore Ø3.8 along Y at X=-0.3, Z=height/2 (bore size recalled: 3.5 mm plug per SJ1-352xN "Ø3.5 mating plug"), depth about 8. 4. 5 pins at the coordinates above. 5. Springs (LOD2).

## LOD Strategy
LOD0 box. LOD1 + bore, boss, 5 pins. LOD2 + springs, sleeve tab.

## Simplification Rules
Never omit bore and boss; pin layout may be simplified only at LOD0.

Pass 2: pin coordinates are no longer placeholders: the default switched from the PJ-307 envelope (pins unresolved) to the Ledino KB3SPRS because it has a real, footprint-valid KiCad pad pattern (re-centered and rotated, transform stated). # G12B: Power, RF, FFC and Card Connectors

Evidence note. All sources below were read through a text-extraction fetch tool (WebFetch summarizer), never by viewing drawings, so callout-to-axis assignments are interpretations (Section 17.7: capped at M, and most values here are L). The web-search budget ran out mid-task, and several manufacturer drawing PDFs (Molex `pdm_docs`) were robots-blocked or returned 404/429. Where a drawing could not be read, values are `RESEARCH_REQUIRED` with an explicitly labeled OHMNI PLACEHOLDER (basis UNCERTAIN, confidence L) so the generator can still run. A placeholder is a design default, not a research claim. Second pass (search restored): KiCad footprints (S5) and re-read callouts closed many gaps; manufacturer drawing PDFs for SMA, SD and microSD are image-only and still unreadable. Status after second pass: OHM-178 complete, all others partial.

Common convention choices made in this file (flagged in the report):
- Connectors with a mating face (DC jack, XT, SMA edge, FFC, SD, microSD): insertion direction = +Y (card/plug/FPC enters from +Y, body rear toward -Y), per Section 6.
- FFC ZIF contacts form a single row; because the mating-face rule wins here, the row runs along X (pin 1 at -X), not Y as the single-row-header rule would say. This is a deliberate exception, recorded in OHM-178.
- Pin/terminal XY = center of PCB-contact area (Section 17.1).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-DC_JACK

**Shared geometry.** Right-angle THT 2-conductor barrel power jack with a rectangular plastic housing (PBT/nylon, black). A circular barrel receptacle opens on the +Y end face; its axis is parallel to the board (along Y) at roughly mid-height of the housing. A center pin (metal, 2.0 mm for the 2.0 mm-pin variant, or 2.5 mm for the 2.5 mm-pin variant) is visible inside the opening, standing on the barrel axis. Three solder tails drop to -Z: pin 1 center, pin 2 sleeve, pin 3 switch (shorting/normally-closed contact). Many series add two small plastic locating pegs or slots (not specified in opened documents).

**Generator notes (GEN-AUDIO_DC).** Box housing (L along Y, W along X, H along Z) with a cylindrical bore of diameter = barrel OD (5.5 mm for the common 2.1/2.5 mm jack; bore depth = jack insertion depth) cut into the +Y face; center pin = cylinder, diameter 2.0 or 2.5 mm per variant, length = insertion depth minus 0.5 mm. Tails are rectangular 0.5 x 1.0 mm or round 1.0 mm (UNCERTAIN, see below).

**Member table** (default / min / max, basis, confidence). Axis mapping: L along Y, W along X, H along Z.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-XT

**Shared geometry.** Amass XT series PCB-mount power connector, right-angle ("PW") style: a nylon (PA) housing with a polarity-keyed outline (two chamfered corners on one long edge so male and female cannot be reversed), gold-plated pins bent down through the board, and a mating face toward +Y. The male (-M) part shows two bullet/blade contacts inside a shroud; the female (-F) part shows two socket cavities. The housing profile is a rounded-rectangle with a chamfer at two corners, the "XT" signature.

**Generator notes (GEN-POWER_CONN).** Extrude the keyed 2D profile (rectangle W x H with two corner chamfers) along Y for depth D; cut two contact cavities (male: pins visible; female: sockets) from the mating face; add rear solder pins bent -Z.

| XT30PW-F | 5.0 | RESEARCH_REQUIRED (assume same envelope as -M) | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | DERIVED | L |
| XT60PW-M | 7.2 (callout 7.2 read twice in the Amass sheet, second pass) | 15.5 | 18.2 | 8.4 | 2-0.6 x 1.7 slots/tabs (callout 2-0.6*1.7) and 2-dia 2.7 holes (callout), assignment L | S4 hosted Amass spec | M-L (L for hole assignment) |
| XT60PW-F | 7.2 | 15.5 assumed | 17.2 (callout) | 8.4 assumed | RESEARCH_REQUIRED | S4 Amass spec | L |

**Conflicts (second pass resolved most of them).** First pass: XT30PW-M extract listed 13.95 / 13.30 / 9.90 and OHMNI assigned X=10.0, Z=9.90. Re-reading the Amass drawing gives the full ordered callout list 13.30, 9.90, 13.95, 9.00, 2.00, 5.00, 5.00, 11.00, 2-ø1.0, 10.00, 2-ø1.7. The KiCad AMASS_XT30PW-M footprint (S5) reproduces these: pins at pitch 5.0 with 1.9 drills, two dia 1.0 locating holes 11.0 apart (x = +3 and -8 around pins at 0 and -5) and 10.0 from the pin row (y = -10), and a fab outline 9.9 wide (x -7.45..2.45) by 9.0 deep (y -13.1..-4.1). So: 9.90 is the housing width along the pin axis (NOT height; the first-pass Z=9.90 was wrong), 10.00 is the pin-row-to-peg-row distance (NOT width), 11.00 is the peg spacing, 9.00 the plan depth of the drawn outline, 2-ø1.7 the power pin holes, 2-ø1.0 the pegs. Overall length 13.95 reaches from the rear pin-hole edge (y_k=-0.85) to the mating face (y_k=+13.1 in KiCad, mirrored to OHMNI +Y), which closes exactly (13.1 + 0.85 = 13.95); 13.30 is the body without the 0.65 rear step (L). Height: none of the callouts is labeled as height; the second 5.00 callout (and the known flat XT30 profile, 15.5:8.4 scaled gives about 5.4) is adopted as 5.0 with confidence L. XT60PW-M: the extractor labels 15.5 "depth" and 8.4 "height", 18.2 length (XT60PW-F 17.2), 7.2 appears twice (pitch, M-L), 2.7 and 2-Ø2.7 holes, 2.5 and 1.85 unassigned (1.85 was the first-pass chamfer guess, now unassigned, L), 6 and 13.5 unassigned.

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SMA_RF

**Shared geometry.** Vertical (straight) SMA female jack, THT: a round hex-nut-bearing barrel above the board with the 1/4-36 UNS-2A thread (thread callout read in a Molex SMA drawing; SMA interface is standardized by that thread), a PTFE dielectric with a female socket inside, a square or round flange base, a center pin tail and four ground legs/pegs through the board. Brass body gold finish, beryllium-copper center contact with gold plating, PTFE dielectric (Cinch 142-0701-201 listing). Mating axis +Z.

**Dimensions (second pass).** The Cinch (RS-hosted drawing A700000009602929) and Molex (RS-hosted drawing PDFs) vertical-SMA drawings are image-only: the fetch tool returned no text ("UNCONTROLLED COPY" only), so no drawing callouts were read. Values now come from (a) the Electro Sonic listing of Cinch 142-0701-201, "9.52 x 7.92 mm" (S4 retailer; read as overall height 9.52 = 0.375 in and hex 7.92 = 0.312 in, interpretation, L-M); (b) the KiCad SMA_Amphenol_132134_Vertical and SMA_Amphenol_901-144_Vertical footprints (S5, two files agree on the pad pattern): center pad drill 1.5 at (0,0), four ground pads drill 1.7 at (+-2.54,+-2.54) (5.08 mm square), fab square +-3.5 (132134) or +-3.175 (901-144) and a 3.175 radius circle (= 6.35 thread major dia); (c) thread 1/4-36 UNS-2A and hex 7.87 ref from the Molex EWR-2074 drawing (same SMA interface). Adopted OHMNI defaults: thread dia 6.35 (DERIVED, M), hex across flats 7.87 (Molex drawing; Cinch listing reads 7.92), overall height above board 9.52 (L-M), flange/body 7.0 x 7.0 (KiCad 132134 fab outline, L), center tail hole dia 1.5, ground legs hole dia 1.7 at (+-2.54,+-2.54) (M-L, two KiCad files). Leg cross-section and body height of the Amphenol 132134 itself are NOT read (RESEARCH_REQUIRED).

**Sources (opened).** Cinch/Johnson 142-0701-201 DigiKey listing (azcus.digikey.com/.../142-0701-201/35274, S4: materials, 18 GHz, threaded). Molex EWR-2074 drawing (see PKG-SMA_EDGE) for thread and hex. Second pass: Electro Sonic Cinch 142-0701-201 listing (e-sonic.com/en/productdetail/johnson-cinch-connectivity-solutions/1420701201-11277143.html, S4 retailer: "9.52 x 7.92 mm"); KiCad footprints SMA_Amphenol_132134_Vertical and SMA_Amphenol_901-144_Vertical (raw.githubusercontent.com/KiCad/kicad-footprints, S5); RS Cinch 8861061 listing (gold over nickel body, beryllium copper gold contact, 18 GHz; no dimensions).

Board thickness slot nominal 1.57 mm (0.062 in).

| Width (X) | 6.35 +-0.13 (0.250 in) | M |
| Dimension 12.45 +-0.13 (0.490 in): first pass assigned it to Z height; second pass reassigns it to the barrel length ahead of the board edge (see below) | 12.45 | L-M (reassigned) |
| Rear block depth (Y), DERIVED 16.26 - 12.45 | 3.81 (0.150 in) | L-M |
| Height (Z): hex across flats used as envelope | 7.87 (0.310 in) | L (no explicit height callout identified) |
| Thread | 1/4-36 UNS-2A | M |
| Hex nut | 7.87 ref (0.310 in) | M |
| Board thickness | 1.57 nominal | M |
| Pad diameter | 0.97 ref (0.038 in), two places | L |
| Pad spacing references | 4.19 (0.165), 4.32 (0.170) | L |
| Panel cutout | 6.50 +-0.10 dia (0.256 in) | L (belongs to panel use, not board edge) |
| Center contact features | 1.78 +-0.05 and 1.27 +-0.05 dia | L |

**Second-pass cross-check (KiCad SMA_Molex_73251-2120_EdgeMount_Horizontal, S5).** The footprint fab outline spans x -1.715..+14.545 (16.26, equals the Molex overall length) by y +-3.175 (6.35, equals the Molex width). Pads (KiCad coordinates, connector axis along x, pad 0,0 = center pad): center pad 4.19 (along axis) x 1.78 at (0,0) [matches Molex callouts 4.19 and 1.78]; two ground pads 4.19 x 2.665 at (0, +-3.4925) on both F and B copper; small ground tabs 0.89 x 0.46 at (-2.54, +-3.4925) and vias dia 0.97 (drill 0.46) at (-2.985, +-3.4925) [0.97 matches the Molex pad dia 0.97]. The pad front edge at x=+2.095 equals the rear-block front face (-1.715 + 3.81 = 2.095), so the board edge is at x=+2.095 and the barrel overhangs 14.545 - 2.095 = 12.45, which equals the 12.45 callout. Therefore 12.45 is the barrel/overhang length, not a height; first-pass Z=12.45 is withdrawn. Z extent is not read; hex 7.87 across flats is used as the envelope (L), and the heavier 6.35 width is the block width. A second Molex listing (Farnell 4726972) states recommended PCB thickness 2.13 mm for a different series part (73251-3460), so board thickness varies by part (1.57 vs 2.13). Molex 73251-1153 and 73251-1150 RS pages list drawings 732511153_sd.pdf / 732511150_sd.pdf (image-only, not readable).

## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-FFC_ZIF

**Shared geometry.** Hirose FH12 series, 0.5 mm pitch, bottom-contact, flip-lock (horizontal) ZIF FPC connector, SMD. A low rectangular black plastic housing with a rotating actuator (flip lock) on the rear; metal contacts visible as a comb of small tabs; two retaining tabs (metal) at the ends.

**Scaling with pin count N (consistent across the two table extractions).**
- A (contact span, first to last contact) = 0.5 x (N-1). Check: N=6 gives 2.5, N=20 gives 9.5 (range quoted: A 2.5 to 9.5); N=10 gives 4.5 (quoted by a second extraction).
- B (body length) = 0.5 x N + 3.1. Check: N=6 gives 6.1, N=16 gives 11.1 (a third extraction for the 16-pin part), N=20 gives 13.1 (range quoted 6.1 to 13.1).
- C (overall incl. retaining tabs) = B + 1.0. Check: N=6 gives 7.1, N=16 gives 12.1, N=20 gives 14.1.
- N=10: A 4.5, B 8.1, C 9.1.
- Depth (front-back) 5.6 and height 2.0 (standard flip-lock; 2.4 with strengthened actuator). Marked M: extraction gave these as "housing depth" and "height above the board".
- FPC thickness 0.3 +-0.05 (standard), 0.18 +-0.05 for FH12F.
- Recommended land: 0.3 +-0.03 pad width (0.25 metal mask) for 0.5 mm pitch in one extraction; another gives 0.8 +-0.1 (0.65 mask), which appears to be the retaining-tab/1 mm-pitch land, not the contact. Adopt 0.3 for contacts (M-L).
- **Second pass, KiCad Hirose_FH12-10S-0.5SH_1x10-1MP_P0.50mm_Horizontal (S5, same part, N=10).** Signal pads 0.3 (X) x 1.3 (Y), pitch 0.5, pin 1 at x=-2.25 .. pin 10 at +2.25 (top view; pin 1 at -X, which matches the OHMNI convention and is the KiCad/library convention rather than a Hirose drawing reading); mounting (retaining-tab) pads 1.8 (X) x 2.2 (Y) at x=+-4.15. Fab outline x +-4.05 (= B/2 = 4.05, agrees with B = 8.1) and 5.6 deep (agrees with the 5.6 depth): so the row of signal pads lies on the FPC-entry side, 1.3 long, projecting from the housing front face. Tab pad x position = B/2 + 0.1 (single data point, N=10 only; for other N extend with that rule, L). KiCad Y-down is converted to Y-up: FCO frame signal pads at Y=+1.85, tab pads at Y=-1.4 (pattern bbox Y +-2.5, X +-5.05, centered), housing spans Y +1.2 (front face) to -4.4 (rear), center Y=-1.6.

An important discrepancy: the alldatasheet page labeled FH12-10S-0.5SH actually showed values for 16 contacts (A 7.5, B 11.1, C 12.1). Resolved by the formulas above, which reproduce every opened value.

**OHMNI default.** 10 contacts, FH12-10S-0.5SH-like. Wurth WR-FPC and Molex 5051101092 were not opened (no data).

**Sources (opened).** KiCad Connector_FFC-FPC Hirose_FH12-10S-0.5SH_1x10-1MP_P0.50mm_Horizontal.kicad_mod (raw.githubusercontent.com/KiCad/kicad-footprints, S5, second pass). Hirose, FH12 series datasheet pages as hosted by alldatasheet (www.alldatasheet.com/html-pdf/81294/HIROSE/FH12-10S-0.5SH/1732/9/FH12-10S-0.5SH.html, S4); Hirose FH12 catalog excerpt via chipdip (static.chipdip.ru/lib/628/DOC026628239.pdf, S4); FH12 datasheet via trustcompo (datasheet.trustcompo.com/hirose-fh12-12s-0.5sh.pdf, S4); LBL-hosted Hirose card/flex catalog (www-eng.lbl.gov/~shuman/NEXT/.../hirose-card-flex-circuit-connectors.pdf): 0.3 FPC, 0.5 A, 2 mm board height, no drawings.
