## PACKAGE FAMILY: PKG-SD_SOCKET

**Shared geometry.** Full-size SD push-push SMD socket: a stainless-steel shell open at the +Y mating end, with the card sliding in along +Y/-Y, a plastic base with 9 contacts in a single row near the rear, and a detect/write-protect switch spring on the side.

**Genuine full-size part chosen (second pass).** Molex 67600-8001 (series 67600, "SD Memory Card Connector, Standard-Mount, Ultra Low Profile", 9 circuits, SMT with locator posts, push-push). The task's Molex 5031821852 is a microSD part (503182 series; used in OHM-180 as an alternate). Molex 67840-8001 and 104031-0811 were also tried: 67840-8001 search results gave no data; 104031-0811 is a microSD part.

**Member table.**

| Member | X (across) | Y (insertion axis) | Z (height) | Contacts | Basis | Conf |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Molex 67600-8001 (OHMNI default) | 27.9 (RS "length 27.9") | 30.5 (RS "width 30.5") | 2.8 (RS "depth 2.8") | 9 | S4 RS listing uk.rs-online.com/web/p/products/8006924 | L-M |
| Kyocera 145638009211859+ (KiCad footprint exemplar, NOT the default) | 28.7 courtyard | 26.1 courtyard | n/a | 9 + 2 detect | S5 KiCad | L |

Axis note: RS gives length 27.9 and width 30.5 without saying which is the insertion axis. OHMNI puts the larger value (30.5) on the insertion axis Y (a 24 mm wide card plus shell sides fits 27.9 across; a 32 mm long card protrudes only slightly from 30.5). This is an assumption (L). Height 2.8 supersedes the first-pass placeholder 3.0.

**Contact row (L).** The nine SD card contacts sit at positions fixed by the card standard, so their X pattern is generic. The Kyocera 145638009211859+ KiCad footprint (S5; a different manufacturer, used only as a pattern exemplar) lists pads 0.8 (X) x 2.0 (Y) in a row at y=-12.5 (rear; card enters from +y) with x = 6.88, 4.38, 1.08, -0.62, -3.12, -5.62, -8.05, -9.75 (pads 1-8) and 9.38 (pad 9), plus detect/write-protect pads at x=2.68 and -13.24, shield pads (13.2, 8.7), (-13.25, 9.9) and two 1.5 mm NPTH at (+-12.1, -5.3). Molex's Molex 67600 listing reads pitch "1.625 x 2 mm, 2.5 x 7 mm" (RS), which is not reconciled with the Kyocera spacing (2.5 and 1.7 alternating); both are listed, neither is drawing-verified. The OHMNI default uses the Kyocera contact X pattern, KiCad Y-down converted to Y-up and rotated 180 deg so the card enters from +Y, then re-centered on the contact row bbox: pad 1..9 X = -7.065, -4.565, -1.265, +0.435, +2.935, +5.435, +7.865, +9.565, -9.565, all at Y=0. (KiCad pad 9 is the outer pad on the opposite side, so pin numbering is not monotonic in X; importers should map by pad name.) Rotating 180 puts SD pin 1 at -X (KiCad top view has it at +X); this delta is recorded.

**Sources (opened).** RS Components listing Molex 67600-8001 (uk.rs-online.com/web/p/products/8006924, S4: 27.9 x 30.5 x 2.8, 9 circuits, pitch strings); Farnell datasheet page Molex 0676008001 (farnell.com/datasheets/1957052.pdf, S4: 2.50 mm mating-interface pitch, series description, ultra low profile; no body dimensions); RS-hosted Molex drawing docs.rs-online.com/6707/0900766b812cbeaf.pdf opened but image-only (no text readable); KiCad SD_Kyocera_145638009211859+.kicad_mod (raw.githubusercontent.com/KiCad/kicad-footprints, S5). KiCad footprint names for Molex/Hirose full-size SD (SD_Molex_67840-8001, SD_Hirose_DM1AA_SF_PEJ31) returned 404. Molex 5031821852/503182 series remains a microSD part (see PKG-MICROSD_SOCKET).

# [OHM-172] DC Barrel Jack

## Identity

Canonical name: DC barrel jack, 2.1 mm center pin / 5.5 mm barrel (default), right-angle THT. ID OHM-172, slug dc_jack_barrel. Category connector / power. Package PKG-DC_JACK (member PJ-102A-like, CUI). Mounting THT. Aliases: DC power jack, CUI PJ-002A, PJ-102A, Switchcraft RAPC722. Variants: 2.5 mm center-pin (parameter center_pin_dia). Class A, P1, complexity 4.


## Physical Dimensions

Default (PKG-DC_JACK, CUI PJ-102A/PJ-002A envelope): L (Y) 14.4 [14.4-14.5] (M: Oregon State, UConn and KiCad PJ-102AH outline agree), W (X) 10.7 [9.0 KiCad main-body alt, 11.1 Switchcraft] (M-L: Oregon State PJ-002A and UConn PJ-102A both read 10.7), H (Z) 11.0 (L: PJ-002A only; UConn lists 6.5, not adopted), barrel bore OD 5.5 (standard barrel; not read in an opened document, L), center pin dia 2.0 (alt 2.5; M), insertion depth 9.0 (9.5 alt). First-pass default W 9.0 was superseded by 10.7 (see family Conflicts); the brief's 14.0 x 9.0 x 11.0 was not confirmed.


## Geometry

Rectangular housing, vertical sides, flat top. A circular bore (dia 5.5, depth 9.0) opens in the +Y face with its axis at x=+2.35 (the body centerline, FCO frame) and z=5.5 (PLACEHOLDER: mid-height; UConn lists a 6.5 value that may be the axis height; RESEARCH_REQUIRED). Center pin cylinder dia 2.0 on axis, rising from the bore floor to 0.5 below the face. Rear and bottom corners square; optional 0.3 mm edge chamfers at LOD2. Two small bottom pegs are RESEARCH_REQUIRED (omit).


## Leads / Pins / Terminals

3 THT terminals: P1 center pin, P2 sleeve, P3 switch. Rectangular tails 0.5 x 1.0 (PLACEHOLDER thickness; UConn lists a 1.0 x 1.6 hole). Layout (second pass, M-L): KiCad CUI PJ-102AH footprint (S5) gives P1 (0,0), P2 (0,6.0), P3 (4.7,3.0) in KiCad coordinates, matching the UConn PJ-102A callouts 3.0 / 4.7. Transformed to the OHMNI frame (Y flipped to Y-up, rotated 180 deg so the bore opens toward +Y, then bbox-centered per FCO), centers are: P1 center pin (+2.35,-3.0), P2 sleeve (+2.35,+3.0), P3 switch (-2.35, 0). P1 is nearest the rear, P2 nearest the opening, P3 sits on the side of the body. The earlier placeholder (pitch 3.5, P1 (0,-1.75), P2/P3 at +-3.0) is replaced; the Oregon State "terminal spacing 3.5, holes 2.0" belongs to the PJ-002A layout and is kept as an alternate, not modeled. Tails to Z=-2.6 default.


## PCB Interface

Three holes 1.6 dia round (KiCad PJ-102AH drill, S5; UConn lists 1.0 x 1.6 slot; PJ-002A Oregon State lists 2.0) at the coordinates above. Oregon State extract also lists two 2.5 mm mounting holes (PJ-002A; L, omitted by default). Pattern origin = FCO center of the three holes. body_offset_mm = (2.35, +3.5), derived from the KiCad PJ-102AH body outline (x -4.5..4.5, y -0.7..13.7 in KiCad coordinates): body rear face at Y=-3.7, opening face at Y=+10.7. Overhang 0 default (the body sits on the board; the opening face is 10.7 beyond the pad center, so place the jack near the board edge in the layout; overhang value is a layout choice, not a package fact).


## Materials

Housing MAT_PLASTIC_BLACK; center pin and tails MAT_TIN_BRIGHT (tin/nickel), visible pin MAT_NICKEL.


## Appearance

Black glossy-matte plastic housing, metal pin in bore. No markings required. Geometry separated from decals (no decals).


## Orientation Markings

No polarity marking on the housing. Conventional center-positive is a system choice, not a package fact. Pin function markings not present.


## Recognition Features

1) Rectangular black block with round bore on the front. 2) Metal center pin inside bore. 3) Three tails. 4) Height about 11 mm, roughly as tall as wide (10.7). 5) Bore diameter 5.5 vs pin 2.0.


## Parametric Variants

center_pin_dia (2.0|2.5), bore_od (5.5 default), insertion_depth, housing L/W/H. Coupled: pin_dia < bore_od - 2.0; tails to Z=-(board_thickness+1.0).


## Recommended Base Geometry

Box + cylindrical subtract + cylinder pin + 3 box tails.


## Modeling Procedure

1. Box W x L x H, base at Z=0, centered with body_offset. 2. Cut bore from +Y face to depth 9.0. 3. Add center pin on axis. 4. Add three tails with positions above. 5. Optional chamfers.


## LOD Strategy

LOD0: box plus three tails merged
LOD1: box with bore cut, center pin, 3 tails
LOD2: chamfers, pin tip taper, possible locating pegs, internal shorting spring omitted


## Simplification Rules

May omit: pegs, chamfers, switch spring. Never omit: the 5.5 bore, the center pin, the +Y opening, the 3 tails.

## Sources

## Research Confidence

For N contacts: contact span A = 0.5(N-1); body length B = 0.5N + 3.1; overall incl tabs C = B + 1.0; depth 5.6 (M: datasheet extracts plus KiCad outline 1.2+4.4); height 2.0 (2.4 strengthened; M, Hirose catalog "2 mm"); FPC 0.3. Low box body of length B along X, depth 5.6 along Y (front face at Y=+1.2, rear at Y=-4.4 in the FCO frame for the default), height 2.0. N contacts, pitch 0.5, along X, pin 1 at -X (OHMNI convention; KiCad FH12 footprint has the same). Pad 0.3 wide (X) x 1.3 long (Y) (M, KiCad). Pin k at x = -A/2 + 0.5(k-1), y = +1.85. N=10: x from -2.25 to +2.25.

## Orientation Markings

Pin 1 at -X (library convention; Hirose drawing pin-1 side not viewed).


## Recognition Features

1) Low rectangular housing 2.0 high. 2) Flip lock bar at rear. 3) Row of N tiny contacts. 4) End tabs.


## Parametric Variants

N (6 to 20 verified), actuator state (open/closed), pitch 0.5.


## Recommended Base Geometry

Box + hinged bar + comb.


## Modeling Procedure

1. Compute B=0.5N+3.1. 2. Box B x 5.6 x 2.0. 3. Actuator. 4. N contacts. 5. Tabs.

# Recommended Codex Implementation Order

Grouped by shared generator so each generator build yields several library components. Do the stages in order; within a stage, P0/P1 members first. Re-check `status` before modeling an entry marked partial or research_required.

### Stage 1: chip passives (one generator, PKG-CHIP2T)

- Build the generator for PKG-CHIP2T -> OHM-001 01005 SMD resistor, OHM-002 0201 SMD resistor, OHM-003 0402 SMD resistor, OHM-004 0603 SMD resistor, OHM-005 0805 SMD resistor, OHM-006 1206 SMD resistor, OHM-007 1210 SMD resistor, OHM-008 2010 SMD resistor, OHM-009 2512 SMD resistor, OHM-014 SMD current-sense resistor, OHM-021 0201 MLCC capacitor, OHM-022 0402 MLCC capacitor, OHM-023 0603 MLCC capacitor, OHM-024 0805 MLCC capacitor, OHM-025 1206 MLCC capacitor, OHM-026 1210 MLCC capacitor, OHM-027 1812 MLCC capacitor, OHM-041 0603 chip inductor, OHM-042 0805 chip inductor, OHM-043 1206 chip inductor

- Build the generator for PKG-TSSOP -> OHM-114 TSSOP-8, OHM-115 TSSOP-14, OHM-116 TSSOP-16, OHM-117 TSSOP-20
